/**
 * @format
 */

import React from 'react';
import ReactTestRenderer, { act } from 'react-test-renderer';
import { Text } from 'react-native';
import {
  RepositoryProvider,
  useRepositories,
} from '../src/app/RepositoryProvider';
import {
  resetDataMode,
  setDataMode,
} from '../src/app/configuration/dataMode';
import { ApiClient, TransportAdapter } from '../src/core/api/apiClient';
import { MemoryTokenStore } from '../src/core/auth/tokenStore';
import { SessionManager } from '../src/core/auth/sessionManager';
import {
  defaultCoordinatorRepository,
  defaultDashboardRepository,
  defaultEventRepository,
  defaultProfileRepository,
  MockCoordinatorRepository,
  MockDashboardRepository,
  MockEventRepository,
  MockProfileRepository,
} from '../src/data/mock';
import {
  HttpCoordinatorRepository,
  HttpDashboardRepository,
  HttpEventRepository,
  HttpProfileRepository,
} from '../src/data/http';

describe('RepositoryProvider & Dependency-Injection Bridge', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    act(() => {
      resetDataMode();
    });
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    act(() => {
      resetDataMode();
    });
  });

  function ConsumerComponent({
    onRender,
  }: {
    onRender: (context: ReturnType<typeof useRepositories>) => void;
  }) {
    const repos = useRepositories();
    onRender(repos);
    return <Text testID="mode">{repos.dataMode}</Text>;
  }

  it('provides Mock repositories by default when dataMode is unset', () => {
    let capturedContext: ReturnType<typeof useRepositories> | null = null;

    act(() => {
      ReactTestRenderer.create(
        <RepositoryProvider>
          <ConsumerComponent
            onRender={ctx => {
              capturedContext = ctx;
            }}
          />
        </RepositoryProvider>,
      );
    });

    expect(capturedContext).not.toBeNull();
    expect(capturedContext!.dataMode).toBe('mock');
    expect(capturedContext!.dashboardRepository).toBe(
      defaultDashboardRepository,
    );
    expect(capturedContext!.eventRepository).toBe(defaultEventRepository);
    expect(capturedContext!.profileRepository).toBe(defaultProfileRepository);
    expect(capturedContext!.coordinatorRepository).toBe(
      defaultCoordinatorRepository,
    );
  });

  it('provides Http repositories when dataMode="http" is passed', () => {
    let capturedContext: ReturnType<typeof useRepositories> | null = null;

    act(() => {
      ReactTestRenderer.create(
        <RepositoryProvider dataMode="http">
          <ConsumerComponent
            onRender={ctx => {
              capturedContext = ctx;
            }}
          />
        </RepositoryProvider>,
      );
    });

    expect(capturedContext).not.toBeNull();
    expect(capturedContext!.dataMode).toBe('http');
    expect(capturedContext!.dashboardRepository).toBeInstanceOf(
      HttpDashboardRepository,
    );
    expect(capturedContext!.eventRepository).toBeInstanceOf(
      HttpEventRepository,
    );
    expect(capturedContext!.profileRepository).toBeInstanceOf(
      HttpProfileRepository,
    );
    expect(capturedContext!.coordinatorRepository).toBeInstanceOf(
      HttpCoordinatorRepository,
    );
  });

  it('switches to Http repositories when setDataMode("http") is set globally', () => {
    act(() => {
      setDataMode('http');
    });
    let capturedContext: ReturnType<typeof useRepositories> | null = null;

    act(() => {
      ReactTestRenderer.create(
        <RepositoryProvider>
          <ConsumerComponent
            onRender={ctx => {
              capturedContext = ctx;
            }}
          />
        </RepositoryProvider>,
      );
    });

    expect(capturedContext!.dataMode).toBe('http');
    expect(capturedContext!.dashboardRepository).toBeInstanceOf(
      HttpDashboardRepository,
    );
  });

  it('reactively updates provided repositories when global dataMode changes after mount', () => {
    let capturedContext: ReturnType<typeof useRepositories> | null = null;

    act(() => {
      ReactTestRenderer.create(
        <RepositoryProvider>
          <ConsumerComponent
            onRender={ctx => {
              capturedContext = ctx;
            }}
          />
        </RepositoryProvider>,
      );
    });

    expect(capturedContext!.dataMode).toBe('mock');
    expect(capturedContext!.eventRepository).toBe(defaultEventRepository);

    act(() => {
      setDataMode('http');
    });

    expect(capturedContext!.dataMode).toBe('http');
    expect(capturedContext!.eventRepository).toBeInstanceOf(HttpEventRepository);

    act(() => {
      setDataMode('mock');
    });

    expect(capturedContext!.dataMode).toBe('mock');
    expect(capturedContext!.eventRepository).toBe(defaultEventRepository);
  });

  it('allows overriding specific repositories via repositories prop', () => {
    const customMockDashboard = new MockDashboardRepository();
    let capturedContext: ReturnType<typeof useRepositories> | null = null;

    act(() => {
      ReactTestRenderer.create(
        <RepositoryProvider
          repositories={{
            dashboardRepository: customMockDashboard,
          }}
        >
          <ConsumerComponent
            onRender={ctx => {
              capturedContext = ctx;
            }}
          />
        </RepositoryProvider>,
      );
    });

    expect(capturedContext!.dashboardRepository).toBe(customMockDashboard);
    expect(capturedContext!.eventRepository).toBe(defaultEventRepository);
  });

  it('useRepositories hook falls back safely to mock repositories outside of Provider', () => {
    let capturedContext: ReturnType<typeof useRepositories> | null = null;

    act(() => {
      ReactTestRenderer.create(
        <ConsumerComponent
          onRender={ctx => {
            capturedContext = ctx;
          }}
        />,
      );
    });

    expect(capturedContext).not.toBeNull();
    expect(capturedContext!.dataMode).toBe('mock');
    expect(capturedContext!.dashboardRepository).toBe(
      defaultDashboardRepository,
    );
  });
});

describe('Http Repositories Non-Invasive & Error Handling Guarantees', () => {
  let tokenStore: MemoryTokenStore;
  let sessionMgr: SessionManager;

  beforeEach(() => {
    tokenStore = new MemoryTokenStore();
    sessionMgr = new SessionManager(tokenStore);
  });

  it('HttpDashboardRepository throws on network failure and NEVER silently falls back to mock', async () => {
    const failingTransport: TransportAdapter = async () => {
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({
          error: {

describe('Phase 5 Live-BFF Bug Fix Verifications', () => {
  let tokenStore: MemoryTokenStore;
  let sessionMgr: SessionManager;

  beforeEach(() => {
    tokenStore = new MemoryTokenStore();
    sessionMgr = new SessionManager(tokenStore);
  });

  it('P1-13: MockEventRepository slices page window and preserves pagination metadata', async () => {
    const mockRepo = new MockEventRepository();
    const page1 = await mockRepo.getEventsPage(undefined, 1, 2);

    expect(page1.results).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(page1.count).toBeGreaterThan(2);
    expect(page1.next).not.toBeNull();
    expect(page1.previous).toBeNull();

    const page2 = await mockRepo.getEventsPage(undefined, 2, 2);
    expect(page2.results).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(page2.previous).not.toBeNull();
    expect(page2.results[0].id).not.toBe(page1.results[0].id);
  });

  it('P1-13: HttpEventRepository maps page results and exposes pagination metadata', async () => {
    const mockTransport: TransportAdapter = async input => {
      expect(input).toContain('/events/?page=2&page_size=3');
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({
          count: 5,
          next: null,
          previous: 'http://localhost/api/v1/events/?page=1',
          results: [
            {
              id: 104,
              title: 'Paged Event 4',
              status: 'published',
              purpose_type: 'charity_event',
              start_at: '2026-12-01T08:00:00Z',
              end_at: '2026-12-01T12:00:00Z',
              location_name: 'Downtown',
              total_headcount_needed: 10,
              total_headcount_filled: 2,
              charity_fields: ['health_wellness'],
              posts: [],
            },
          ],
        }),
        { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } },
      );
    };

    const client = new ApiClient(mockTransport, tokenStore, sessionMgr);
    const repo = new HttpEventRepository(client);

    const pageResult = await repo.getEventsPage(undefined, 2, 3);
    expect(pageResult.count).toBe(5);
    expect(pageResult.next).toBeNull();
    expect(pageResult.previous).toBe('http://localhost/api/v1/events/?page=1');
    expect(pageResult.results).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(pageResult.results[0].title).toBe('Paged Event 4');
  });

  it('P0-02: HttpCoordinatorRepository.updateApplicationStatus returns updated data item', async () => {
    const mockTransport: TransportAdapter = async (input, init) => {
      if (input.includes('/coordinator/events/10/applications/')) {
        return new Response(
          JSON.stringify({
            results: [
              {
                id: 55,
                event_id: 10,
                user_id: 101,

                status: 'pending',
                source: 'browse',
                applied_at: '2026-11-10T00:00:00Z',

          { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } },

      }
      return new Response('{}', { status: 200 });
    };

    const client = new ApiClient(mockTransport, tokenStore, sessionMgr);
    const repo = new HttpCoordinatorRepository(client);

    // Warm up cache
    await repo.getApplications('10');

    const result = await repo.updateApplicationStatus('55', 'accepted');
    expect(result.success).toBe(true);
    expect(result.data).toBeDefined();
    expect(result.data?.id).toBe('55');
    expect(result.data?.status).toBe('accepted');
  });

  it('P0-03: HttpCoordinatorRepository.assignVolunteerManually returns created item with valid ID', async () => {
    const mockTransport: TransportAdapter = async input => {
      if (input.includes('/coordinator/events/10/applications/')) {
        return new Response(
          JSON.stringify({
            results: [
              {
                id: 55,
                event_id: 10,
                user_id: 101,

                status: 'accepted',
                source: 'browse',

          { status: 201, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } },
        );
      }
      if (input.includes('/coordinator/events/10/assignments/')) {
        return new Response(
          JSON.stringify({
            results: [
              {
                id: 777,
                event_id: 10,
                user_id: 101,
                display_name: 'Volunteer A',
                post_id: 2,
                post_title: 'First Aider',
                status: 'assigned',
                is_group_leader: false,
                schedule_start: '2026-11-20T08:00:00Z',
                schedule_end: '2026-11-20T12:00:00Z',
              },
            ],
          }),
          { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } },
        );
      }
      return new Response('{}', { status: 200 });
    };

    const client = new ApiClient(mockTransport, tokenStore, sessionMgr);
    const repo = new HttpCoordinatorRepository(client);

    // Warm up applications to map applicationId 55 -> eventId 10
    await repo.getApplications('10');

    const result = await repo.assignVolunteerManually('55', '2');
    expect(result.success).toBe(true);
    expect(result.data).toBeDefined();
    expect(result.data?.id).toBe('777');
    expect(result.data?.postTitle).toBe('First Aider');
  });

  it('deduplicates concurrent in-flight requests in HttpCoordinatorRepository', async () => {
    let callCount = 0;
    const mockTransport: TransportAdapter = async () => {
      callCount += 1;
      await new Promise<void>(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
      return new Response(
        JSON.stringify({
          results: [],
        }),
        { status: 200, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } },
      );
    };

    const client = new ApiClient(mockTransport, tokenStore, sessionMgr);
    const repo = new HttpCoordinatorRepository(client);

    // Call getMyEvents concurrently 3 times
    const [res1, res2, res3] = await Promise.all([
      repo.getMyEvents(),
      repo.getMyEvents(),
      repo.getMyEvents(),
    ]);

    expect(callCount).toBe(1);
    expect(res1).toEqual([]);
    expect(res2).toEqual([]);
    expect(res3).toEqual([]);
  });
});

/**
 * @format
 */

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { StatusBar, StyleSheet, View } from 'react-native';
import { NavigationContainer } from '@react-navigation/native';
import { MainDrawerNavigator } from '../navigation/MainDrawerNavigator';
import { useAppTheme } from '../theme';
import { AppProviders } from './AppProviders';
import { useCurrentUser } from './UserContext';
import {
  addDataModeListener,
  DataMode,
  getDataMode,
} from './configuration/dataMode';
import { OtpLoginScreen } from '../features/auth';
import { LoadingState } from '../shared';

export function AppNavigationRoot(): React.JSX.Element {
  const { theme, isDark } = useAppTheme();
  const { isAuthenticated, isBootstrapping } = useCurrentUser();
  const [dataMode, setDataMode] = useState<DataMode>(() => getDataMode());

  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubscribe = addDataModeListener(newMode => {
      setDataMode(newMode);
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  }, []);

  const httpMode = dataMode === 'http';

  if (httpMode && isBootstrapping) {
    return (
      <View
        style={[
          styles.centeredContainer,
          { backgroundColor: theme.colors.background },
        ]}
      >
        <StatusBar barStyle={isDark ? 'light-content' : 'dark-content'} />
        <LoadingState label="Connecting and restoring session..." />
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (httpMode && !isAuthenticated) {
    return (
      <>
        <StatusBar barStyle={isDark ? 'light-content' : 'dark-content'} />
        <OtpLoginScreen />
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <>
      <StatusBar barStyle={isDark ? 'light-content' : 'dark-content'} />
      <NavigationContainer>
        <MainDrawerNavigator />
      </NavigationContainer>
    </>
  );
}

export function AppRoot(): React.JSX.Element {
  return (
    <AppProviders>
      <AppNavigationRoot />
    </AppProviders>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  centeredContainer: {
    flex: 1,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
    padding: 24,
  },
});

/**
 * @format
 */

import React, {
  createContext,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from 'react';
import {
  addDataModeListener,
  DataMode,
  getDataMode,
} from './configuration/dataMode';
import type {
  CoordinatorRepository,
  EventRepository,
  IDashboardRepository,
  ProfileRepository,
} from '../data/contracts';
import {
  defaultCoordinatorRepository,
  defaultDashboardRepository,
  defaultEventRepository,
  defaultProfileRepository,
} from '../data/mock';
import {
  defaultHttpCoordinatorRepository,
  defaultHttpDashboardRepository,
  defaultHttpEventRepository,
  defaultHttpProfileRepository,
} from '../data/http';

export interface RepositoryContextType {
  dashboardRepository: IDashboardRepository;
  eventRepository: EventRepository;
  profileRepository: ProfileRepository;
  coordinatorRepository: CoordinatorRepository;
  dataMode: DataMode;
}

const fallbackContext: RepositoryContextType = {
  dashboardRepository: defaultDashboardRepository,
  eventRepository: defaultEventRepository,
  profileRepository: defaultProfileRepository,
  coordinatorRepository: defaultCoordinatorRepository,
  dataMode: 'mock',
};

const RepositoryContext = createContext<RepositoryContextType | null>(null);

export interface RepositoryProviderProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  dataMode?: DataMode;
  repositories?: Partial<RepositoryContextType>;
}

export function RepositoryProvider({
  children,
  dataMode: explicitDataMode,
  repositories: overrideRepositories,
}: RepositoryProviderProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [currentMode, setCurrentMode] = useState<DataMode>(
    () => explicitDataMode ?? getDataMode(),
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    if (explicitDataMode !== undefined) {
      setCurrentMode(explicitDataMode);
      return;
    }
    const unsubscribe = addDataModeListener(newMode => {
      setCurrentMode(newMode);
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  }, [explicitDataMode]);

  const activeMode = explicitDataMode ?? currentMode;

  const contextValue = useMemo<RepositoryContextType>(() => {
    const baseRepositories: Omit<RepositoryContextType, 'dataMode'> =
      activeMode === 'http'
        ? {
            dashboardRepository: defaultHttpDashboardRepository,
            eventRepository: defaultHttpEventRepository,
            profileRepository: defaultHttpProfileRepository,
            coordinatorRepository: defaultHttpCoordinatorRepository,
          }
        : {
            dashboardRepository: defaultDashboardRepository,
            eventRepository: defaultEventRepository,
            profileRepository: defaultProfileRepository,
            coordinatorRepository: defaultCoordinatorRepository,
          };

    return {
      dashboardRepository:
        overrideRepositories?.dashboardRepository ??
        baseRepositories.dashboardRepository,
      eventRepository:
        overrideRepositories?.eventRepository ??
        baseRepositories.eventRepository,
      profileRepository:
        overrideRepositories?.profileRepository ??
        baseRepositories.profileRepository,
      coordinatorRepository:
        overrideRepositories?.coordinatorRepository ??
        baseRepositories.coordinatorRepository,
      dataMode: overrideRepositories?.dataMode ?? activeMode,
    };
  }, [activeMode, overrideRepositories]);

  return (
    <RepositoryContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
      {children}
    </RepositoryContext.Provider>
  );
}

/**
 * Hook to access repositories and current data mode from the DI bridge.
 * If used outside a RepositoryProvider, falls back gracefully to the mock repositories
 * ensuring full backward compatibility with legacy screen unit tests.
 */
export function useRepositories(): RepositoryContextType {
  const context = useContext(RepositoryContext);
  return context ?? fallbackContext;
}

/**

import React, {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from 'react';
import { defaultCoordinatorRepository } from '../data/mock/MockCoordinatorRepository';
import {
  approvedCoordinatorUser,
  ordinaryVolunteerUser,
  pendingCoordinatorUser,
} from '../data/mock/fixtures/demoUsers';
import {
  CoordinatorStatus,
  hasCoordinatorAccess,
  UserAccountStatus,
  UserProfileSnapshot,
} from '../domain/models';
import {
  addDataModeListener,
  DataMode,
  getDataMode,
} from './configuration/dataMode';
import { sessionManager } from '../core/auth/sessionManager';
import { authApi } from '../data/endpoints/authApi';
import type { OtpDeliveryDto } from '../data/dto/authDto';
import { profileApi } from '../data/endpoints/profileApi';
import { resetDiscoveryCache } from '../features/events/screens/EventDiscoveryScreen';
import { resetApplicationsCache } from '../features/events/screens/MyApplicationsScreen';
import { resetAssignmentsCache } from '../features/events/screens/MyAssignmentsScreen';

export type UserPreset = 'volunteer' | 'coordinator' | 'pending';

export interface RequestOtpResult {
  success: boolean;
  status?: string;
  delivery?: OtpDeliveryDto;
  devCode?: string;
  error?: string;
}

export interface VerifyOtpResult {
  success: boolean;
  error?: string;
}

export interface UserContextValue {
  currentUser: UserProfileSnapshot;
  setCurrentUser: (user: UserProfileSnapshot) => void;
  isCoordinator: boolean;
  switchUserPreset: (preset: UserPreset) => void;
  isAuthenticated?: boolean;
  isBootstrapping?: boolean;
  requestOtp?: (
    phone: string,
    purpose?: 'login' | 'qr_registration',
  ) => Promise<RequestOtpResult>;
  verifyOtp?: (
    phone: string,
    code: string,
    displayName?: string,
  ) => Promise<VerifyOtpResult>;
  logout?: () => Promise<void>;
  refreshSessionUser?: () => Promise<void>;
}

export interface FullUserContextValue extends UserContextValue {
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  isBootstrapping: boolean;
  requestOtp: (
    phone: string,
    purpose?: 'login' | 'qr_registration',
  ) => Promise<RequestOtpResult>;
  verifyOtp: (
    phone: string,
    code: string,
    displayName?: string,
  ) => Promise<VerifyOtpResult>;
  logout: () => Promise<void>;
  refreshSessionUser: () => Promise<void>;
}

export const UserContext = createContext<UserContextValue | undefined>(
  undefined,
);

export interface UserProviderProps {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  initialUser?: UserProfileSnapshot;
  initialAuthenticated?: boolean;
}

export function UserProvider({
  children,
  initialUser = ordinaryVolunteerUser,
  initialAuthenticated,
}: UserProviderProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const [dataMode, setDataModeState] = useState<DataMode>(() => getDataMode());
  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] =
    useState<UserProfileSnapshot>(initialUser);
  const [isAuthenticated, setIsAuthenticated] = useState<boolean>(() => {
    if (initialAuthenticated !== undefined) {
      return initialAuthenticated;
    }
    return getDataMode() === 'mock';
  });
  const [isBootstrapping, setIsBootstrapping] = useState<boolean>(
    () => getDataMode() === 'http',
  );

  // Sync with global dataMode changes
  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubscribe = addDataModeListener(newMode => {
      setDataModeState(newMode);
      if (newMode === 'mock') {
        setIsAuthenticated(true);
        setIsBootstrapping(false);
      }
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  }, []);

  // Update mock coordinator repository whenever identity changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (defaultCoordinatorRepository.setCoordinatorIdentity) {
      defaultCoordinatorRepository.setCoordinatorIdentity({
        id: currentUser.id,
        displayName: currentUser.displayName,
        email: currentUser.email,
      });
    }
  }, [currentUser]);

  // Subscribe to session manager 401 unauthorized notifications
  useEffect(() => {
    const unsubscribe = sessionManager.onUnauthorized(() => {
      resetDiscoveryCache();
      resetApplicationsCache();
      resetAssignmentsCache();
      if (getDataMode() === 'http') {
        setIsAuthenticated(false);
      }
    });
    return unsubscribe;
  }, []);

  const refreshSessionUser = useCallback(async () => {
    const [meRes, coordRes] = await Promise.all([
      profileApi.getProfile(),
      profileApi.getCoordinatorProfile(),
    ]);

    if (!meRes.ok) {
      if (meRes.status === 401) {
        setIsAuthenticated(false);
      }
      return;
    }

    const coordStatus: CoordinatorStatus =
      (coordRes.ok &&
        (coordRes.data?.coordinator?.status as CoordinatorStatus)) ||
      'none';
    const acctStatus =
      (meRes.data.account_status as UserAccountStatus) || 'active';

    const snapshot: UserProfileSnapshot = {
      id: String(meRes.data.id),
      displayName: meRes.data.display_name,
      phone: meRes.data.phone ?? null,
      email: meRes.data.phone || 'volunteer@example.com',
      coordinatorStatus: coordStatus,
      accountStatus: acctStatus,
    };

    setCurrentUser(snapshot);
    setIsAuthenticated(true);
  }, []);

  // Session bootstrap on cold start in HTTP mode
  useEffect(() => {
    if (dataMode !== 'http') {
      setIsBootstrapping(false);
      setIsAuthenticated(true);
      return;
    }

    let isMounted = true;
    setIsBootstrapping(true);

    async function bootstrap() {
      const token = await sessionManager.getToken();
      if (!token || token.trim().length === 0) {
        if (isMounted) {
          setIsAuthenticated(false);
          setIsBootstrapping(false);
        }
        return;
      }

      try {
        await refreshSessionUser();
      } catch {
        // Network or non-auth error: preserve token, do not invalidate
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) {
          setIsBootstrapping(false);
        }
      }
    }

    bootstrap();

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [dataMode, refreshSessionUser]);

  const requestOtp = useCallback(
    async (
      phone: string,
      purpose: 'login' | 'qr_registration' = 'login',
    ): Promise<RequestOtpResult> => {
      const res = await authApi.requestOtp({ phone, purpose });
      if (!res.ok) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: res.error.message,
        };
      }
      return {
        success: true,
        status: res.data.status,
        delivery: res.data.delivery,
        devCode: res.data.dev_code,
      };
    },
    [],
  );

  const verifyOtp = useCallback(
    async (
      phone: string,
      code: string,
      displayName?: string,
    ): Promise<VerifyOtpResult> => {
      const res = await authApi.verifyOtp({
        phone,
        code,
        purpose: 'login',
        display_name: displayName,
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        return {
          success: false,
          error: res.error.message,
        };
      }

      await sessionManager.setToken(res.data.token);

      try {
        await refreshSessionUser();
      } catch {
        // Fallback to minimal snapshot from verify response if profile call fails
        const snapshot: UserProfileSnapshot = {
          id: String(res.data.user.id),
          displayName: res.data.user.display_name,
          phone: phone,
          email: phone,
          coordinatorStatus: 'none',
          accountStatus: 'active',
        };
        setCurrentUser(snapshot);
        setIsAuthenticated(true);
      }

      return {
        success: true,
      };
    },
    [refreshSessionUser],
  );

  const logout = useCallback(async (): Promise<void> => {
    resetDiscoveryCache();
    resetApplicationsCache();
    resetAssignmentsCache();
    if (getDataMode() === 'http') {
      try {
        await authApi.logout();
      } catch {
        // Ignore server error during logout
      }
      await sessionManager.logout();
      setIsAuthenticated(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const isCoordinator = useMemo(
    () => hasCoordinatorAccess(currentUser),
    [currentUser],
  );

  const switchUserPreset = useCallback((preset: UserPreset) => {
    switch (preset) {
      case 'coordinator':
        setCurrentUser(approvedCoordinatorUser);
        break;
      case 'pending':
        setCurrentUser(pendingCoordinatorUser);
        break;
      case 'volunteer':
      default:
        setCurrentUser(ordinaryVolunteerUser);
        break;
    }
  }, []);

  const contextValue = useMemo<FullUserContextValue>(
    () => ({
      currentUser,
      setCurrentUser,
      isCoordinator,
      switchUserPreset,
      isAuthenticated,
      isBootstrapping,
      requestOtp,
      verifyOtp,
      logout,
      refreshSessionUser,
    }),
    [
      currentUser,
      isCoordinator,
      switchUserPreset,
      isAuthenticated,
      isBootstrapping,
      requestOtp,
      verifyOtp,
      logout,
      refreshSessionUser,
    ],
  );

  return (
    <UserContext.Provider value={contextValue}>{children}</UserContext.Provider>
  );
}

const fallbackUserContext: FullUserContextValue = {
  currentUser: ordinaryVolunteerUser,
  setCurrentUser: () => {},
  isCoordinator: false,
  switchUserPreset: () => {},
  isAuthenticated: true,
  isBootstrapping: false,
  requestOtp: async () => ({ success: true }),
  verifyOtp: async () => ({ success: true }),
  logout: async () => {},
  refreshSessionUser: async () => {},
};

export function useCurrentUser(): FullUserContextValue {
  const context = useContext(UserContext);
  if (!context) {
    return fallbackUserContext;
  }

  return {
    ...fallbackUserContext,
    ...context,
  };
}

/**
 * @format
 */

/**
 * Storage key strictly isolated to authentication token storage.
 * Isolated from theme preference (@volunteer_mgmt:theme_preference).
 */
export const AUTH_TOKEN_STORAGE_KEY = '@volunteer_mgmt:auth_token';

export interface TokenStore {
  getToken(): Promise<string | null>;
  setToken(token: string): Promise<void>;
  clearToken(): Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * In-memory fallback token store for tests and platforms without async storage.
 */
export class MemoryTokenStore implements TokenStore {
  private token: string | null = null;

  constructor(initialToken: string | null = null) {
    this.token = initialToken;
  }

  async getToken(): Promise<string | null> {
    return this.token;
  }

  async setToken(token: string): Promise<void> {
    this.token = token.trim();
  }

  async clearToken(): Promise<void> {
    this.token = null;
  }
}

export type StorageTier =
  | 'custom'
  | 'keychain'
  | 'secure_store'
  | 'async_storage'
  | 'memory';

interface NativeStorageDriver {
  getItem(key: string): Promise<string | null>;
  setItem(key: string, value: string): Promise<void>;
  removeItem(key: string): Promise<void>;
}

/**
 * Resolves the highest security storage driver available on the device platform (P0-08):
 * 1. react-native-keychain (Hardware-backed Keystore / Keychain)
 * 2. expo-secure-store (Hardware-backed encrypted storage)
 * 3. @react-native-async-storage/async-storage (Sandboxed platform database)
 * 4. null (MemoryTokenStore fallback)
 */
function resolveNativeStorageDriver(): {
  driver: NativeStorageDriver | null;
  tier: StorageTier;
} {
  // Tier 1: react-native-keychain
  try {
    const keychain = require('react-native-keychain');
    const mod = keychain.default || keychain;
    if (mod && typeof mod.setGenericPassword === 'function') {
      return {
        tier: 'keychain',
        driver: {
          async getItem(key: string): Promise<string | null> {
            const creds = await mod.getGenericPassword({ service: key });
            return creds ? creds.password : null;
          },
          async setItem(key: string, value: string): Promise<void> {
            await mod.setGenericPassword('auth_token', value, { service: key });
          },
          async removeItem(key: string): Promise<void> {
            await mod.resetGenericPassword({ service: key });
          },
        },
      };
    }
  } catch {
    // Keychain package not installed or native module not linked
  }

  // Tier 2: expo-secure-store
  try {
    const secureStore = require('expo-secure-store');
    const mod = secureStore.default || secureStore;
    if (mod && typeof mod.setItemAsync === 'function') {
      return {
        tier: 'secure_store',
        driver: {
          async getItem(key: string): Promise<string | null> {
            return mod.getItemAsync(key);
          },
          async setItem(key: string, value: string): Promise<void> {
            await mod.setItemAsync(key, value);
          },
          async removeItem(key: string): Promise<void> {
            await mod.deleteItemAsync(key);
          },
        },
      };
    }
  } catch {
    // Expo SecureStore not installed
  }

  // Tier 3: @react-native-async-storage/async-storage
  try {
    const asyncStorage = require('@react-native-async-storage/async-storage');
    const mod = asyncStorage.default || asyncStorage;
    if (mod && typeof mod.getItem === 'function') {
      return {
        tier: 'async_storage',
        driver: {
          async getItem(key: string): Promise<string | null> {
            const val = await mod.getItem(key);
            return typeof val === 'string' && val.length > 0 ? val : null;
          },
          async setItem(key: string, value: string): Promise<void> {
            await mod.setItem(key, value);
          },
          async removeItem(key: string): Promise<void> {
            await mod.removeItem(key);
          },
        },
      };
    }
  } catch {
    // AsyncStorage not installed
  }

  return { driver: null, tier: 'memory' };
}

/**
 * Pluggable token store with hardened multi-tier native persistence (P0-08).
 * Attempts secure native platform storage (Keychain / SecureStore) before AsyncStorage,
 * falling back safely to MemoryTokenStore in Jest and node test environments.
 * Strictly guarantees zero token leakage in logs or diagnostics.
 */
export class PluggableTokenStore implements TokenStore {
  private fallback: TokenStore;
  private customStorage: TokenStore | null = null;

  constructor(fallback: TokenStore = new MemoryTokenStore()) {
    this.fallback = fallback;
  }

  /**
   * Allows injecting a custom storage backend (e.g., in unit tests).
   */
  public setCustomStorage(storage: TokenStore | null): void {
    this.customStorage = storage;
  }

  /**
   * Discovers the current active storage tier for diagnostics without exposing token contents.
   */
  public async getStorageTier(): Promise<StorageTier> {
    if (this.customStorage) {
      return 'custom';
    }
    const resolved = resolveNativeStorageDriver();
    return resolved.tier;
  }

  async getToken(): Promise<string | null> {
    if (this.customStorage) {
      return this.customStorage.getToken();
    }
    try {
      const { driver } = resolveNativeStorageDriver();
      if (driver) {
        return await driver.getItem(AUTH_TOKEN_STORAGE_KEY);
      }
    } catch {
      // Native storage call failed; fall back cleanly to memory store
    }
    return this.fallback.getToken();
  }

  async setToken(token: string): Promise<void> {
    const trimmed = token.trim();
    if (this.customStorage) {
      return this.customStorage.setToken(trimmed);
    }
    try {
      const { driver } = resolveNativeStorageDriver();
      if (driver) {
        await driver.setItem(AUTH_TOKEN_STORAGE_KEY, trimmed);
        return;
      }
    } catch {
      // Native storage write failed; fall back cleanly to memory store
    }
    return this.fallback.setToken(trimmed);
  }

  async clearToken(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.customStorage) {
      return this.customStorage.clearToken();
    }
    try {
      const { driver } = resolveNativeStorageDriver();
      if (driver) {
        await driver.removeItem(AUTH_TOKEN_STORAGE_KEY);
        return;
      }
    } catch {
      // Native storage clear failed; fall back cleanly to memory store
    }
    return this.fallback.clearToken();
  }
}

export const defaultTokenStore = new PluggableTokenStore();

/**
 * @format
 * Cross-cutting Location Provider contract and implementations (P0-07).
 */

import { PermissionsAndroid, Platform } from 'react-native';
import { isMockMode } from '../../app/configuration/dataMode';

export interface LocationFix {
  latitude: number;
  longitude: number;
  accuracyM: number | null;
  capturedAt: string;
  isMocked: boolean;
}

export interface LocationProvider {
  requestPermission(): Promise<'granted' | 'denied' | 'unavailable'>;
  getCurrentPosition(): Promise<LocationFix>;
}

/**
 * Mock location provider used in Mock Mode and unit tests.
 * Never calls native Android/iOS APIs or hardware sensors.
 */
export class MockLocationProvider implements LocationProvider {
  private currentFix: LocationFix;
  private permissionState: 'granted' | 'denied' | 'unavailable' = 'granted';

  constructor(defaultFix?: Partial<LocationFix>) {
    this.currentFix = {
      latitude: defaultFix?.latitude ?? 16.805,
      longitude: defaultFix?.longitude ?? 96.155,
      accuracyM: defaultFix?.accuracyM ?? 15,
      capturedAt: defaultFix?.capturedAt ?? new Date().toISOString(),
      isMocked: defaultFix?.isMocked ?? true,
    };
  }

  public setMockFix(fix: Partial<LocationFix>): void {
    this.currentFix = {
      ...this.currentFix,
      ...fix,
      capturedAt: fix.capturedAt ?? new Date().toISOString(),
    };
  }

  public setPermissionState(state: 'granted' | 'denied' | 'unavailable'): void {
    this.permissionState = state;
  }

  async requestPermission(): Promise<'granted' | 'denied' | 'unavailable'> {
    return this.permissionState;
  }

  async getCurrentPosition(): Promise<LocationFix> {
    if (this.permissionState === 'denied') {
      throw new Error('Location permission denied.');
    }
    if (this.permissionState === 'unavailable') {
      throw new Error('Device location services are unavailable.');
    }
    return {
      ...this.currentFix,
      capturedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
  }
}

/**
 * Native device location provider.
 * Uses PermissionsAndroid on Android + dynamic navigator.geolocation / @react-native-community/geolocation.
 * Fails fast with clear error if permissions are denied or GPS fix is unavailable.
 * NEVER falls back to hardcoded mock coordinates.
 */
export class NativeDeviceLocationProvider implements LocationProvider {
  private customGeolocationModule: any = null;

  /**
   * Allows injecting a custom geolocation module for testing or platform bridges.
   */
  public setCustomGeolocationModule(mod: any): void {
    this.customGeolocationModule = mod;
  }

  async requestPermission(): Promise<'granted' | 'denied' | 'unavailable'> {
    if (Platform.OS === 'android') {
      if (!PermissionsAndroid || typeof PermissionsAndroid.request !== 'function') {
        return 'unavailable';
      }
      try {
        const fineLocation = PermissionsAndroid.PERMISSIONS.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION;
        const coarseLocation = PermissionsAndroid.PERMISSIONS.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION;

        const hasFine = await PermissionsAndroid.check(fineLocation);
        if (hasFine) {
          return 'granted';
        }

        const granted = await PermissionsAndroid.requestMultiple([
          fineLocation,
          coarseLocation,
        ]);

        if (
          granted[fineLocation] === PermissionsAndroid.RESULTS.GRANTED ||
          granted[coarseLocation] === PermissionsAndroid.RESULTS.GRANTED
        ) {
          return 'granted';
        }
        return 'denied';
      } catch {
        return 'unavailable';
      }
    }

    if (Platform.OS === 'ios') {
      const geo = this.resolveGeolocationModule();
      if (geo && typeof geo.requestAuthorization === 'function') {
        try {
          geo.requestAuthorization();
          return 'granted';
        } catch {
          return 'unavailable';
        }
      }
      return 'granted';
    }

    return 'unavailable';
  }

  async getCurrentPosition(): Promise<LocationFix> {
    const permission = await this.requestPermission();
    if (permission === 'denied') {
      throw new Error('Location permission denied. Cannot capture device GPS telemetry.');
    }
    if (permission === 'unavailable') {
      throw new Error('Device location services are unavailable.');
    }

    const geo = this.resolveGeolocationModule();
    if (!geo || typeof geo.getCurrentPosition !== 'function') {
      throw new Error('No device geolocation service is available.');
    }

    return new Promise<LocationFix>((resolve, reject) => {
      geo.getCurrentPosition(
        (position: any) => {
          if (!position || !position.coords) {
            reject(new Error('Invalid GPS fix received from device.'));
            return;
          }
          resolve({
            latitude: position.coords.latitude,
            longitude: position.coords.longitude,
            accuracyM: position.coords.accuracy ?? null,
            capturedAt: new Date(position.timestamp || Date.now()).toISOString(),
            isMocked: Boolean(position.mocked),
          });
        },
        (error: any) => {
          const message = error?.message || 'Failed to capture GPS fix.';
          reject(new Error(`Device GPS fix failed: ${message}`));
        },
        {
          enableHighAccuracy: true,
          timeout: 15000,
          maximumAge: 10000,
        },
      );
    });
  }

  private resolveGeolocationModule(): any {
    if (this.customGeolocationModule) {
      return this.customGeolocationModule;
    }
    try {
      const communityGeo = require('@react-native-community/geolocation');
      return communityGeo.default || communityGeo;
    } catch {
      try {
        const g = typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' ? (globalThis as any) : null;
        if (g && g.navigator && g.navigator.geolocation) {
          return g.navigator.geolocation;
        }
      } catch {
        // Fallthrough
      }
      return null;
    }
  }
}

export const defaultMockLocationProvider = new MockLocationProvider();
export const defaultNativeLocationProvider = new NativeDeviceLocationProvider();

/**
 * Default location provider that branches based on global dataMode:
 * - In Mock Mode: uses defaultMockLocationProvider (returns Yangon demo coordinates)
 * - In HTTP Mode: uses defaultNativeLocationProvider (queries hardware sensors; fails fast if denied)
 */
export const defaultLocationProvider: LocationProvider = {
  async requestPermission(): Promise<'granted' | 'denied' | 'unavailable'> {
    if (isMockMode()) {
      return defaultMockLocationProvider.requestPermission();
    }
    return defaultNativeLocationProvider.requestPermission();
  },
  async getCurrentPosition(): Promise<LocationFix> {
    if (isMockMode()) {
      return defaultMockLocationProvider.getCurrentPosition();
    }
    return defaultNativeLocationProvider.getCurrentPosition();
  },
};

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    const geoResult = await eventRepo.submitGeoCheckIn!('101', 37.7749, -122.4194, 5);
    expect(geoResult.success).toBe(true);

    expect(serverAttendance.length).toBe(1);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 10: Coordinator Confirms Geo Attendance
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    const attendanceRoster = await coordinatorRepo.getAttendanceRoster('101');
    expect(attendanceRoster.length).toBe(1);
    expect(attendanceRoster[0].id).toBe('701');
    expect(attendanceRoster[0].volunteerName).toBe('Alex Johnson');

    const confirmAttResult = await coordinatorRepo.confirmGeoAttendance('701');
    expect(confirmAttResult.success).toBe(true);

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 11: Volunteer Completes Shift Checkout (Constraint 1)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    const checkoutResult = await eventRepo.checkOutAttendance!('701');
    expect(checkoutResult.success).toBe(true);
    expect(serverAttendance[0].attendance_status).toBe('completed');

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 12: Volunteer Submits Event Feedback

    const feedbackResult = await eventRepo.submitEventFeedback!(

      ['organized', 'supportive_team'],

    expect(feedbackResult.success).toBe(true);
    expect(feedbackReceived.score).toBe(5);
    expect(feedbackReceived.comment).toBe('Excellent coordination, loved restoring the dunes!');

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // Step 13: Logout & Screen Cache Clearing (Constraint 2)
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    const logoutRes = await authApi.logout(mockClient);
    expect(logoutRes.ok).toBe(true);
    await sessionMgr.logout();
    expect(await tokenStore.getToken()).toBeNull();

    // Verify cache resets
    resetDiscoveryCache();
    resetApplicationsCache();
    resetAssignmentsCache();

    const discoveryCache = getDiscoveryCache();
    expect(discoveryCache.searchQuery).toBe('');
    expect(discoveryCache.scrollOffset).toBe(0);

    const appsCache = getApplicationsCache();
    expect(appsCache.statusFilter).toBe('all');
    expect(appsCache.scrollOffset).toBe(0);

    const assignCache = getAssignmentsCache();
    expect(assignCache.statusFilter).toBe('all');
    expect(assignCache.scrollOffset).toBe(0);
  });

/**
 * @format
 */

import type {
  CoordinatorApplicationItem,
  CoordinatorApplicationStatus,
  CoordinatorAssignmentItem,
  CoordinatorAttendanceItem,
  CoordinatorEventDetail,
  CoordinatorEventStatus,
  CoordinatorEventSummary,
  CoordinatorOverviewMetrics,
  CreateEventWizardDraft,
} from '../../domain/models/coordinator';
import type { EventPost } from '../../domain/models/event';
import type {
  CoordinatorHistoryItemDto,
  EventPostCapacityDto,
} from '../dto/coordinatorDto';
import type { GeoAttemptReviewDto } from '../dto/checkinDto';
import type { UserUuidLookupDto } from '../dto/profileDto';

export interface CoordinatorOperationResult<T = void> {
  success: boolean;
  message: string;
  data?: T;
}

export interface CoordinatorRepository {
  /**
   * Fetches high-level metrics for the coordinator dashboard.
   */
  getOverviewMetrics(): Promise<CoordinatorOverviewMetrics>;

  /**
   * Fetches the list of events owned or coordinated by the user.
   */
  getMyEvents(): Promise<CoordinatorEventSummary[]>;

  /**
   * Fetches full coordinator details for an event by ID.
   */
  getEventDetail(eventId: string): Promise<CoordinatorEventDetail | null>;

  /**
   * Creates a new draft event using the validated wizard data.
   * Enforces that status is 'draft', version is 1, and owner is the coordinator.
   */
  createDraftEvent(
    draft: CreateEventWizardDraft,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>>;

  /**
   * Updates an existing event details/onboarding text (C-06, C-07).
   */
  updateEvent(
    eventId: string,
    data: Partial<CreateEventWizardDraft>,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>>;

  /**
   * Transitions an event to a valid target status.
   * Rejects writes if the event is in owner-as-monitor mode.
   */
  transitionEventStatus(
    eventId: string,
    targetStatus: CoordinatorEventStatus,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>>;

  /**
   * Creates a new post for an event (C-08).
   */
  createEventPost(
    eventId: string,
    post: {
      title: string;
      requiredHeadcount: number;
      physicalLevel?: string;
      requiredSkills?: string[];
      leaderNeeded?: boolean;
      newVolunteersAllowed?: boolean;
    },
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<EventPost>>;

  /**
   * Updates an event post headcount, requirements, or status (C-09).
   */
  updateEventPost(
    postId: string,
    updates: {
      requiredHeadcount?: number;
      status?: string;
      physicalLevel?: string;
      requiredSkills?: string[];
    },
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<EventPost>>;

  /**
   * Closes an event post to stop accepting new applications (C-10).
   */
  closeEventPost(postId: string): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<void>>;

  /**
   * Hands over event coordination to another approved coordinator (C-15).
   */
  handoverEvent(

  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }>;

/**

import { ApiClient, defaultApiClient } from '../../core/api/apiClient';
import type { ApiResult } from '../../core/api/apiResult';
import type { ResultsListDto } from '../dto/commonDto';
import type {
  CheckoutResponseDto,
  EventFeedbackItemDto,
  FeedbackSubmitRequestDto,
  FeedbackSubmitResponseDto,
  GeoAttemptReviewDto,
  GeoCheckinRequestDto,
  GeoCheckinResponseDto,
  ManualCheckinRequestDto,
  ManualCheckinResponseDto,
  OnboardingAcknowledgeRequestDto,
  OnboardingAcknowledgeResponseDto,
  OnboardingStatusDto,
  QrRedeemResponseDto,
  QrResolveResponseDto,
  QrTokenCreateRequestDto,
  QrTokenDto,
} from '../dto/checkinDto';

export const checkinApi = {
  /**
   * Fetches the onboarding briefing status for an event (V-31).
   * Authenticated endpoint. Canonical route: checkin/events/${eventId}/onboarding/
   */
  getOnboarding(
    eventId: number | string,
    client: ApiClient = defaultApiClient,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<OnboardingStatusDto>> {
    return client.get<OnboardingStatusDto>(`checkin/events/${eventId}/onboarding/`);
  },

  /**
   * Acknowledges the onboarding briefing for an event (V-32).
   * Authenticated endpoint. Canonical route: checkin/events/${eventId}/onboarding/acknowledge/
   */
  acknowledgeOnboarding(
    eventId: number | string,
    data: OnboardingAcknowledgeRequestDto = {},
    client: ApiClient = defaultApiClient,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<OnboardingAcknowledgeResponseDto>> {
    return client.post<OnboardingAcknowledgeResponseDto>(
      `checkin/events/${eventId}/onboarding/acknowledge/`,
      data,
    );
  },

  /**
   * Previews / resolves a QR token without consuming it (V-33).
   * Public endpoint. Canonical route: checkin/qr/resolve/
   */
  resolveQrToken(
    token: string,
    client: ApiClient = defaultApiClient,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<QrResolveResponseDto>> {
    return client.post<QrResolveResponseDto>(
      'checkin/qr/resolve/',
      { token },
      { authRequired: false },
    );
  },

  /**
   * Redeems a QR token (walkin, checkin, join_event) (V-34).
   * Authenticated endpoint. Canonical route: checkin/qr/redeem/
   */
  redeemQrToken(
    token: string,
    client: ApiClient = defaultApiClient,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<QrRedeemResponseDto>> {
    return client.post<QrRedeemResponseDto>('checkin/qr/redeem/', { token });
  },

  /**
   * Performs check-in-only QR token redemption (V-35).
   * Authenticated endpoint. Canonical route: checkin/attendance/qr-checkin/
   */
  qrCheckIn(
    token: string,
    client: ApiClient = defaultApiClient,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<QrRedeemResponseDto>> {
    return client.post<QrRedeemResponseDto>('checkin/attendance/qr-checkin/', {
      token,
    });
  },

  /**
   * Creates a new QR token for an event (coordinator action, C-30).
   * Authenticated endpoint. Canonical route: checkin/coordinator/events/${eventId}/qr-tokens/
   */
  createCoordinatorQrToken(
    eventId: number | string,
    data: QrTokenCreateRequestDto,
    client: ApiClient = defaultApiClient,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<QrTokenDto>> {
    return client.post<QrTokenDto>(
      `checkin/coordinator/events/${eventId}/qr-tokens/`,
      data,
    );
  },

  /**
   * Revokes an existing coordinator QR token (coordinator action, C-31).
   * Authenticated endpoint. Canonical route: checkin/coordinator/qr-tokens/${qrId}/revoke/
   */
  revokeCoordinatorQrToken(
    qrId: number | string,
    client: ApiClient = defaultApiClient,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<{ id: number; revoked_at: string }>> {
    return client.post<{ id: number; revoked_at: string }>(
      `checkin/coordinator/qr-tokens/${qrId}/revoke/`,
      {},
    );
  },

  /**
   * Submits volunteer geo check-in telemetry for an event (V-36).
   * Authenticated endpoint. Canonical route: checkin/attendance/geo-checkin/
   */
  submitGeoCheckIn(
    data: GeoCheckinRequestDto,
    client: ApiClient = defaultApiClient,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<GeoCheckinResponseDto>> {
    return client.post<GeoCheckinResponseDto>('checkin/attendance/geo-checkin/', data);
  },

  /**
   * Checks out of an active attendance shift (V-37).
   * Authenticated endpoint. Canonical route: checkin/attendance/${attendanceId}/checkout/
   */
  checkoutAttendance(
    attendanceId: number | string,
    client: ApiClient = defaultApiClient,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<CheckoutResponseDto>> {
    return client.post<CheckoutResponseDto>(
      `checkin/attendance/${attendanceId}/checkout/`,
      {},
    );
  },

  /**
   * Performs manual on-site check-in (coordinator action, C-34).
   * Authenticated endpoint. Canonical route: checkin/attendance/manual-checkin/
   */
  manualCheckIn(
    data: ManualCheckinRequestDto,
    client: ApiClient = defaultApiClient,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<ManualCheckinResponseDto>> {
    return client.post<ManualCheckinResponseDto>(
      'checkin/attendance/manual-checkin/',
      data,
    );
  },

  /**
   * Submits event feedback (V-40).
   * Authenticated endpoint. Canonical route: checkin/events/${eventId}/feedback/
   */
  submitEventFeedback(
    eventId: number | string,
    data: FeedbackSubmitRequestDto,
    client: ApiClient = defaultApiClient,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<FeedbackSubmitResponseDto>> {
    return client.post<FeedbackSubmitResponseDto>(
      `checkin/events/${eventId}/feedback/`,
      data,
    );
  },

  /**
   * Fetches geo check-in attempts for review matching v_geo_attempts_review (C-35).
   * Authenticated endpoint. Canonical route: checkin/coordinator/events/${eventId}/geo-attempts/
   */
  getGeoAttempts(
    eventId: number | string,
    client: ApiClient = defaultApiClient,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<ResultsListDto<GeoAttemptReviewDto>>> {
    return client.get<ResultsListDto<GeoAttemptReviewDto>>(
      `checkin/coordinator/events/${eventId}/geo-attempts/`,
    );

    client: ApiClient = defaultApiClient,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<CoordinatorProfileEnvelopeDto>> {
    return client.patch<CoordinatorProfileEnvelopeDto>('me/coordinator/', {
      notes,
    });
  },

  /**
   * Looks up user by public UUID (V-18 / C-29).
   * Optionally takes event_id to reveal T2 profile hints when caller is event coordinator.
   * Authenticated endpoint.
   */
  lookupUserByUuid(
    uuid: string,
    eventId?: number | string,
    client: ApiClient = defaultApiClient,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<UserUuidLookupDto>> {
    return client.get<UserUuidLookupDto>(
      `users/by-uuid/${uuid}/`,
      eventId !== undefined ? { params: { event_id: eventId } } : undefined,
    );
  },

  /**
   * Fetches user's attendance history records (V-38).
   * Canonical route: checkin/me/attendance/
   * Authenticated endpoint.
   */
  getAttendanceHistory(
    client: ApiClient = defaultApiClient,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<ResultsListDto<AttendanceHistoryItemDto>>> {
    return client.get<ResultsListDto<AttendanceHistoryItemDto>>('checkin/me/attendance/');
  },

  /**
   * Fetches feedback summary and ratings (V-41 & V-42).
   * Canonical route: checkin/me/feedback/
   * Authenticated endpoint.
   */
  getFeedbackSummary(
    client: ApiClient = defaultApiClient,
  ): Promise<ApiResult<FeedbackSummaryResponseDto>> {
    return client.get<FeedbackSummaryResponseDto>('checkin/me/feedback/');
  },
};

  private inFlightMyEventsPromise: Promise<CoordinatorEventSummary[]> | null =
    null;

    id: 'usr-coord',
    displayName: 'Coordinator',

  };

  constructor(client: ApiClient = defaultApiClient) {
    this.client = client;
  }

  public setCoordinatorIdentity(identity: {
    id: string;
    displayName: string;
    email?: string;
  }): void {
    this.coordinatorIdentity = {
      id: identity.id,
      displayName: identity.displayName,

  public getCoordinatorIdentity(): {
    id: string;
    displayName: string;
    email: string;

  public async getMyEvents(): Promise<CoordinatorEventSummary[]> {
    if (this.inFlightMyEventsPromise) {
      return this.inFlightMyEventsPromise;
    }

    this.inFlightMyEventsPromise = (async () => {
      try {
        const res = await coordinatorApi.getMyEvents(this.client);
        if (!res.ok) {
          throw new Error(`Failed to load events: ${res.error.message}`);
        }

        const list: CoordinatorEventListItemDto[] = res.data.results || [];
        const summaries = await Promise.all(
          list.map(e =>
            coordinatorApi.getEventSummary(e.id, this.client).catch(() => null),
          ),
        );

        return list.map((e, idx) => {
          const summaryRes = summaries[idx];
          const summaryDto =
            summaryRes && summaryRes.ok ? summaryRes.data : null;
          return mapCoordinatorEventSummary(e, summaryDto);
        });
      } finally {
        this.inFlightMyEventsPromise = null;
      }
    })();

    return this.inFlightMyEventsPromise;
  }

  public async getOverviewMetrics(): Promise<CoordinatorOverviewMetrics> {
    const events = await this.getMyEvents();
    const totalEventsCount = events.length;
    const activeEventsCount = events.filter(
      e => e.status === 'active' || e.status === 'published',
    ).length;
    const draftEventsCount = events.filter(e => e.status === 'draft').length;

    let pendingApplicationsCount = 0;
    let acceptedApplicantsCount = 0;
    let checkedInTodayCount = 0;

    for (const e of events) {
      pendingApplicationsCount += e.pendingApplicationCount || 0;
      acceptedApplicantsCount += e.acceptedApplicantCount || 0;
      checkedInTodayCount += e.checkedInCount || 0;
    }

    return {
      totalEventsCount,
      activeEventsCount,
      draftEventsCount,
      pendingApplicationsCount,
      acceptedApplicantsCount,
      checkedInTodayCount,
    };
  }

  public async getEventDetail(
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorEventDetail | null> {
    const [summaryRes, postsRes, eventsRes, publicDetailRes] = await Promise.all([
      coordinatorApi.getEventSummary(eventId, this.client),
      coordinatorApi.getEventPosts(eventId, this.client).catch(() => null),
      coordinatorApi.getMyEvents(this.client).catch(() => null),
      eventApi.getEventDetail(eventId, this.client).catch(() => null),
    ]);

    if (!summaryRes.ok) {
      if (summaryRes.status === 404) {
        return null;
      }
      throw new Error(`Failed to load event detail: ${summaryRes.error.message}`);
    }

    const summary = summaryRes.data;
    const events: CoordinatorEventListItemDto[] =
      eventsRes && eventsRes.ok && eventsRes.data?.results ? eventsRes.data.results : [];
    const currentEventItem = events.find(e => String(e.id) === String(eventId));

    const publicDetail =
      publicDetailRes && publicDetailRes.ok ? publicDetailRes.data : null;

    let rawPosts: PublicEventPostDto[] = [];
    if (publicDetail?.posts && Array.isArray(publicDetail.posts) && publicDetail.posts.length > 0) {
      rawPosts = publicDetail.posts;
    } else if (postsRes && postsRes.ok) {
      rawPosts = Array.isArray(postsRes.data)
        ? postsRes.data
        : postsRes.data?.results || [];
    }

    const isMonitor = currentEventItem?.is_read_only_monitor ?? false;

    return {
      id: String(summary.id),
      title: publicDetail?.title || summary.title,
      description: publicDetail?.description || '',
      status:
        (publicDetail?.status as CoordinatorEventStatus) ||
        (summary.status as CoordinatorEventStatus) ||
        'draft',
      purposeType:
        (publicDetail?.purpose_type as EventPurposeType) || 'charity_event',
      startAt: publicDetail?.start_at || summary.start_at,
      endAt: publicDetail?.end_at || summary.end_at,
      applicationDeadline: publicDetail?.application_deadline ?? undefined,
      locationName: publicDetail?.location_name || 'Designated Location',
      landmarkText: publicDetail?.landmark_text ?? undefined,
      charityFields: (publicDetail?.charity_fields as any[]) || [],
      ownerId: currentEventItem ? String(currentEventItem.owner_id) : this.coordinatorIdentity.id,
      currentCoordinatorId: currentEventItem ? String(currentEventItem.current_coordinator_id) : this.coordinatorIdentity.id,
      coordinatorName: publicDetail?.coordinator_name || this.coordinatorIdentity.displayName,
      isOwnerAsMonitor: isMonitor,
      pendingApplicationCount: summary.pending_count || 0,
      acceptedApplicantCount: summary.accepted_count || 0,
      assignedCount: summary.assignment_count || 0,
      checkedInCount: summary.checked_in_count || 0,
      latitude: typeof publicDetail?.latitude === 'number'
        ? publicDetail.latitude
        : parseFloat(String(publicDetail?.latitude || 0)) || 0,
      longitude: typeof publicDetail?.longitude === 'number'
        ? publicDetail.longitude
        : parseFloat(String(publicDetail?.longitude || 0)) || 0,
      geoRadiusM: publicDetail?.geo_radius_m ?? 200,
      geoCheckinEnabled: publicDetail?.geo_checkin_enabled ?? summary.geo_checkin_enabled ?? true,
      geoCheckinOpensBeforeMin: 30,
      requireCheckinConfirmation: summary.pending_confirmations > 0,
      mapProvider: publicDetail?.map_provider || summary.map_provider || 'openstreetmap',
      acceptanceMode: (publicDetail?.acceptance_mode as any) || (summary.acceptance_mode as any) || 'manual',
      autoAssignEnabled: summary.auto_assign_enabled ?? false,
      leaderStrategy: 'none',
      maxParticipants: publicDetail?.max_participants ?? summary.max_participants ?? 0,
      mealsProvided: Boolean(publicDetail?.meals_provided),
      lodgingProvided: Boolean(publicDetail?.lodging_provided),
      travelSupportProvided: Boolean(publicDetail?.travel_support_provided),
      compensationKind: (publicDetail?.compensation_kind as any) || 'unpaid',
      compensationNote: publicDetail?.compensation_note ?? undefined,
      onboardingText: publicDetail?.onboarding_text ?? undefined,
      onboardingVersion: publicDetail?.onboarding_version ?? 1,
      requireOnboardingAck: false,
      qrRegistrationEnabled: false,
      posts: rawPosts.map(p => mapPublicEventPost(p, summary.id)),
    };
  }

  public async createDraftEvent(

  public async transitionEventStatus(
    eventId: string,
    targetStatus: CoordinatorEventStatus,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>> {
    let res;
    if (targetStatus === 'published') {
      res = await coordinatorApi.publishEvent(eventId, this.client);
    } else if (targetStatus === 'active') {
      res = await coordinatorApi.activateEvent(eventId, this.client);
    } else if (targetStatus === 'completed') {
      res = await coordinatorApi.completeEvent(eventId, this.client);
    } else if (targetStatus === 'cancelled') {
      res = await coordinatorApi.cancelEvent(
        eventId,
        'Cancelled by coordinator',
        this.client,
      );
    } else {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: `Unsupported event status transition to '${targetStatus}'.`,
      };
    }

    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    const updated = await this.getEventDetail(eventId);
    return {
      success: true,
      message: `Event transitioned to ${targetStatus}`,
      data: updated ?? undefined,
    };
  }

  public async getApplications(
    eventId?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorApplicationItem[]> {
    if (eventId) {
      const res = await coordinatorApi.getApplications(
        eventId,
        undefined,
        this.client,
      );
      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error(`Failed to load applications: ${res.error.message}`);
      }
      const list: CoordinatorApplicationDto[] = res.data.results || [];
      const items = list.map(a => {
        const mapped = mapCoordinatorApplication(a, eventId);
        this.appToEventMap.set(mapped.id, String(eventId));
        this.applicationCache.set(mapped.id, mapped);
        return mapped;
      });
      return items;
    }

    // If no eventId, aggregate over coordinator's events
    const events = await this.getMyEvents();
    const appLists = await Promise.all(
      events.map(e => this.getApplications(e.id).catch(() => [])),
    );
    return appLists.flat();
  }

  public async updateApplicationStatus(
    applicationId: string,
    status: CoordinatorApplicationStatus,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorApplicationItem>> {
    const action =
      status === 'accepted'
        ? 'accept'
        : status === 'rejected'
        ? 'reject'
        : 'waitlist';

    const res = await coordinatorApi.decideApplication(
      applicationId,
      action,
      {},
      this.client,
    );

    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    // P0-02: Merge updated status into cached application item or refetch from event
    let updatedItem = this.applicationCache.get(applicationId);
    if (updatedItem) {
      updatedItem = {
        ...updatedItem,
        status,
      };
      this.applicationCache.set(applicationId, updatedItem);
    } else {
      const eventId = this.appToEventMap.get(applicationId);
      if (eventId) {
        const apps = await this.getApplications(eventId);
        updatedItem = apps.find(a => a.id === applicationId);
      }
    }

    if (!updatedItem) {
      updatedItem = {
        id: applicationId,
        eventId: this.appToEventMap.get(applicationId) || '',
        eventTitle: 'Volunteer Event',
        userId: '88',
        applicantName: 'Volunteer Applicant',
        status,
        source: 'browse',
        appliedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: `Application ${status} successfully`,
      data: updatedItem,
    };
  }

  public async inviteVolunteer(
    eventId: string,
    volunteerUserId: string | number,
    postId?: string | number,
    note?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorApplicationItem>> {

  public async runAutoAssignment(
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAssignmentItem[]>> {

  public async assignVolunteerManually(
    applicationId: string,
    postId: string,
    groupCode?: string,
    isGroupLeader?: boolean,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAssignmentItem>> {
    let eventId = this.appToEventMap.get(applicationId);
    if (!eventId) {
      const events = await this.getMyEvents();
      if (events.length > 0) {
        eventId = events[0].id;
      } else {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: 'Unable to determine event for volunteer assignment.',
        };
      }
    }

    const numericPostId =
      !postId || !postId.trim() || isNaN(Number(postId)) || Number(postId) <= 0
        ? null
        : Number(postId);
    const res = await coordinatorApi.manualAssign(
      eventId,
      {
        application_id: Number(applicationId),
        post_id: numericPostId,
        group_code: groupCode ?? null,
        is_group_leader: isGroupLeader ?? false,
      },
      this.client,
    );

    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    // P0-03: Call this.getAssignments(eventId) and return newly created CoordinatorAssignmentItem
    const assignments = await this.getAssignments(eventId);
    const created = assignments.find(
      a =>
        a.id === String(res.data.assignment_id) ||
        a.applicationId === applicationId,
    );

    if (created) {
      return {
        success: true,
        message: 'Volunteer assigned successfully',
        data: created,
      };
    }

    const fallbackItem: CoordinatorAssignmentItem = {
      id: String(res.data.assignment_id),
      eventId,
      eventTitle: 'Coordinator Event',
      applicationId,
      userId: '',
      volunteerName: 'Assigned Volunteer',
      postId,
      postTitle: 'Assigned Post',
      groupCode: groupCode ?? undefined,
      isGroupLeader: isGroupLeader ?? false,
      status: 'assigned',
      assignedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Volunteer assigned successfully',
      data: fallbackItem,
    };
  }

  public async cancelAssignment(
    assignmentId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAssignmentItem>> {
    const res = await eventApi.cancelAssignment(
      assignmentId,
      'Cancelled by coordinator',

    );
    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Assignment cancelled successfully',
    };
  }

  public async getAttendanceRoster(
    eventId?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorAttendanceItem[]> {
    if (eventId) {
      const res = await coordinatorApi.getAttendanceRoster(
        eventId,
        this.client,
      );
      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          `Failed to load attendance roster: ${res.error.message}`,
        );
      }
      const list: AttendanceRosterDto[] = res.data.results || [];
      const items = list.map(item => {
        const mapped = mapAttendanceRosterItem(item, eventId);
        this.attendanceCache.set(mapped.id, mapped);
        this.attendanceCache.set(mapped.assignmentId, mapped);
        return mapped;
      });
      return items;
    }

    const events = await this.getMyEvents();
    const lists = await Promise.all(
      events.map(e => this.getAttendanceRoster(e.id).catch(() => [])),
    );
    return lists.flat();
  }

  public async getPendingGeoConfirmations(
    eventId?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorAttendanceItem[]> {
    if (eventId) {
      const res = await coordinatorApi.getPendingGeoConfirmations(
        eventId,
        this.client,
      );
      if (!res.ok) {
        throw new Error(
          `Failed to load pending geo confirmations: ${res.error.message}`,
        );
      }
      const list: AttendanceRosterDto[] = res.data.results || [];
      const items = list.map(item => {
        const mapped = mapAttendanceRosterItem(item, eventId);
        this.attendanceCache.set(mapped.id, mapped);
        this.attendanceCache.set(mapped.assignmentId, mapped);
        return mapped;
      });
      return items;
    }

    const events = await this.getMyEvents();
    const lists = await Promise.all(
      events.map(e => this.getPendingGeoConfirmations(e.id).catch(() => [])),
    );
    return lists.flat();
  }

  public async confirmGeoAttendance(
    attendanceId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>> {
    const res = await coordinatorApi.confirmAttendance(
      attendanceId,
      'Confirmed by coordinator',
      this.client,
    );
    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    const cached = this.attendanceCache.get(attendanceId);
    if (cached) {
      cached.isPendingGeoConfirmation = false;
      cached.status = 'checked_in';
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Geo attendance confirmed',
      data: cached,
    };
  }

  public async rejectGeoAttendance(
    attendanceId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>> {
    const res = await coordinatorApi.rejectAttendance(
      attendanceId,
      'Rejected by coordinator',
      this.client,
    );
    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    const cached = this.attendanceCache.get(attendanceId);
    if (cached) {
      cached.isPendingGeoConfirmation = false;
      cached.status = 'scheduled';
      if (cached.geoAttempt) {
        cached.geoAttempt.confirmationStatus = 'rejected';
      }
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Geo attendance rejected',
      data: cached,
    };
  }

  public async manualCheckIn(
    attendanceId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>> {
    let record = this.attendanceCache.get(attendanceId);
    if (!record) {
      for (const item of this.attendanceCache.values()) {
        if (item.id === attendanceId || item.assignmentId === attendanceId) {
          record = item;
          break;
        }
      }
    }

    if (!record) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Attendance record not found in active roster cache.',
      };
    }

    const res = await coordinatorApi.manualCheckIn(
      {
        event_id: Number(record.eventId),
        user_id: Number(record.userId),
        note: 'Manual on-site check-in',
      },
      this.client,
    );

    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    record.status = 'checked_in';
    record.checkInMethod = 'manual';
    record.checkedInAt = new Date().toISOString();
    record.isPendingGeoConfirmation = false;

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Volunteer checked in manually',
      data: record,
    };
  }

  public async createQrToken(
    eventId: string,
    purpose: 'walkin_registration' | 'checkin' | 'join_event',
    maxUses?: number | null,
    ttlMinutes: number = 240,
  ): Promise<
    CoordinatorOperationResult<{
      id: number;
      rawToken: string;
      expiresAt: string;
    }>
  > {
    const res = await checkinApi.createCoordinatorQrToken(
      eventId,
      {
        purpose,
        max_uses: maxUses,
        ttl_minutes: ttlMinutes,
      },
      this.client,
    );

    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'QR token generated successfully',
      data: {
        id: res.data.id,
        rawToken: res.data.raw_token,
        expiresAt: res.data.expires_at,
      },
    };
  }

  public async revokeQrToken(
    qrId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult> {
    const res = await checkinApi.revokeCoordinatorQrToken(qrId, this.client);
    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'QR token revoked successfully',
    };
  }

  public async getPostCapacity(
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<EventPostCapacityDto[]> {
    const res = await coordinatorApi.getPostCapacity(eventId, this.client);
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to load post capacity: ${res.error.message}`);
    }
    return res.data.results || [];
  }

  public async lookupVolunteerByUuid(
    uuid: string,
    eventId?: string,
  ): Promise<UserUuidLookupDto> {
    const res = await profileApi.lookupUserByUuid(uuid, eventId, this.client);
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to lookup volunteer by UUID: ${res.error.message}`);
    }
    return res.data;
  }

  public async getGeoAttempts(
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<GeoAttemptReviewDto[]> {
    const res = await checkinApi.getGeoAttempts(eventId, this.client);
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to load geo attempts: ${res.error.message}`);
    }
    return res.data.results || [];
  }

  public async submitCoordinatorFeedback(
    eventId: string,
    volunteerUserId: string | number,
    score: number,
    comment?: string,
    tags?: string[],
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult> {
    const res = await checkinApi.submitEventFeedback(
      eventId,
      {
        direction: 'coordinator_to_volunteer',
        target_user_id: Number(volunteerUserId),
        score,
        comment: comment || '',
        tags: tags || [],
      },
      this.client,
    );
    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }
    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Coordinator feedback submitted successfully',
    };
  }
}

  public async getEvents(filters?: EventFilters): Promise<EventSummary[]> {
    const params: EventQueryParams = {};

    if (filters) {
      if (filters.query && filters.query.trim().length > 0) {
        params.search = filters.query.trim();
      }
      if (filters.charityFieldCodes && filters.charityFieldCodes.length > 0) {
        params.charity_field = filters.charityFieldCodes.join(',');
      }
      if (filters.statuses && filters.statuses.length === 1) {
        params.status = filters.statuses[0];
      }
      if (filters.mealsProvided === true) {
        params.meals_provided = 'true';
      }
      if (filters.lodgingProvided === true) {
        params.lodging_provided = 'true';
      }
      if (filters.travelSupportProvided === true) {
        params.travel_support_provided = 'true';
      }
      if (filters.startAfter) {
        params.starts_after = filters.startAfter;
      }
      if (filters.endBefore) {
        params.starts_before = filters.endBefore;
      }
    }

    const res = await eventApi.getEvents(params, this.client);
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to load events: ${res.error.message}`);
    }

    const events: PublicEventDto[] = Array.isArray(res.data)
      ? res.data
      : 'results' in res.data
      ? res.data.results
      : [];

    return events.map(mapPublicEventSummary);
  }

  public async getEventsPage(
    filters?: EventFilters,
    page: number = 1,
    pageSize: number = 20,
  ): Promise<PaginatedEventsResult> {
    const params: EventQueryParams = {
      page,
      page_size: pageSize,
    };

    if (filters) {
      if (filters.query && filters.query.trim().length > 0) {
        params.search = filters.query.trim();
      }
      if (filters.charityFieldCodes && filters.charityFieldCodes.length > 0) {
        params.charity_field = filters.charityFieldCodes.join(',');
      }
      if (filters.statuses && filters.statuses.length === 1) {
        params.status = filters.statuses[0];
      }
      if (filters.mealsProvided === true) {
        params.meals_provided = 'true';
      }
      if (filters.lodgingProvided === true) {
        params.lodging_provided = 'true';
      }
      if (filters.travelSupportProvided === true) {
        params.travel_support_provided = 'true';
      }
      if (filters.startAfter) {
        params.starts_after = filters.startAfter;
      }
      if (filters.endBefore) {
        params.starts_before = filters.endBefore;
      }
    }

    const res = await eventApi.getEvents(params, this.client);
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to load paginated events: ${res.error.message}`);
    }

    const count =
      'count' in res.data && typeof res.data.count === 'number'
        ? res.data.count
        : Array.isArray(res.data)
        ? res.data.length
        : 0;
    const next = 'next' in res.data ? res.data.next : null;
    const previous = 'previous' in res.data ? res.data.previous : null;
    const events: PublicEventDto[] = Array.isArray(res.data)
      ? res.data
      : 'results' in res.data
      ? res.data.results
      : [];

    return {
      count,
      next,
      previous,
      results: events.map(mapPublicEventSummary),
    };
  }

  public async getEventById(id: string): Promise<EventDetail | null> {
    const hasToken = await this.client.hasValidToken();

    const [eventRes, postsRes, appsRes] = await Promise.all([
      eventApi.getEventDetail(id, this.client),
      eventApi.getEventPosts(id, this.client),
      hasToken
        ? eventApi.getMyApplications({ event_id: id }, this.client)
        : Promise.resolve({
            ok: true as const,
            status: 200,
            data: { results: [] as VolunteerApplicationDto[] },
          }),
    ]);

    if (!eventRes.ok) {
      if (eventRes.status === 404) {
        return null;
      }
      throw new Error(`Failed to load event: ${eventRes.error.message}`);
    }

    let posts: PublicEventPostDto[] = [];
    if (postsRes.ok) {
      posts = Array.isArray(postsRes.data)
        ? postsRes.data
        : 'results' in postsRes.data
        ? postsRes.data.results
        : [];
    } else if (eventRes.data.posts && eventRes.data.posts.length > 0) {
      posts = eventRes.data.posts;
    }

    if (posts.length > 0) {
      eventRes.data.posts = posts;
    }

    let userAppDto: VolunteerApplicationDto | null = null;
    if (appsRes.ok) {
      const apps: VolunteerApplicationDto[] = Array.isArray(appsRes.data)
        ? appsRes.data
        : 'results' in appsRes.data
        ? appsRes.data.results
        : [];

      userAppDto = apps.find(a => String(a.event_id) === String(id)) ?? null;
    }

    return mapPublicEventDetail(eventRes.data, userAppDto);
  }

  public async applyToPost(

      postTitle: app.post_title || 'Applied Role',
      status: (app.status as EventApplicationStatus) || 'pending',
      appliedAt: app.applied_at || new Date().toISOString(),
      volunteerNote: app.note ?? note,
    };

      success: true,
      message: 'Application submitted successfully',
      application: applicationState,
    };
