      {
        event_id: Number(eventId),
        latitude,
        longitude,
        accuracy_m: accuracyM ?? null,

      this.client,
    );

    if (res.ok) {
      return {
        success: res.data.success ?? true,
        message: res.data.message || 'Geo check-in verified successfully.',
        result: res.data.result,
        distanceM: res.data.distance_m ?? undefined,
        confirmationStatus: res.data.confirmation_status ?? undefined,
        attendanceId: res.data.attendance_id
          ? String(res.data.attendance_id)
          : undefined,
      };
    }

    const error = res.error;
    const distanceM =
      error.kind === 'validation' &&
      error.meta &&
      typeof error.meta.distance_m === 'number'
        ? error.meta.distance_m
        : undefined;

    return {
      success: false,
      message: error.message,
      result: 'code' in error ? error.code : undefined,
      distanceM,

  public async getProfile(): Promise<VolunteerProfile> {
    const [profRes, coordRes, feedbackRes, interestsRes] = await Promise.all([
      profileApi.getProfile(this.client),
      profileApi.getCoordinatorProfile(this.client),
      profileApi.getFeedbackSummary(this.client),
      profileApi.getCharityInterests(this.client),
    ]);

    if (!profRes.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to load profile: ${profRes.error.message}`);
    }

    if (interestsRes.ok && interestsRes.data.field_codes) {
      profRes.data.charity_interests = interestsRes.data.field_codes;
    }

    return mapUserProfile(
      profRes.data,
      coordRes.ok ? coordRes.data : null,
      feedbackRes.ok ? feedbackRes.data : null,
    );
  }

  public async updateProfile(
    updates: Partial<VolunteerProfile>,
  ): Promise<ProfileOperationResult<VolunteerProfile>> {
    const dto = mapProfileUpdateRequest(updates);

    if (updates.charityInterests) {
      const interestsRes = await profileApi.setCharityInterests(
        updates.charityInterests,
        this.client,
      );
      if (!interestsRes.ok) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: `Failed to update charity interests: ${interestsRes.error.message}`,
        };
      }
    }

    if (Object.keys(dto).length > 0) {
      const updateRes = await profileApi.updateProfile(dto, this.client);
      if (!updateRes.ok) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message: updateRes.error.message,
        };
      }
    }

    const updatedProfile = await this.getProfile();
    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Profile updated successfully',
      data: updatedProfile,
    };
  }

  public async getAvailability(): Promise<VolunteerAvailability> {
    const res = await profileApi.getAvailability(this.client);
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to load availability: ${res.error.message}`);
    }

    return mapAvailability(res.data);
  }

  public async saveWeeklyRule(
    rule: Omit<WeeklyAvailabilityRule, 'id'>,
  ): Promise<ProfileOperationResult<WeeklyAvailabilityRule>> {
    const curr = await this.getAvailability();
    const weekdayName =
      rule.weekdayName || WEEKDAY_NAMES[rule.weekday] || `Day ${rule.weekday}`;

    const normStart = normalizeTimeString(rule.startTime);
    const normEnd = normalizeTimeString(rule.endTime);
    const deterministicId = `${rule.weekday}-${normStart}-${normEnd}`;

    const newRule: WeeklyAvailabilityRule = {
      ...rule,
      weekdayName,
      startTime: normStart,
      endTime: normEnd,
      id: deterministicId,
    };

    const updatedRules: WeeklyAvailabilityRule[] = [
      ...curr.weeklyRules.filter(
        r => !(r.weekday === rule.weekday && r.startTime === normStart),
      ),
      newRule,
    ];

    const payload = mapAvailabilityRulesReplaceRequest(updatedRules);
    const res = await profileApi.replaceAvailabilityRules(payload, this.client);
    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Rule saved successfully',
      data: newRule,
    };
  }

  public async deleteWeeklyRule(
    ruleId: string,
  ): Promise<ProfileOperationResult> {
    const curr = await this.getAvailability();
    const remaining = curr.weeklyRules.filter(r => r.id !== ruleId);
    const payload = mapAvailabilityRulesReplaceRequest(remaining);
    const res = await profileApi.replaceAvailabilityRules(payload, this.client);

    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Rule deleted successfully',
    };
  }

  public async saveException(
    exception: Omit<AvailabilityException, 'id'>,
  ): Promise<ProfileOperationResult<AvailabilityException>> {
    const dto: AvailabilityExceptionDto = {
      date: exception.date,
      is_available: exception.isAvailable,
      start_time:
        exception.isAvailable && exception.startTime
          ? formatToTimeWithSeconds(exception.startTime)
          : null,
      end_time:
        exception.isAvailable && exception.endTime
          ? formatToTimeWithSeconds(exception.endTime)
          : null,
      note: exception.note ?? null,
    };

    const res = await profileApi.upsertAvailabilityException(dto, this.client);
    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Exception saved successfully',
      data: {
        ...exception,
        id: String(res.data.id || exception.date),
      },
    };
  }

  public async deleteException(
    exceptionId: string,
  ): Promise<ProfileOperationResult> {
    const res = await profileApi.deleteAvailabilityException(
      exceptionId,
      this.client,
    );
    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Exception deleted successfully',
    };
  }

  public async getVerificationStatus(): Promise<VerificationCoordinatorData> {
    const [verRes, coordRes] = await Promise.all([
      profileApi.getVerificationStatus(this.client),
      profileApi.getCoordinatorProfile(this.client),
    ]);

    if (!verRes.ok) {
      throw new Error(
        `Failed to load verification status: ${verRes.error.message}`,
      );
    }

    return mapVerificationCoordinatorData(
      verRes.data,
      coordRes.ok ? coordRes.data : null,
    );
  }

  public async getCoordinatorEligibility(): Promise<CoordinatorEligibilityData> {
    const [verRes, coordRes, attendanceRes, feedbackRes] = await Promise.all([
      profileApi.getVerificationStatus(this.client),
      profileApi.getCoordinatorProfile(this.client),
      profileApi.getAttendanceHistory(this.client),
      profileApi.getFeedbackSummary(this.client),
    ]);

    const verificationStatus = verRes.ok
      ? (verRes.data.verification_status as any) || 'unverified'
      : 'unverified';
    const isVerified =
      verificationStatus === 'approved' || verificationStatus === 'verified';

    const attendanceRecords =
      attendanceRes.ok && attendanceRes.data.results
        ? attendanceRes.data.results
        : [];
    const completedAttendance = attendanceRecords.filter(
      att => att.status === 'completed',
    );
    const completedAttendanceEventsCount = completedAttendance.length;
    const meetsCompletedEventsRequirement =
      isVerified || completedAttendanceEventsCount >= 5;

    const summary = feedbackRes.ok ? feedbackRes.data.summary : null;
    const ratingAvg =
      summary?.volunteer_avg_rating ?? summary?.overall_avg_rating ?? null;
    const ratingCount =
      summary?.volunteer_rating_count ?? summary?.total_count ?? 0;
    const meetsGoodRatingRequirement = isVerified
      ? true
      : ratingAvg !== null
      ? ratingAvg >= 4.0
      : null;

    let coordinatorStatus: CoordinatorStatus = 'none';
    if (coordRes.ok && coordRes.data.coordinator) {
      coordinatorStatus = coordRes.data.coordinator
        .status as CoordinatorStatus;
    }

    return {
      verificationStatus,
      isVerified,
      completedAttendanceEventsCount,
      meetsCompletedEventsRequirement,
      meetsGoodRatingRequirement,
      ratingAverage: ratingAvg,
      ratingCount,
      coordinatorStatus,
    };
  }

  public async submitCoordinatorApplication(
    note: string,
  ): Promise<ProfileOperationResult> {
    const res = await profileApi.applyForCoordinator(note, this.client);
    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Coordinator application submitted successfully',
    };
  }

  public async checkAvailabilityForEvent(
    eventId: string | number,
  ): Promise<AvailabilityCheckResult> {
    const res = await profileApi.checkEventAvailability(eventId, this.client);
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to check event availability: ${res.error.message}`);
    }
    return {
      isAvailable: res.data.available,
      scheduleConflict: res.data.schedule_conflict,
      eventId: res.data.event_id ? String(res.data.event_id) : String(eventId),
      startAt: res.data.start_at,
      endAt: res.data.end_at,
    };
  }

  public async checkAvailabilityForWindow(
    startAt: string,
    endAt: string,
  ): Promise<AvailabilityCheckResult> {
    const res = await profileApi.checkWindowAvailability(
      { start_at: startAt, end_at: endAt },
      this.client,
    );
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to check window availability: ${res.error.message}`);
    }
    return {
      isAvailable: res.data.available,
      scheduleConflict: res.data.schedule_conflict,
      startAt: res.data.start_at ?? startAt,
      endAt: res.data.end_at ?? endAt,
    };
  }

  public async uploadVerificationImage(
    imageType: string,
    fileUri: string,
    mimeType?: string,
    fileName?: string,
  ): Promise<VerificationImageUploadResult> {
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append('image_type', imageType);
    formData.append('image', {
      uri: fileUri,
      type: mimeType || 'image/jpeg',
      name: fileName || `verification_${imageType}_${Date.now()}.jpg`,
    } as any);

    const res = await profileApi.uploadVerificationImage(formData, this.client);
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to upload verification image: ${res.error.message}`);
    }
    return {
      id: String(res.data.id),
      imageType: res.data.image_type,
      status: res.data.status,
      comparisonStatus: res.data.comparison_status,
      isCurrent: res.data.is_current,
      createdAt: res.data.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
    };
  }

  public async updateCoordinatorApplicationNotes(
    notes: string,
  ): Promise<ProfileOperationResult> {
    const res = await profileApi.updateCoordinatorApplicationNotes(
      notes,
      this.client,
    );
    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }
    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Coordinator application notes updated successfully',
    };
  }

  public async lookupUserByUuid(
    uuid: string,
    eventId?: string | number,
  ): Promise<UserUuidLookupResult> {
    const res = await profileApi.lookupUserByUuid(uuid, eventId, this.client);
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to lookup user by UUID: ${res.error.message}`);
    }
    return {
      userId: res.data.user_id,
      uuid: res.data.uuid,
      displayName: res.data.display_name,
      skills: res.data.skills,
      physicalOk: res.data.physical_ok,
      goodEyesight: res.data.good_eyesight,
      needsGlasses: res.data.needs_glasses,
      canLiftHeavy: res.data.can_lift_heavy,
      canWorkOutdoor: res.data.can_work_outdoor,
      hasLeaderExperience: res.data.has_leader_experience,
      newToVolunteer: res.data.new_to_volunteer,
      preferredLanguage: res.data.preferred_language,
      homeArea: res.data.home_area,
      needsMealSupport: res.data.needs_meal_support,
      needsTravelSupport: res.data.needs_travel_support,
      acceptsUnpaid: res.data.accepts_unpaid,
      verificationStatus: res.data.verification_status,
    };
  }

  public async getAttendanceHistory(): Promise<AttendanceHistoryItem[]> {
    const res = await profileApi.getAttendanceHistory(this.client);
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to load attendance history: ${res.error.message}`);
    }
    const items = res.data.results || [];
    return items.map(dto => ({
      id: String(dto.id),
      assignmentId:
        dto.assignment_id !== null && dto.assignment_id !== undefined
          ? String(dto.assignment_id)
          : null,
      eventId: String(dto.event_id),
      eventTitle: dto.event_title ?? null,
      locationName: dto.location_name ?? null,
      postId:
        dto.post_id !== null && dto.post_id !== undefined
          ? String(dto.post_id)
          : null,
      postTitle: dto.post_title ?? null,
      scheduleStart: dto.schedule_start ?? null,
      scheduleEnd: dto.schedule_end ?? null,
      status: String(dto.status),
      method: dto.method ? String(dto.method) : null,
      checkinAt: dto.checkin_at,
      checkoutAt: dto.checkout_at,
      confirmationStatus: dto.confirmation_status
        ? String(dto.confirmation_status)
        : null,
      walkInFlag: dto.walk_in_flag ?? false,
      verifiedHours: dto.verified_hours ?? null,
    }));
  }

  public async getOwnFeedback(): Promise<MyFeedbackResponse> {
    const res = await profileApi.getFeedbackSummary(this.client);
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to load feedback summary: ${res.error.message}`);
    }
    return mapMyFeedbackResponse(res.data);
  }
}

        walk_in_flag: false,
        checkin_at: '2026-12-20T08:00:00Z',
        checkin_distance_m: null,
        confirmation_status: 'not_required',

      const qrItem = mapAttendanceRosterItem(qrDto);
      expect(qrItem.checkInMethod).toBe('qr');
      expect(qrItem.status).toBe('checked_in');
      expect(qrItem.attendanceStatus).toBe('checked_in');
      expect(qrItem.confirmationStatus).toBe('not_required');

      const manualDto: AttendanceRosterDto = {
        ...qrDto,
        attendance_id: 904,
        method: 'coordinator_manual',
        confirmation_status: 'confirmed',

      expect(manualItem.checkInMethod).toBe('manual');
      expect(manualItem.confirmationStatus).toBe('confirmed');

import {

import type { VolunteerProfile } from '../../../domain/models/profile';

describe('profileMapper', () => {
  const sampleUserDto: UserProfileDto = {
    id: 201,
    uuid: 'usr-uuid-201',
    display_name: 'Ko Thura',
    phone: '+95912345678',
    preferred_language: 'my',
    home_area: 'Kamayut, Yangon',

  describe('Time normalization helpers', () => {

      expect(normalizeTimeString('08:30:00')).toBe('08:30');
      expect(normalizeTimeString('9:5:00')).toBe('09:05');
      expect(normalizeTimeString('18:00')).toBe('18:00');
      expect(normalizeTimeString(null)).toBe('00:00');
    });

    it('formats HH:mm to HH:mm:00 for TimeField backend storage', () => {
      expect(formatToTimeWithSeconds('08:30')).toBe('08:30:00');
      expect(formatToTimeWithSeconds('14:45:00')).toBe('14:45:00');
    });
  });

  describe('mapUserProfile', () => {
    const sampleCoordEnvelope: CoordinatorProfileEnvelopeDto = {
      coordinator: {
        user_id: 201,
        status: 'approved',
        approved_by_id: 1,

      expect(profile.coordinatorStatus).toBe('approved');
      expect(profile.ratingAverage).toBe(4.85);
      expect(profile.ratingCount).toBe(14);
      expect(profile.capabilities.canLiftHeavy).toBe(true);
      expect(profile.supportPreferences.needsTravelSupport).toBe(true);
      expect(profile.donationPreferences.bloodType).toBe('O+');
      expect(profile.charityInterests).toEqual(['disaster_support', 'health']);
    });

    it('handles null phone, coordinator envelope, and feedback metrics safely', () => {
      const userWithoutPhone: UserProfileDto = {
        ...sampleUserDto,

      };

      const profile = mapUserProfile(userWithoutPhone, null, null);

  describe('mapProfileUpdateRequest', () => {
    it('strictly outputs ONLY allow-listed keys matching ProfileUpdateSerializer', () => {
      const updates: Partial<VolunteerProfile> = {
        displayName: 'Thura Updated',
        preferredLanguage: 'en',
        homeArea: 'Bahan, Yangon',
        emergencyContactName: 'U Tin',
        emergencyContactPhone: '+95911112222',
        skills: ['teaching', 'cooking'],

          physicalOk: true,
          goodEyesight: true,
          needsGlasses: true,
          canLiftHeavy: false,
          canWorkOutdoor: true,
          hasLeaderExperience: true,
          newToVolunteer: false,

        supportPreferences: {

          needsTravelSupport: false,
          acceptsUnpaid: true,
        },
        donationPreferences: {
          bloodType: 'B+',
          isWillingToDonate: true,
          isWillingToDonateBlood: true,
          isWillingToDonateItems: true,
        },
      };

      const payload = mapProfileUpdateRequest(updates);

      // Verify exact allow-listed keys exist
      expect(payload.display_name).toBe('Thura Updated');
      expect(payload.preferred_language).toBe('en');
      expect(payload.home_area).toBe('Bahan, Yangon');
      expect(payload.emergency_contact_name).toBe('U Tin');
      expect(payload.emergency_contact_phone).toBe('+95911112222');
      expect(payload.skills).toEqual(['teaching', 'cooking']);
      expect(payload.needs_glasses).toBe(true);
      expect(payload.can_lift_heavy).toBe(false);
      expect(payload.needs_meal_support).toBe(true);
      expect(payload.blood_type).toBe('B+');
      expect(payload.is_willing_to_donate_blood).toBe(true);
      expect(payload.is_willing_to_donate).toBe(true);

      // Verify that non-allow-listed keys are NOT in the payload
      const payloadKeys = Object.keys(payload);
      expect(payloadKeys).not.toContain('id');
      expect(payloadKeys).not.toContain('email');
      expect(payloadKeys).not.toContain('account_status');
      expect(payloadKeys).not.toContain('verification_status');
      expect(payloadKeys).not.toContain('coordinator_status');
      expect(payloadKeys).not.toContain('charity_interests'); // handled via separate PUT endpoint
    });

    it('coherently merges donation sub-flags with currentProfile to preserve is_willing_to_donate', () => {
      const currentProfile: VolunteerProfile = {
        ...(sampleUserDto as any),
        donationPreferences: {
          bloodType: 'A+',
          isWillingToDonate: true,
          isWillingToDonateBlood: false,
          isWillingToDonateItems: true,
        },
      };

      const partialUpdates: Partial<VolunteerProfile> = {
        donationPreferences: {
          bloodType: 'A+',
          isWillingToDonate: true,
          isWillingToDonateBlood: false,
        } as any,
      };

      const partialPayload = mapProfileUpdateRequest(partialUpdates, currentProfile);
      expect(partialPayload.is_willing_to_donate).toBe(true);
      expect(partialPayload.is_willing_to_donate_blood).toBe(false);
      expect(partialPayload.is_willing_to_donate_items).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  describe('mapAvailability & mapAvailabilityRulesReplaceRequest', () => {
    it('maps AvailabilityResponseDto and normalizes time strings and weekday names', () => {
      const responseDto: AvailabilityResponseDto = {
        rules: [
          {
            id: 11,
            weekday: 1, // Monday
            start_time: '08:00:00',
            end_time: '12:00:00',
          },
          {
            id: 12,
            weekday: 6, // Saturday
            start_time: '13:30:00',
            end_time: '17:00:00',
          },
        ],
        exceptions: [
          {
            id: 21,
            date: '2026-12-25',
            is_available: false,
            note: 'Christmas blackout',
          },
        ],
      };

      const availability = mapAvailability(responseDto);
      expect(availability.weeklyRules).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(availability.weeklyRules[0].weekdayName).toBe('Monday');
      expect(availability.weeklyRules[0].startTime).toBe('08:00');

import type {

  EventPurposeType,
  VolunteerT2Capabilities,
} from '../../domain/models/coordinator';

/**
 * Maps wizard draft to EventCreateRequestDto matching EventCreateSerializer.
 * Translates mobile domain choices into backend allow-listed serializer choices:
 * - leaderStrategy ('first_assigned' | 'highest_rated' -> 'first_experienced')
 * - compensationKind ('stipend' | 'travel_reimbursement' -> 'arranged_outside_system')
 */
export function mapCreateEventDraftToRequest(
  draft: CreateEventWizardDraft,
): EventCreateRequestDto {
  let leaderStrategy: 'none' | 'first_experienced' | 'manual' = 'none';
  if (
    draft.leaderStrategy === 'first_experienced' ||
    draft.leaderStrategy === 'manual'
  ) {
    leaderStrategy = draft.leaderStrategy;
  } else if (
    draft.leaderStrategy === 'first_assigned' ||
    draft.leaderStrategy === 'highest_rated'
  ) {
    leaderStrategy = 'first_experienced';
  }

  let compensationKind: 'unpaid' | 'arranged_outside_system' = 'unpaid';
  let compensationNote: string | null = draft.compensationNote ?? null;

  if (draft.compensationKind === 'arranged_outside_system') {
    compensationKind = 'arranged_outside_system';
  } else if (
    draft.compensationKind === 'stipend' ||
    draft.compensationKind === 'travel_reimbursement'
  ) {
    compensationKind = 'arranged_outside_system';
    const kindLabel =
      draft.compensationKind === 'stipend'
        ? 'Stipend Support'
        : 'Travel Reimbursement';
    compensationNote = draft.compensationNote
      ? `${kindLabel}: ${draft.compensationNote}`
      : kindLabel;
  }

  return {
    title: draft.title.trim(),
    description: draft.description ? draft.description.trim() : null,
    purpose_type: draft.purposeType,
    location_name: draft.locationName ? draft.locationName.trim() : null,
    landmark_text: draft.landmarkText ? draft.landmarkText.trim() : null,
    latitude: typeof draft.latitude === 'number' ? draft.latitude : null,
    longitude: typeof draft.longitude === 'number' ? draft.longitude : null,
    geo_radius_m: draft.geoRadiusM ?? 100,
    geo_checkin_enabled: Boolean(draft.geoCheckinEnabled),
    geo_checkin_opens_before_min: draft.geoCheckinOpensBeforeMin ?? 30,
    require_checkin_confirmation: Boolean(draft.requireCheckinConfirmation),
    map_provider: draft.mapProvider === 'google' ? 'google' : 'openstreetmap',
    start_at: draft.startAt,
    end_at: draft.endAt,
    application_deadline: draft.applicationDeadline ?? null,
    acceptance_mode: draft.acceptanceMode,
    auto_assign_enabled: Boolean(draft.autoAssignEnabled),
    group_size: draft.groupSize ?? null,
    leader_strategy: leaderStrategy,
    max_participants: draft.maxParticipants ?? null,
    meals_provided: Boolean(draft.mealsProvided),
    lodging_provided: Boolean(draft.lodgingProvided),
    travel_support_provided: Boolean(draft.travelSupportProvided),
    compensation_kind: compensationKind,
    compensation_note: compensationNote,
    onboarding_text: draft.onboardingText ? draft.onboardingText.trim() : null,
    require_onboarding_ack: Boolean(draft.requireOnboardingAck),
    qr_registration_enabled: Boolean(draft.qrRegistrationEnabled),
    charity_field_codes: draft.charityFieldCodes || [],
  };
}

/**

      needsMealSupport: Boolean(dto.needs_meal_support),
      needsTravelSupport: Boolean(dto.needs_travel_support),
      acceptsUnpaid: Boolean(dto.accepts_unpaid),
      verificationStatus: dto.verification_status || 'none',

  return {

    appliedAt: dto.applied_at,

      dto.post_id !== null && dto.post_id !== undefined

      : '';

    'application_id' in dto && dto.application_id != null
      ? dto.application_id
      : '';

    'display_name' in dto && dto.display_name ? dto.display_name : 'Volunteer';

    'is_group_leader' in dto && dto.is_group_leader != null

/**
 * Maps AttendanceRosterDto to domain CoordinatorAttendanceItem.
 */
export function mapAttendanceRosterItem(
  dto: AttendanceRosterDto,
  eventTitle = 'Volunteer Event',
): CoordinatorAttendanceItem {
  let status: AttendanceRecordStatus = 'scheduled';
  let isPendingGeoConfirmation = false;

  if (dto.confirmation_status === 'pending') {
    status = 'pending_confirmation';
    isPendingGeoConfirmation = true;
  } else if (dto.attendance_status === 'completed') {
    status = 'completed';
  } else if (dto.attendance_status === 'checked_in') {
    status = 'checked_in';
  } else if (dto.attendance_status === 'absent' || dto.attendance_status === 'excused') {
    status = 'no_show';
  } else {
    status = 'scheduled';
  }

  let checkInMethod: CheckInMethod | undefined = undefined;
  if (dto.method) {
    if (dto.method === 'qr_scan' || dto.method === 'qr') {
      checkInMethod = 'qr';
    } else if (dto.method === 'coordinator_manual' || dto.method === 'manual') {
      checkInMethod = 'manual';
    } else if (dto.method === 'geo') {
      checkInMethod = 'geo';
    } else if (dto.method === 'system') {
      checkInMethod = 'system';
    }
  }

  let geoAttempt = undefined;
  if (dto.checkin_distance_m !== null && dto.checkin_distance_m !== undefined) {
    geoAttempt = {
      attemptedAt: dto.checkin_at || new Date().toISOString(),
      withinGeofence: status !== 'pending_confirmation',
      distanceMeters: Number(dto.checkin_distance_m),
      confirmationStatus:
        dto.confirmation_status === 'confirmed' || dto.confirmation_status === 'rejected'
          ? (dto.confirmation_status as 'confirmed' | 'rejected')
          : ('pending' as const),
    };
  }

  return {
    id: String(dto.attendance_id ?? dto.assignment_id),
    eventId: String(dto.event_id),
    eventTitle,
    assignmentId: String(dto.assignment_id),
    userId: String(dto.user_id),
    volunteerName: dto.display_name,
    postTitle: dto.post_title ?? 'General Volunteer',
    groupCode: dto.group_code ?? undefined,
    status,
    attendanceStatus: (dto.attendance_status as any) ?? null,
    confirmationStatus: (dto.confirmation_status as any) ?? null,
    checkInMethod,
    checkedInAt: dto.checkin_at ?? undefined,
    isPendingGeoConfirmation,
    geoAttempt,
  };
}

/**
 * @format
 */

import type {
  AttendanceHistoryItemDto,
  FeedbackSummaryResponseDto,
} from '../dto/profileDto';
import type { VolunteerAssignmentDto } from '../dto/eventDto';
import type {
  CompletedActivity,
  DashboardSummary,
  UpcomingCommitment,
} from '../../domain/models/dashboard';

/**
 * Computes verified hours from check-in and check-out timestamps.
 * Returns 0 if exact duration cannot be measured (never fabricates 3.0).
 */
export function calculateVerifiedHours(
  checkinIso?: string | null,
  checkoutIso?: string | null,
  providedHours?: number | null,
): number {
  if (typeof providedHours === 'number' && providedHours >= 0) {
    return Math.round(providedHours * 10) / 10;
  }
  if (checkinIso && checkoutIso) {
    const diffMs = new Date(checkoutIso).getTime() - new Date(checkinIso).getTime();
    if (!isNaN(diffMs) && diffMs > 0) {
      const hours = diffMs / (1000 * 60 * 60);
      return Math.round(hours * 10) / 10;
    }
  }
  return 0; // Unmeasured duration returns 0, never a fake constant
}

/**
 * Maps assignments, attendance records, and feedback metrics into DashboardSummary.
 * Strictly enforces that completed activities are attendance-backed (`status === 'completed'`).
 * Joins attendance records with assignments as a fallback for title/post/location.
 */
export function mapDashboardSummary(
  assignments: VolunteerAssignmentDto[] = [],
  attendanceRecords: AttendanceHistoryItemDto[] = [],
  feedbackSummary?: FeedbackSummaryResponseDto | null,
): DashboardSummary {
  // Build lookup index for joining attendance with assignments
  const assignmentById = new Map<number, VolunteerAssignmentDto>();
  const assignmentByEventId = new Map<number, VolunteerAssignmentDto>();
  assignments.forEach(a => {
    if (a.id != null) {
      assignmentById.set(Number(a.id), a);
    }
    if (a.event_id != null) {
      assignmentByEventId.set(Number(a.event_id), a);
    }
  });

  // Filter active upcoming shifts: 'assigned' or 'confirmed'
  const upcomingCommitments: UpcomingCommitment[] = assignments
    .filter(a => a.status === 'assigned' || a.status === 'confirmed')
    .map(a => ({
      id: String(a.id),
      eventId: String(a.event_id),
      eventTitle: a.event_title || 'Volunteer Event',
      roleName: a.post_title || 'Assigned Volunteer',
      startAt: a.schedule_start,
      endAt: a.schedule_end,
      location: a.location_name || 'Event Location',
      status: a.status === 'confirmed' ? 'confirmed' : 'assigned',
    }));

  // Filter completed activities: strictly status === 'completed'
  const completedAttendance = attendanceRecords.filter(
    att => att.status === 'completed',
  );

  const recentCompletedActivities: CompletedActivity[] = completedAttendance.map(
    att => {
      const matchedAssignment =
        (att.assignment_id != null ? assignmentById.get(Number(att.assignment_id)) : undefined) ??
        (att.event_id != null ? assignmentByEventId.get(Number(att.event_id)) : undefined);

      const verifiedAt =
        att.checkout_at || att.checkin_at || new Date().toISOString();
      const hours = calculateVerifiedHours(
        att.checkin_at,
        att.checkout_at,
        att.verified_hours,
      );

      const resolvedTitle =
        att.event_title || matchedAssignment?.event_title || 'Community Service Activity';
      const resolvedRole =
        att.post_title || matchedAssignment?.post_title || 'Volunteer Contributor';
      const resolvedLocation =
        att.location_name || matchedAssignment?.location_name || 'Designated Location';

      return {
        id: String(att.id),
        eventId: String(att.event_id),
        eventTitle: resolvedTitle,
        roleName: resolvedRole,
        completedAt: verifiedAt,
        attendanceStatus: 'completed',
        verifiedHours: hours,
        location: resolvedLocation,
        attendanceVerifiedAt: verifiedAt,
      };
    },
  );

  const completedShiftCount = completedAttendance.length;
  const uniqueEventIds = new Set(completedAttendance.map(att => att.event_id));
  const completedEventCount = uniqueEventIds.size;

  const summary = feedbackSummary?.summary;
  const ratingAverage =
    summary?.volunteer_avg_rating ??
    summary?.overall_avg_rating ??
    summary?.as_volunteer?.avg_overall ??
    null;

  const ratingCount =
    summary?.volunteer_rating_count ??
    summary?.total_count ??
    summary?.as_volunteer?.count ??
    0;

  return {
    completedShiftCount,
    completedEventCount,
    upcomingCommitmentCount: upcomingCommitments.length,
    ratingAverage,
    ratingCount,
    upcomingCommitments,
    recentCompletedActivities,
  };
}

import type {
  ApplicationSubmitRequestDto,
  PublicEventDetailDto,
  PublicEventDto,
  PublicEventPostDto,
  VolunteerApplicationDto,
  VolunteerAssignmentDto,
} from '../dto/eventDto';
import type {
  CharityCategoryCode,
  EventApplicationState,
  EventApplicationStatus,
  EventDetail,
  EventPost,
  EventStatus,
  EventSummary,
  PhysicalLevel,
  PostStatus,
  VolunteerApplicationItem,
  VolunteerAssignmentItem,
  VolunteerAssignmentStatus,
} from '../../domain/models/event';

/**
 * Normalizes event status to domain union 'published' | 'active'.
 */
function normalizeEventStatus(statusStr: string): EventStatus {
  if (statusStr === 'active') {
    return 'active';
  }
  return 'published';
}

/**
 * Normalizes post status to domain union 'open' | 'full' | 'closed'.
 */
function normalizePostStatus(statusStr: string): PostStatus {
  if (statusStr === 'full' || statusStr === 'closed') {
    return statusStr;
  }
  return 'open';
}

/**
 * Normalizes post physical level.
 */
function normalizePhysicalLevel(levelStr: string): PhysicalLevel {
  if (levelStr === 'light' || levelStr === 'medium' || levelStr === 'heavy') {
    return levelStr;
  }
  return 'none';
}

/**
 * Maps PublicEventDto to domain EventSummary model.
 */
export function mapPublicEventSummary(dto: PublicEventDto): EventSummary {
  return {
    id: String(dto.id),
    title: dto.title,
    description: dto.description ?? '',
    purposeType: dto.purpose_type,
    status: normalizeEventStatus(dto.status),
    locationName: dto.location_name ?? '',
    landmarkText: dto.landmark_text ?? undefined,
    startAt: dto.start_at,
    endAt: dto.end_at,
    applicationDeadline: dto.application_deadline ?? undefined,
    charityFields: (dto.charity_fields || []) as CharityCategoryCode[],
    coordinatorName: dto.coordinator_name ?? 'Coordinator',
    spotsRemaining: typeof dto.spots_remaining === 'number' ? dto.spots_remaining : 0,
    mealsProvided: Boolean(dto.meals_provided),
    lodgingProvided: Boolean(dto.lodging_provided),
    travelSupportProvided: Boolean(dto.travel_support_provided),
    compensationKind: dto.compensation_kind ?? 'unpaid',
  };
}

/**
 * Maps PublicEventPostDto to domain EventPost model.
 */
export function mapPublicEventPost(
  dto: PublicEventPostDto,
  eventId: string | number,
): EventPost {
  const reqHeadcount = typeof dto.required_headcount === 'number' ? dto.required_headcount : 1;
  const assigned = typeof dto.assigned_count === 'number' ? dto.assigned_count : 0;
  const rem = typeof dto.remaining === 'number' ? dto.remaining : Math.max(0, reqHeadcount - assigned);

  return {
    id: String(dto.id),
    eventId: String(eventId),
    title: dto.title,
    description: dto.description ?? undefined,
    requiredHeadcount: reqHeadcount,
    filledHeadcount: assigned,
    remainingCapacity: rem,
    physicalLevel: normalizePhysicalLevel(dto.physical_level),
    requiredSkills: Array.isArray(dto.required_skills) ? dto.required_skills : [],
    leaderNeeded: Boolean(dto.leader_needed),
    newVolunteersAllowed: Boolean(dto.new_volunteers_allowed),
    status: normalizePostStatus(dto.status),
  };
}

/**
 * Maps PublicEventDetailDto and optional user application to domain EventDetail model.
 */
export function mapPublicEventDetail(
  dto: PublicEventDetailDto,
  userApp?: VolunteerApplicationDto | null,
): EventDetail {
  const summary = mapPublicEventSummary(dto);
  const posts: EventPost[] = Array.isArray(dto.posts)
    ? dto.posts.map(p => mapPublicEventPost(p, dto.id))
    : [];

  let userApplication: EventApplicationState | null = null;
  if (userApp) {
    userApplication = {
      id: String(userApp.id),
      eventId: String(userApp.event_id),
      postId: String(userApp.post_id ?? ''),
      postTitle: userApp.post_title ?? 'General Volunteer Support',
      status: userApp.status as EventApplicationStatus,
      appliedAt: userApp.applied_at,
      volunteerNote: userApp.note ?? undefined,
    };
  }

  const lat =
    dto.latitude !== null && dto.latitude !== undefined && dto.latitude !== ''
      ? Number(dto.latitude)
      : undefined;

  const lng =
    dto.longitude !== null && dto.longitude !== undefined && dto.longitude !== ''
      ? Number(dto.longitude)
      : undefined;

  return {
    ...summary,
    landmarkText: dto.landmark_text ?? undefined,
    compensationNote: dto.compensation_note ?? undefined,
    onboardingText: dto.onboarding_text ?? undefined,
    latitude: !isNaN(lat as number) ? lat : undefined,
    longitude: !isNaN(lng as number) ? lng : undefined,
    geoCheckinEnabled: Boolean(dto.geo_checkin_enabled),
    posts,
    userApplication,
  };
}

const WEEKDAY_NAMES: Record<number, string> = {
  1: 'Monday',
  2: 'Tuesday',
  3: 'Wednesday',
  4: 'Thursday',
  5: 'Friday',
  6: 'Saturday',
  7: 'Sunday',
};

/**
 * Trims PostgreSQL TimeField values ("08:00:00" -> "08:00").
 */
export function normalizeTimeString(timeStr?: string | null): string {
  if (!timeStr) {
    return '00:00';
  }
  const parts = timeStr.trim().split(':');
  if (parts.length >= 2) {
    return `${parts[0].padStart(2, '0')}:${parts[1].padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }
  return timeStr;
}

/**
 * Ensures TimeField string has seconds ("08:00" -> "08:00:00").
 */
export function formatToTimeWithSeconds(timeStr: string): string {
  const normalized = normalizeTimeString(timeStr);
  return `${normalized}:00`;
}

/**
 * Maps UserProfileDto composite into domain VolunteerProfile.
 * Note: Backwards compatibility - maps phone into email property so UI displays without change.
 */
export function mapUserProfile(
  userDto: UserProfileDto,
  coordinatorEnvelope?: CoordinatorProfileEnvelopeDto | null,
  feedbackSummary?: FeedbackSummaryResponseDto | null,
): VolunteerProfile {
  const coordStatus: CoordinatorStatus =
    (coordinatorEnvelope?.coordinator?.status as CoordinatorStatus) || 'none';

  const verifStatus =
    (userDto.verification_status as 'none' | 'pending' | 'verified' | 'rejected') || 'none';

  const acctStatus =
    (userDto.account_status as 'active' | 'blocked' | 'closed') || 'active';

  const summary = feedbackSummary?.summary;
  const ratingAverage =
    summary?.volunteer_avg_rating ??
    summary?.overall_avg_rating ??
    summary?.as_volunteer?.avg_overall ??
    null;

  const ratingCount =
    summary?.volunteer_rating_count ??
    summary?.total_count ??
    summary?.as_volunteer?.count ??
    0;

  return {
    id: String(userDto.id),
    phone: userDto.phone ?? null,
    email: userDto.phone ? userDto.phone : undefined,
    accountStatus: acctStatus,
    verificationStatus: verifStatus,
    coordinatorStatus: coordStatus,
    isAdmin: false,
    isStaff: false,
    ratingAverage,
    ratingCount,

    displayName: userDto.display_name || 'Volunteer',
    preferredLanguage: (userDto.preferred_language as UserLanguage) || 'en',
    homeArea: userDto.home_area || '',
    emergencyContactName: userDto.emergency_contact_name || '',
    emergencyContactPhone: userDto.emergency_contact_phone || '',
    skills: Array.isArray(userDto.skills) ? userDto.skills : [],
    charityInterests: (userDto.charity_interests || []) as CharityCategoryCode[],

    capabilities: {
      physicalOk: Boolean(userDto.physical_ok),
      goodEyesight: Boolean(userDto.good_eyesight),
      needsGlasses: Boolean(userDto.needs_glasses),
      canLiftHeavy: Boolean(userDto.can_lift_heavy),
      canWorkOutdoor: Boolean(userDto.can_work_outdoor),
      hasLeaderExperience: Boolean(userDto.has_leader_experience),
      newToVolunteer: Boolean(userDto.new_to_volunteer),
    },

    supportPreferences: {
      needsMealSupport: Boolean(userDto.needs_meal_support),
      needsTravelSupport: Boolean(userDto.needs_travel_support),
      acceptsUnpaid: Boolean(userDto.accepts_unpaid),
    },

    donationPreferences: {
      bloodType: (userDto.blood_type as BloodType) || 'unknown',
      isWillingToDonate: Boolean(
        userDto.is_willing_to_donate ??
          (userDto.is_willing_to_donate_blood || userDto.is_willing_to_donate_items),
      ),
      isWillingToDonateBlood: Boolean(userDto.is_willing_to_donate_blood),
      isWillingToDonateItems: Boolean(userDto.is_willing_to_donate_items),
    },
  };
}

/**
 * Maps partial VolunteerProfile updates to strict ProfileUpdateSerializer allow-list.
 * CRITICAL: Emits ONLY the 20 approved keys; any extraneous property causes HTTP 400.
 * Merges with currentProfile?.donationPreferences to avoid partial patches clobbering sub-flags.
 */
export function mapProfileUpdateRequest(
  updates: Partial<VolunteerProfile>,
  currentProfile?: VolunteerProfile | null,
): ProfileUpdateRequestDto {
  const payload: ProfileUpdateRequestDto = {};

  if (updates.displayName !== undefined) {
    payload.display_name = updates.displayName.trim();
  }
  if (updates.preferredLanguage !== undefined) {
    payload.preferred_language = updates.preferredLanguage;
  }
  if (updates.homeArea !== undefined) {
    payload.home_area = updates.homeArea.trim();
  }
  if (updates.emergencyContactName !== undefined) {
    payload.emergency_contact_name = updates.emergencyContactName.trim();
  }
  if (updates.emergencyContactPhone !== undefined) {
    payload.emergency_contact_phone = updates.emergencyContactPhone.trim();
  }
  if (updates.skills !== undefined) {
    payload.skills = updates.skills;
  }

  if (updates.capabilities) {
    if (updates.capabilities.physicalOk !== undefined) {
      payload.physical_ok = updates.capabilities.physicalOk;
    }
    if (updates.capabilities.goodEyesight !== undefined) {
      payload.good_eyesight = updates.capabilities.goodEyesight;
    }
    if (updates.capabilities.needsGlasses !== undefined) {
      payload.needs_glasses = updates.capabilities.needsGlasses;
    }
    if (updates.capabilities.canLiftHeavy !== undefined) {
      payload.can_lift_heavy = updates.capabilities.canLiftHeavy;
    }
    if (updates.capabilities.canWorkOutdoor !== undefined) {
      payload.can_work_outdoor = updates.capabilities.canWorkOutdoor;
    }
    if (updates.capabilities.hasLeaderExperience !== undefined) {
      payload.has_leader_experience = updates.capabilities.hasLeaderExperience;
    }
    if (updates.capabilities.newToVolunteer !== undefined) {
      payload.new_to_volunteer = updates.capabilities.newToVolunteer;
    }
  }

  if (updates.supportPreferences) {
    if (updates.supportPreferences.needsMealSupport !== undefined) {
      payload.needs_meal_support = updates.supportPreferences.needsMealSupport;
    }
    if (updates.supportPreferences.needsTravelSupport !== undefined) {
      payload.needs_travel_support = updates.supportPreferences.needsTravelSupport;
    }
    if (updates.supportPreferences.acceptsUnpaid !== undefined) {
      payload.accepts_unpaid = updates.supportPreferences.acceptsUnpaid;
    }
  }

  if (updates.donationPreferences) {
    if (updates.donationPreferences.bloodType !== undefined) {
      payload.blood_type = updates.donationPreferences.bloodType;
    }

    const currentDonateBlood = currentProfile?.donationPreferences?.isWillingToDonateBlood;
    const currentDonateItems = currentProfile?.donationPreferences?.isWillingToDonateItems;

    const donateBlood =
      updates.donationPreferences.isWillingToDonateBlood !== undefined
        ? updates.donationPreferences.isWillingToDonateBlood
        : currentDonateBlood;

    const donateItems =
      updates.donationPreferences.isWillingToDonateItems !== undefined
        ? updates.donationPreferences.isWillingToDonateItems
        : currentDonateItems;

    if (donateBlood !== undefined) {
      payload.is_willing_to_donate_blood = donateBlood;
    }
    if (donateItems !== undefined) {
      payload.is_willing_to_donate_items = donateItems;
    }

    if (updates.donationPreferences.isWillingToDonate !== undefined) {
      payload.is_willing_to_donate = updates.donationPreferences.isWillingToDonate;
    } else if (donateBlood !== undefined || donateItems !== undefined) {
      payload.is_willing_to_donate = Boolean(donateBlood || donateItems);
    }
  }

  return payload;
}

/**
 * Maps FeedbackSummaryResponseDto into domain MyFeedbackResponse with separate authored feedback
 * and received aggregate metrics (V-41, V-42, P2-02).
 */
export function mapMyFeedbackResponse(
  dto: FeedbackSummaryResponseDto,
): MyFeedbackResponse {
  const results = Array.isArray(dto.results) ? dto.results : [];
  const authoredFeedback: AuthoredFeedbackItem[] = results.map(item => ({
    id: String(item.id),
    eventId: String(item.event_id),
    eventTitle: item.event_title ?? undefined,
    direction: item.direction,
    ratingOverall: item.rating_overall,
    tags: Array.isArray(item.tags) ? item.tags : [],
    comments: item.comments ?? undefined,
    createdAt: item.created_at,
  }));

  const s = dto.summary || {};
  const asVol = s.as_volunteer || {
    count: s.volunteer_rating_count ?? 0,
    avg_overall: s.volunteer_avg_rating ?? null,
  };
  const asCoord = s.as_coordinator || {
    count: s.coordinator_rating_count ?? 0,
    avg_overall: s.coordinator_avg_rating ?? null,
  };

  const totalCount =
    s.total_count ?? (asVol.count + asCoord.count);
  const overallAvg =
    s.overall_avg_rating ??
    (totalCount > 0 ? asVol.avg_overall ?? asCoord.avg_overall : null);

  const receivedSummary: FeedbackRatingSummary = {
    userId: s.user_id !== undefined ? String(s.user_id) : undefined,
    overallAvgRating: overallAvg,
    totalCount,
    volunteerAvgRating: s.volunteer_avg_rating ?? asVol.avg_overall ?? null,
    volunteerRatingCount: s.volunteer_rating_count ?? asVol.count ?? 0,
    coordinatorAvgRating: s.coordinator_avg_rating ?? asCoord.avg_overall ?? null,
    coordinatorRatingCount: s.coordinator_rating_count ?? asCoord.count ?? 0,
    asVolunteer: {
      count: asVol.count,
      avgOverall: asVol.avg_overall,
    },
    asCoordinator: {
      count: asCoord.count,
      avgOverall: asCoord.avg_overall,
    },
    ratingDistribution: s.rating_distribution || {},
  };

  return {
    authoredFeedback,
    receivedSummary,
  };
}

/**
 * Maps AvailabilityResponseDto to domain VolunteerAvailability model.
 */
export function mapAvailability(
  dto: AvailabilityResponseDto,
): VolunteerAvailability {
  const weeklyRules: WeeklyAvailabilityRule[] = (dto.rules || []).map(r => {
    const normStart = normalizeTimeString(r.start_time);
    const normEnd = normalizeTimeString(r.end_time);
    const deterministicId =
      r.id != null ? String(r.id) : `${r.weekday}-${normStart}-${normEnd}`;

    return {
      id: deterministicId,
      weekday: r.weekday,
      weekdayName: WEEKDAY_NAMES[r.weekday] || `Day ${r.weekday}`,
      startTime: normStart,
      endTime: normEnd,
      validFrom: r.valid_from ?? undefined,
      validTo: r.valid_to ?? undefined,
    };
  });

  const exceptions: AvailabilityException[] = (dto.exceptions || []).map(e => ({
    id: String(e.id ?? `exc-${e.date}`),
    date: e.date,
    isAvailable: Boolean(e.is_available),
    startTime: e.start_time ? normalizeTimeString(e.start_time) : undefined,
    endTime: e.end_time ? normalizeTimeString(e.end_time) : undefined,
    note: e.note ?? undefined,
  }));

  return {
    weeklyRules,
    exceptions,
  };
}

/**
 * Maps domain weekly rules into AvailabilityRulesReplaceDto payload.
 */
export function mapAvailabilityRulesReplaceRequest(
  rules: WeeklyAvailabilityRule[],
): AvailabilityRulesReplaceDto {
  return {
    rules: rules.map(r => {
      const item: AvailabilityRulesReplaceDto['rules'][number] = {
        weekday: r.weekday,
        start_time: formatToTimeWithSeconds(r.startTime),
        end_time: formatToTimeWithSeconds(r.endTime),
      };
      if (r.validFrom !== undefined && r.validFrom !== null) {
        item.valid_from = r.validFrom;
      }
      if (r.validTo !== undefined && r.validTo !== null) {
        item.valid_to = r.validTo;
      }
      return item;
    }),
  };
}

/**
 * Normalizes backend verification image status to domain status.
 */
function normalizeVerificationStatus(statusStr: string): VerificationStatus {
  if (statusStr === 'approved' || statusStr === 'verified') {
    return 'verified';
  }
  if (statusStr === 'pending') {
    return 'pending';
  }
  if (statusStr === 'rejected') {
    return 'rejected';
  }
  return 'none';
}

/**
 * Maps VerificationStatusResponseDto and coordinator envelope to VerificationCoordinatorData.
 */
export function mapVerificationCoordinatorData(
  verificationDto: VerificationStatusResponseDto,
  coordinatorEnvelope?: CoordinatorProfileEnvelopeDto | null,
): VerificationCoordinatorData {
  const verifStatus = normalizeVerificationStatus(
    verificationDto.verification_status,
  );
  const coordStatus: CoordinatorStatus =
    (coordinatorEnvelope?.coordinator?.status as CoordinatorStatus) || 'none';

  const imageMap = new Map(
    (verificationDto.images || []).map(img => [img.image_type, img]),
  );

  const slotConfigs: Array<{
    imageType: VerificationImageType;
    label: string;
    description: string;
  }> = [
    {
      imageType: 'mock_selfie',
      label: 'Photo Selfie',
      description: 'Clear frontal photo of your face for on-site visual identity match.',
    },
    {
      imageType: 'id_license',
      label: 'NRC / Citizen ID',
      description: 'Official national identity card (front and back clearly legible).',
    },
    {
      imageType: 'driver_license',
      label: "Driver's License (Optional)",
      description: 'Required if volunteering for logistics or transport roles.',
    },
  ];

  const imageSlots: VerificationImageSlot[] = slotConfigs.map(cfg => {
    const record = imageMap.get(cfg.imageType);
    return {
      imageType: cfg.imageType,
      label: cfg.label,
      description: cfg.description,
      status: record ? normalizeVerificationStatus(record.status) : 'none',
      fileFormat: 'jpeg',
      uploadedAt: record ? record.created_at : undefined,
    };
  });

  return {
    verificationStatus: verifStatus,
    coordinatorStatus: coordStatus,
    canApplyForCoordinator: verifStatus === 'verified',
    imageSlots,
    coordinatorApplicationNote: coordinatorEnvelope?.coordinator?.notes ?? undefined,
  };
}

  private metrics: CoordinatorOverviewMetrics;

  private assignments: CoordinatorAssignmentItem[];
  private attendance: CoordinatorAttendanceItem[];

    initialEvents: CoordinatorEventDetail[] = createCoordinatorEventsFixture(),

    this.metrics = deepClone(initialMetrics);
    this.applications = deepClone(initialApplications);
    this.assignments = deepClone(initialAssignments);
    this.attendance = deepClone(initialAttendance);
    this.coordinatorIdentity = options?.coordinatorIdentity
      ? { ...options.coordinatorIdentity }
      : {
          id: approvedCoordinatorUser.id,
          displayName: approvedCoordinatorUser.displayName,
          email: approvedCoordinatorUser.email,
        };
    this.idGenerator = options?.idGenerator ?? createSequentialIdGenerator(1000);
    this.clock = options?.clock ?? (() => new Date());
  }

  public reset(
    events?: CoordinatorEventDetail[],
    metrics?: CoordinatorOverviewMetrics,
    applications?: CoordinatorApplicationItem[],
    assignments?: CoordinatorAssignmentItem[],
    attendance?: CoordinatorAttendanceItem[],
    options?: MockCoordinatorRepositoryOptions,
  ): void {
    this.events = deepClone(events ?? createCoordinatorEventsFixture());
    this.metrics = deepClone(metrics ?? createCoordinatorMetricsFixture());
    this.applications = deepClone(
      applications ?? createCoordinatorApplicationsFixture(),
    );
    this.assignments = deepClone(
      assignments ?? createCoordinatorAssignmentsFixture(),
    );
    this.attendance = deepClone(
      attendance ?? createCoordinatorAttendanceFixture(),
    );
    if (options?.coordinatorIdentity) {
      this.coordinatorIdentity = { ...options.coordinatorIdentity };
    }
    if (options?.idGenerator) {
      this.idGenerator = options.idGenerator;
    } else {
      this.idGenerator = createSequentialIdGenerator(1000);
    }
    if (options?.clock) {
      this.clock = options.clock;
    }
  }

  public seed(data: {
    events?: CoordinatorEventDetail[];
    metrics?: CoordinatorOverviewMetrics;
    applications?: CoordinatorApplicationItem[];
    assignments?: CoordinatorAssignmentItem[];
    attendance?: CoordinatorAttendanceItem[];
    coordinatorIdentity?: MockCoordinatorIdentity;
    idGenerator?: IdGenerator;
    clock?: Clock;
  }): void {
    this.reset(
      data.events,
      data.metrics,
      data.applications,
      data.assignments,
      data.attendance,
      {
        coordinatorIdentity: data.coordinatorIdentity,
        idGenerator: data.idGenerator,
        clock: data.clock,
      },
    );
  }

  public async createDraftEvent(
    draft: CreateEventWizardDraft,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>> {
    // 1. Validate charity categories count (must be between 1 and 3)
    if (
      !draft.charityFieldCodes ||
      draft.charityFieldCodes.length < 1 ||
      draft.charityFieldCodes.length > 3
    ) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Ensure between 1 and 3 charity fields are provided.',
      };
    }

    // 2. Validate schedule: end must be later than start
    const startTime = new Date(draft.startAt).getTime();
    const endTime = new Date(draft.endAt).getTime();
    if (isNaN(startTime) || isNaN(endTime) || endTime <= startTime) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Event end time must be later than start time.',
      };
    }

    if (draft.applicationDeadline) {
      const deadlineTime = new Date(draft.applicationDeadline).getTime();
      if (!isNaN(deadlineTime) && deadlineTime > startTime) {
        return {
          success: false,
          message:
            'Application deadline must be on or before the event start time.',
        };
      }
    }

    // 3. Validate geoRadius contract: 20 to 5000 meters
    if (
      draft.geoRadiusM !== undefined &&
      (draft.geoRadiusM < 20 || draft.geoRadiusM > 5000)
    ) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Geofence radius must be between 20 and 5000 meters.',
      };
    }

    // 4. Create draft event using dynamic coordinator fixture identity
    const newEvent: CoordinatorEventDetail = {
      id: this.idGenerator('evt-draft'),
      title: draft.title.trim(),
      description: draft.description?.trim() ?? '',
      status: 'draft', // Forced to draft
      purposeType: draft.purposeType,
      startAt: draft.startAt,
      endAt: draft.endAt,
      applicationDeadline: draft.applicationDeadline,
      locationName: draft.locationName.trim(),
      landmarkText: draft.landmarkText?.trim(),
      charityFields: [...draft.charityFieldCodes],
      ownerId: this.coordinatorIdentity.id,
      currentCoordinatorId: this.coordinatorIdentity.id,
      coordinatorName: this.coordinatorIdentity.displayName,
      isOwnerAsMonitor: false,
      pendingApplicationCount: 0,
      acceptedApplicantCount: 0,
      assignedCount: 0,
      checkedInCount: 0,
      latitude: draft.latitude,
      longitude: draft.longitude,
      geoRadiusM: draft.geoRadiusM,
      geoCheckinEnabled: draft.geoCheckinEnabled,
      geoCheckinOpensBeforeMin: draft.geoCheckinOpensBeforeMin,
      requireCheckinConfirmation: draft.requireCheckinConfirmation,
      mapProvider: draft.mapProvider,
      acceptanceMode: draft.acceptanceMode,
      autoAssignEnabled: draft.autoAssignEnabled,
      groupSize: draft.groupSize,
      leaderStrategy: draft.leaderStrategy,
      maxParticipants: draft.maxParticipants,
      mealsProvided: draft.mealsProvided,
      lodgingProvided: draft.lodgingProvided,
      travelSupportProvided: draft.travelSupportProvided,
      compensationKind: draft.compensationKind,
      compensationNote: draft.compensationNote?.trim(),
      onboardingText: draft.onboardingText?.trim(),
      onboardingVersion: 1, // Forced to 1
      requireOnboardingAck: draft.requireOnboardingAck,
      qrRegistrationEnabled: draft.qrRegistrationEnabled,
      posts: [],
    };

    this.events.unshift(newEvent);
    this.metrics.totalEventsCount += 1;
    this.metrics.draftEventsCount += 1;

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(newEvent),
    };
  }

  public async updateEvent(
    eventId: string,
    data: Partial<CreateEventWizardDraft>,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>> {
    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === eventId);
    if (!event) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Event not found',
      };
    }
    if (data.title !== undefined) event.title = data.title.trim();
    if (data.description !== undefined)
      event.description = data.description.trim();
    if (data.locationName !== undefined)
      event.locationName = data.locationName.trim();
    if (data.onboardingText !== undefined) {
      event.onboardingText = data.onboardingText.trim();
      event.onboardingVersion = (event.onboardingVersion || 1) + 1;
    }
    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(event),
    };
  }

  public async transitionEventStatus(
    eventId: string,
    targetStatus: CoordinatorEventStatus,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>> {
    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === eventId);
    if (!event) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Event not found',
      };
    }

    // Owner-as-monitor guard: writes and transitions are disabled
    if (event.isOwnerAsMonitor) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Action disabled in read-only monitor mode. Coordination is held by another coordinator.',
      };
    }

    // Lifecycle state machine validation
    const current = event.status;
    const allowed = getAllowedTransitions(current);
    if (!allowed.includes(targetStatus)) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: `Invalid transition from ${current} to ${targetStatus}`,
      };
    }

    event.status = targetStatus;

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(event),
    };
  }

  public async getApplications(
    eventId?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorApplicationItem[]> {
    const list = eventId
      ? this.applications.filter(a => a.eventId === eventId)
      : this.applications;
    return deepClone(list);
  }

  public async updateApplicationStatus(
    applicationId: string,
    status: CoordinatorApplicationStatus,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorApplicationItem>> {
    const app = this.applications.find(a => a.id === applicationId);
    if (!app) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Application not found',
      };
    }

    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === app.eventId);
    if (event?.isOwnerAsMonitor) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Action disabled in read-only monitor mode. Coordination is held by another coordinator.',
      };
    }

    app.status = status;

    // Enforce privacy rule: T2 capabilities appear only for accepted applicants
    if (status === 'accepted') {
      if (!app.t2Capabilities) {
        app.t2Capabilities = {
          skills: ['general_assistance', 'community_outreach'],
          physicalOk: true,
          goodEyesight: true,
          needsGlasses: false,
          canLiftHeavy: false,
          canWorkOutdoor: true,
          hasLeaderExperience: false,
          newToVolunteer: false,
          preferredLanguage: 'my',
          homeArea: 'Yangon',
          needsMealSupport: true,
          needsTravelSupport: false,
          acceptsUnpaid: true,
          verificationStatus: 'verified',
        };
      }
    } else {
      // Remove T2 semi-private capabilities for pending/waitlisted/rejected applicants
      delete app.t2Capabilities;
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(app),
    };
  }

  public async getAssignments(
    eventId?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorAssignmentItem[]> {
    const list = eventId
      ? this.assignments.filter(a => a.eventId === eventId)
      : this.assignments;
    return deepClone(list);
  }

  public async getUnassignedApplications(
    eventId?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorApplicationItem[]> {
    const acceptedApps = this.applications.filter(
      a =>
        a.status === 'accepted' &&
        (!eventId || a.eventId === eventId) &&
        !this.assignments.some(
          asg => asg.applicationId === a.id && asg.status !== 'cancelled',
        ),
    );
    return deepClone(acceptedApps);
  }

  public async runAutoAssignment(
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAssignmentItem[]>> {
    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === eventId);
    if (!event) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Event not found',
      };
    }

    if (event.isOwnerAsMonitor) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Action disabled in read-only monitor mode. Coordination is held by another coordinator.',
      };
    }

    const unassigned = await this.getUnassignedApplications(eventId);
    if (unassigned.length === 0) {
      return {
        success: true,
        message: 'All accepted volunteers are already assigned.',
        data: [],
      };
    }

    const created: CoordinatorAssignmentItem[] = [];
    unassigned.forEach((app, index) => {
      const newAsg: CoordinatorAssignmentItem = {
        id: this.idGenerator('asg-auto'),
        eventId: app.eventId,
        eventTitle: app.eventTitle,
        applicationId: app.id,
        userId: app.userId,
        volunteerName: app.applicantName,
        postId: app.postId ?? 'post-default',
        postTitle: app.postTitle ?? 'General Volunteer Support',
        status: 'assigned',
        groupCode: `GRP-${String.fromCharCode(65 + (index % 3))}`,
        isGroupLeader: index === 0,
        assignedAt: this.clock().toISOString(),
      };
      this.assignments.push(newAsg);
      created.push(newAsg);
    });

    event.assignedCount += created.length;

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(created),
    };
  }

  public async assignVolunteerManually(
    applicationId: string,
    postId: string,
    groupCode = 'GRP-MANUAL',
    isGroupLeader = false,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAssignmentItem>> {
    const app = this.applications.find(a => a.id === applicationId);
    if (!app) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Application not found',
      };
    }

    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === app.eventId);
    if (event?.isOwnerAsMonitor) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Action disabled in read-only monitor mode. Coordination is held by another coordinator.',
      };
    }

    if (app.status !== 'accepted') {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Only accepted applicants may be assigned to posts.',
      };
    }

    const newAsg: CoordinatorAssignmentItem = {
      id: this.idGenerator('asg-manual'),
      eventId: app.eventId,
      eventTitle: app.eventTitle,
      applicationId: app.id,
      userId: app.userId,
      volunteerName: app.applicantName,
      postId: postId,
      postTitle: app.postTitle ?? 'Volunteer Post',
      status: 'assigned',
      groupCode,
      isGroupLeader,
      assignedAt: this.clock().toISOString(),
    };

    this.assignments.push(newAsg);
    if (event) {
      event.assignedCount += 1;
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(newAsg),
    };
  }

  public async cancelAssignment(
    assignmentId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAssignmentItem>> {
    const asg = this.assignments.find(a => a.id === assignmentId);
    if (!asg) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Assignment not found',
      };
    }

    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === asg.eventId);
    if (event?.isOwnerAsMonitor) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Action disabled in read-only monitor mode. Coordination is held by another coordinator.',
      };
    }

    if (asg.status === 'completed') {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Completed assignments cannot be cancelled.',
      };
    }

    asg.status = 'cancelled';
    if (event && event.assignedCount > 0) {
      event.assignedCount -= 1;
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(asg),
    };
  }

  public async confirmGeoAttendance(
    attendanceId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>> {
    const record = this.attendance.find(a => a.id === attendanceId);
    if (!record) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Attendance record not found',
      };
    }

    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === record.eventId);
    if (event?.isOwnerAsMonitor) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Action disabled in read-only monitor mode. Coordination is held by another coordinator.',
      };
    }

    record.status = 'checked_in';
    record.isPendingGeoConfirmation = false;
    record.checkedInAt = this.clock().toISOString();
    if (record.geoAttempt) {
      record.geoAttempt.confirmationStatus = 'confirmed';
    }

    if (event) {
      event.checkedInCount += 1;
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(record),
    };
  }

  public async rejectGeoAttendance(
    attendanceId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>> {
    const record = this.attendance.find(a => a.id === attendanceId);
    if (!record) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Attendance record not found',
      };
    }

    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === record.eventId);
    if (event?.isOwnerAsMonitor) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Action disabled in read-only monitor mode. Coordination is held by another coordinator.',
      };
    }

    record.status = 'scheduled';
    record.isPendingGeoConfirmation = false;
    if (record.geoAttempt) {
      record.geoAttempt.confirmationStatus = 'rejected';
      record.geoAttempt.note = 'Rejected by coordinator in on-site verification.';
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(record),
    };
  }

  public async manualCheckIn(
    attendanceId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorAttendanceItem>> {
    const record = this.attendance.find(a => a.id === attendanceId);
    if (!record) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Attendance record not found',
      };
    }

    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === record.eventId);
    if (event?.isOwnerAsMonitor) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Action disabled in read-only monitor mode. Coordination is held by another coordinator.',
      };
    }

    record.status = 'checked_in';
    record.checkInMethod = 'manual';
    record.checkedInAt = this.clock().toISOString();
    record.isPendingGeoConfirmation = false;

    if (event) {
      event.checkedInCount += 1;
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(record),
    };
  }

  public async handoverEvent(
    eventId: string,
    newCoordinatorUserId: string,
    _reason?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult> {
    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === eventId);
    if (!event) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Event not found',
      };
    }

    event.currentCoordinatorId = newCoordinatorUserId;
    event.isOwnerAsMonitor = true;

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Event handed over successfully',
    };
  }

  public async retakeEvent(
    eventId: string,
    _reason?: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult> {
    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === eventId);
    if (!event) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Event not found',
      };
    }

    event.currentCoordinatorId = event.ownerId;
    event.isOwnerAsMonitor = false;

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Event retaken successfully',
    };
  }

  public async createEventPost(
    eventId: string,
    post: {
      title: string;
      requiredHeadcount: number;
      physicalLevel?: string;
      requiredSkills?: string[];
      leaderNeeded?: boolean;
      newVolunteersAllowed?: boolean;
    },
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<EventPost>> {
    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === eventId);
    if (!event) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Event not found',
      };
    }
    const newPost: EventPost = {
      id: this.idGenerator('post'),
      eventId,
      title: post.title,
      requiredHeadcount: post.requiredHeadcount,
      filledHeadcount: 0,
      remainingCapacity: post.requiredHeadcount,
      physicalLevel: (post.physicalLevel as any) || 'light',
      requiredSkills: post.requiredSkills || [],
      leaderNeeded: post.leaderNeeded ?? false,
      newVolunteersAllowed: post.newVolunteersAllowed ?? true,
      status: 'open',
    };
    event.posts.push(newPost);
    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(newPost),
    };
  }

  public async updateEventPost(
    postId: string,
    updates: {
      requiredHeadcount?: number;
      status?: string;
      physicalLevel?: string;
      requiredSkills?: string[];
    },
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<EventPost>> {
    for (const event of this.events) {
      const post = event.posts.find(p => p.id === postId);
      if (post) {
        if (updates.requiredHeadcount !== undefined) {
          post.requiredHeadcount = updates.requiredHeadcount;
          post.remainingCapacity = Math.max(
            0,
            post.requiredHeadcount - post.filledHeadcount,
          );
        }
        if (updates.status !== undefined) post.status = updates.status as any;
        if (updates.physicalLevel !== undefined)
          post.physicalLevel = updates.physicalLevel as any;
        if (updates.requiredSkills !== undefined)
          post.requiredSkills = updates.requiredSkills;
        return {
          success: true,
          message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
          data: deepClone(post),
        };
      }
    }
    return {
      success: false,
      message: 'Post not found',
    };
  }

  public async closeEventPost(
    postId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<void>> {
    for (const event of this.events) {
      const post = event.posts.find(p => p.id === postId);
      if (post) {
        post.status = 'closed';
        return {
          success: true,
          message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
        };
      }
    }
    return {
      success: false,
      message: 'Post not found',
    };
  }

    };
  }

function getAllowedTransitions(
  status: CoordinatorEventStatus,
): CoordinatorEventStatus[] {
  switch (status) {
    case 'draft':
      return ['published', 'cancelled'];
    case 'published':
      return ['active', 'cancelled'];
    case 'active':
      return ['completed', 'cancelled'];
    case 'completed':
    case 'cancelled':
    default:
      return [];
  }
}

export class MockEventRepository implements EventRepository {
  private events: EventDetail[];
  private applications: VolunteerApplicationItem[];
  private assignments: VolunteerAssignmentItem[];
  private idGenerator: IdGenerator;
  private clock: Clock;
  private acknowledgedOnboarding: Set<string> = new Set();

  constructor(
    initialData: EventDetail[] = createEventsFixture(),
    initialApps: VolunteerApplicationItem[] = initialVolunteerApplications,
    initialAssignments: VolunteerAssignmentItem[] = initialVolunteerAssignments,
    options?: MockEventRepositoryOptions,
  ) {
    this.events = deepClone(initialData);
    this.applications = deepClone(initialApps);
    this.assignments = deepClone(initialAssignments);
    this.idGenerator = options?.idGenerator ?? createSequentialIdGenerator(2000);
    this.clock = options?.clock ?? (() => new Date());
  }

  public reset(
    data?: EventDetail[],
    apps?: VolunteerApplicationItem[],
    assignments?: VolunteerAssignmentItem[],
    options?: MockEventRepositoryOptions,
  ): void {
    this.events = deepClone(data ?? createEventsFixture());
    this.applications = deepClone(apps ?? initialVolunteerApplications);
    this.assignments = deepClone(assignments ?? initialVolunteerAssignments);
    if (options?.idGenerator) {
      this.idGenerator = options.idGenerator;
    } else {
