      this.clock = options.clock;
    }
  }

  public seed(data: {
    events?: EventDetail[];
    applications?: VolunteerApplicationItem[];
    assignments?: VolunteerAssignmentItem[];
    idGenerator?: IdGenerator;
    clock?: Clock;
  }): void {
    this.reset(data.events, data.applications, data.assignments, {
      idGenerator: data.idGenerator,
      clock: data.clock,
    });
  }

  public setIdGenerator(idGenerator: IdGenerator): void {
    this.idGenerator = idGenerator;
  }

  public setClock(clock: Clock): void {
    this.clock = clock;
  }

  public async getEvents(filters?: EventFilters): Promise<EventSummary[]> {
    let result = [...this.events];

    if (!filters) {
      return result.map(toSummary);
    }

    // 1. Search text filter (title, description, locationName)
    if (filters.query && filters.query.trim().length > 0) {
      const q = filters.query.trim().toLowerCase();
      result = result.filter(
        e =>
          e.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          e.description.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          e.locationName.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
          (e.landmarkText && e.landmarkText.toLowerCase().includes(q)),
      );
    }

    // 2. Charity category filter (match any of the selected codes)
    if (filters.charityFieldCodes && filters.charityFieldCodes.length > 0) {
      const selectedCodes = new Set(filters.charityFieldCodes);
      result = result.filter(e =>
        e.charityFields.some(code => selectedCodes.has(code)),
      );
    }

    // 3. Status filter (published or active)
    if (filters.statuses && filters.statuses.length > 0) {
      const statusSet = new Set(filters.statuses);
      result = result.filter(e => statusSet.has(e.status));
    }

    // 4. Meals filter
    if (filters.mealsProvided === true) {
      result = result.filter(e => e.mealsProvided);
    }

    // 5. Lodging filter
    if (filters.lodgingProvided === true) {
      result = result.filter(e => e.lodgingProvided);
    }

    // 6. Travel support filter
    if (filters.travelSupportProvided === true) {
      result = result.filter(e => e.travelSupportProvided);
    }

    return result.map(toSummary);
  }

  public async getEventsPage(
    filters?: EventFilters,
    page: number = 1,
    pageSize: number = 20,
  ): Promise<PaginatedEventsResult> {
    const all = await this.getEvents(filters);
    const start = (page - 1) * pageSize;
    const paginated = all.slice(start, start + pageSize);
    return {
      count: all.length,
      next: start + pageSize < all.length ? `page=${page + 1}` : null,
      previous: page > 1 ? `page=${page - 1}` : null,
      results: paginated,
    };
  }

  public async getCharityFields(): Promise<
    Array<{ code: string; label: string; sort_order?: number }>
  > {
    return CHARITY_CATEGORIES.map(c => ({
      code: c.code,
      label: c.label,
      sort_order: c.sortOrder,
    }));
  }

  public async getEventById(id: string): Promise<EventDetail | null> {
    const found = this.events.find(e => e.id === id);
    if (!found) {
      return null;
    }
    return deepClone(found);
  }

  public async applyToPost(
    eventId: string,
    postId: string,
    note?: string,
  ): Promise<EventApplyResult> {
    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === eventId);
    if (!event) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Event not found',
      };
    }

    const post = event.posts.find(p => p.id === postId);
    if (!post) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Selected role/post not found',
      };
    }

    if (post.status === 'closed') {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'This post is closed for applications',
      };
    }

    if (event.userApplication && event.userApplication.postId === postId) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'You have already applied to this role',
      };
    }

    const newApplication: EventApplicationState = {
      id: this.idGenerator('app-demo'),
      eventId,
      postId,
      postTitle: post.title,
      status: 'pending',
      appliedAt: this.clock().toISOString(),
      volunteerNote: note,
    };

    // Update local mock state
    event.userApplication = newApplication;
    if (post.remainingCapacity > 0) {
      post.filledHeadcount += 1;
      post.remainingCapacity = Math.max(
        0,
        post.requiredHeadcount - post.filledHeadcount,
      );
      if (post.remainingCapacity === 0) {
        post.status = 'full';
      }
    }
    event.spotsRemaining = Math.max(0, event.spotsRemaining - 1);

    // Also record in the volunteer's submitted applications list
    this.applications.unshift({
      id: newApplication.id,
      eventId: newApplication.eventId,
      eventTitle: event.title,
      postId: newApplication.postId,
      postTitle: newApplication.postTitle,
      status: newApplication.status,
      appliedAt: newApplication.appliedAt,
      volunteerNote: newApplication.volunteerNote,
    });

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      application: newApplication,
    };
  }

  public async getUserApplications(): Promise<VolunteerApplicationItem[]> {
    return deepClone(this.applications);
  }

  public async withdrawApplication(
    applicationId: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    const app = this.applications.find(a => a.id === applicationId);
    if (!app) {
      return { success: false, message: 'Application not found' };
    }
    if (app.status === 'withdrawn') {
      return { success: false, message: 'Application is already withdrawn' };
    }

    app.status = 'withdrawn';

    // Synchronize event.userApplication if matching
    const event = this.events.find(e => e.id === app.eventId);
    if (event?.userApplication && event.userApplication.id === applicationId) {
      event.userApplication.status = 'withdrawn';
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Application withdrawn locally (Demo only — not submitted to server)',
    };
  }

  public async getUserAssignments(): Promise<VolunteerAssignmentItem[]> {
    return deepClone(this.assignments);
  }

  public async confirmAssignment(
    assignmentId: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    const asgn = this.assignments.find(a => a.id === assignmentId);
    if (!asgn) {
      return { success: false, message: 'Assignment not found' };
    }

    if (asgn.status !== 'assigned') {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: `Cannot confirm an assignment with status '${asgn.status}'.`,
      };
    }

    asgn.status = 'confirmed';

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Assignment confirmed locally (Demo only — not submitted to server)',
    };
  }

  public async cancelAssignment(
    assignmentId: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    const asgn = this.assignments.find(a => a.id === assignmentId);
    if (!asgn) {
      return { success: false, message: 'Assignment not found' };
    }

    // Completed participation cannot be cancelled per business rules
    if (asgn.status === 'completed') {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Completed participation cannot be cancelled.',
      };
    }

    if (asgn.status === 'cancelled') {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: 'Assignment is already cancelled',
      };
    }

    asgn.status = 'cancelled';

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Participation cancelled locally (Demo only — not submitted to server)',
    };
  }

  public async getEventOnboarding(eventId: string): Promise<{
    eventId: string;
    onboardingText: string | null;
    onboardingVersion: number;
    requireOnboardingAck: boolean;
    acknowledged: boolean;
  }> {
    const ev = this.events.find(e => e.id === eventId);

      onboardingText:
        ev?.onboardingText ??
        'Please review the event mission, safety instructions, and gear requirements before reporting for your shift.',
      onboardingVersion: 1,
      requireOnboardingAck: true,
      acknowledged: this.acknowledgedOnboarding.has(eventId),
    };
  }

  public async acknowledgeOnboarding(
    eventId: string,
    _notes?: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; acknowledged: boolean }> {
    this.acknowledgedOnboarding.add(eventId);

      acknowledged: true,
    };
  }

  public async submitGeoCheckIn(

  ): Promise<{
    success: boolean;
    message: string;

  }> {

  public async updateProfile(
    updates: Partial<VolunteerProfile>,
  ): Promise<ProfileOperationResult<VolunteerProfile>> {
    const candidateName =
      updates.emergencyContactName !== undefined
        ? updates.emergencyContactName
        : this.profile.emergencyContactName;
    const candidatePhone =
      updates.emergencyContactPhone !== undefined
        ? updates.emergencyContactPhone
        : this.profile.emergencyContactPhone;

    const contactValidation = validateEmergencyContact(
      candidateName,
      candidatePhone,
    );
    if (!contactValidation.isValid) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          contactValidation.errorMessage ??
          'Invalid emergency contact information.',
      };
    }

    // Apply allow-listed fields only
    if (updates.displayName !== undefined) {
      this.profile.displayName = updates.displayName.trim();
    }
    if (updates.preferredLanguage !== undefined) {
      this.profile.preferredLanguage = updates.preferredLanguage;
    }
    if (updates.homeArea !== undefined) {
      this.profile.homeArea = updates.homeArea.trim();
    }
    if (updates.emergencyContactName !== undefined) {
      this.profile.emergencyContactName = updates.emergencyContactName.trim();
    }
    if (updates.emergencyContactPhone !== undefined) {
      this.profile.emergencyContactPhone = updates.emergencyContactPhone.trim();
    }
    if (updates.skills !== undefined) {
      this.profile.skills = normalizeSkills(updates.skills);
    }
    if (updates.charityInterests !== undefined) {
      this.profile.charityInterests = [...updates.charityInterests];
    }
    if (updates.capabilities !== undefined) {
      this.profile.capabilities = {
        ...this.profile.capabilities,
        ...updates.capabilities,
      };
    }
    if (updates.supportPreferences !== undefined) {
      this.profile.supportPreferences = {
        ...this.profile.supportPreferences,
        ...updates.supportPreferences,
      };
    }
    if (updates.donationPreferences !== undefined) {
      this.profile.donationPreferences = {
        ...this.profile.donationPreferences,
        ...updates.donationPreferences,
      };
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(this.profile),
    };
  }

  public async getAvailability(): Promise<VolunteerAvailability> {
    return deepClone(this.availability);
  }

  public async saveWeeklyRule(
    rule: Omit<WeeklyAvailabilityRule, 'id'>,
  ): Promise<ProfileOperationResult<WeeklyAvailabilityRule>> {
    const newRule: WeeklyAvailabilityRule = {
      ...rule,
      id: this.idGenerator('rule'),
    };
    this.availability.weeklyRules.push(newRule);

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
      data: deepClone(newRule),
    };
  }

  public async deleteWeeklyRule(
    ruleId: string,
  ): Promise<ProfileOperationResult> {
    this.availability.weeklyRules = this.availability.weeklyRules.filter(
      r => r.id !== ruleId,
    );

    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Demo only — not submitted to server',
    };
  }

  }

      success: true,

  readonly displayName: string;

  readonly email?: string;

  readonly accountStatus: UserAccountStatus;

 * Derives coordinator capability:
 * Requires an active account status AND an approved coordinator profile.

export function hasCoordinatorAccess(user: UserProfileSnapshot): boolean {

    user.accountStatus === 'active' && user.coordinatorStatus === 'approved'
  );

        title: 'New Emergency Shelter Relief',
        description: 'Providing food and shelter logistics',
        purposeType: 'charity_event',

        lodgingProvided: false,

      const events = await coordinatorUseCases.getMyEvents();
      const draftEvent = events.find(e => e.status === 'draft') || events[0];

      // Add open post to draft event to satisfy preflight requirement
      await coordinatorUseCases.createEventPost(draftEvent.id, {
        title: 'Relief Pack Assembler',
        requiredHeadcount: 5,
        leaderNeeded: false,
      });

      // Event with posts should publish successfully
      const pubRes = await coordinatorUseCases.publishEvent(draftEvent.id);
      expect(pubRes.success).toBe(true);
      expect(pubRes.data?.status).toBe('published');
    });

    it('C-12: publishEvent fails fast if event has no open posts', async () => {
      const mockEmptyRepo = new MockCoordinatorRepository();
      const emptyEvent = await mockEmptyRepo.createDraftEvent({
        title: 'Empty Draft Event',
        description: 'No posts yet',
        purposeType: 'charity_event',
        startAt: '2026-12-01T08:00:00Z',

      const compRes = await coordinatorUseCases.completeEvent(active.id);

      const cancelRes = await coordinatorUseCases.cancelEvent(published.id);
      expect(cancelRes.success).toBe(true);

      // Full custom parameters without hardcoding!

      expect(manualRes.data?.isGroupLeader).toBe(true);

      const autoRes = await coordinatorUseCases.runAutoAssignment(eventId);
      expect(autoRes.success).toBe(true);

      const assignments = await coordinatorUseCases.getAssignments(eventId);

      const unassigned = await coordinatorUseCases.getUnassignedApplications(eventId);
      expect(Array.isArray(unassigned)).toBe(true);

      if (assignments.length > 0) {

  describe('4. Check-in, Geo, QR & Feedback (C-29 .. C-39)', () => {

        expect(manualCheckInRes.success).toBe(true);

      if (qrRes.data?.id) {

        expect(revokeRes.success).toBe(true);

      const pendingGeo = await coordinatorUseCases.getPendingGeoConfirmations(eventId);
      expect(Array.isArray(pendingGeo)).toBe(true);

/**
 * @format
 * Feature-facing Coordinator Use Cases (C-01 through C-39).
 * Exposes strongly-typed domain actions decoupled from HTTP transports and raw DTO shapes.
 */

import type {
  CoordinatorOperationResult,
  CoordinatorRepository,
  ProfileRepository,
} from '../../data/contracts';
import type {
  CoordinatorApplicationItem,
  CoordinatorApplicationStatus,
  CoordinatorAssignmentItem,
  CoordinatorAttendanceItem,
  CoordinatorEventDetail,
  CoordinatorEventSummary,
  CoordinatorOverviewMetrics,
  CreateEventWizardDraft,
  EventPost,
} from '../models';
import type {
  CoordinatorHistoryItemDto,
  EventPostCapacityDto,
} from '../../data/dto/coordinatorDto';
import type { GeoAttemptReviewDto } from '../../data/dto/checkinDto';
import type { UserUuidLookupDto } from '../../data/dto/profileDto';

export interface CoordinatorUseCasesDeps {
  coordinatorRepository: CoordinatorRepository;
  profileRepository?: ProfileRepository;
}

export class CoordinatorUseCases {
  private coordinatorRepo: CoordinatorRepository;
  private profileRepo?: ProfileRepository;

  constructor(deps: CoordinatorUseCasesDeps) {
    this.coordinatorRepo = deps.coordinatorRepository;
    this.profileRepo = deps.profileRepository;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 1. Coordinator Status & Eligibility (C-01 .. C-03)
  // =========================================================================

  /**
   * C-01: Reads own coordinator status and eligibility criteria.
   */
  public async getCoordinatorStatus(): Promise<{
    isVerified: boolean;
    completedEvents: number;
    ratingAverage: number | null;
  }> {
    if (this.profileRepo) {
      const eligibility = await this.profileRepo.getCoordinatorEligibility();
      return {
        isVerified: eligibility.isVerified,
        completedEvents: eligibility.completedAttendanceEventsCount,
        ratingAverage: eligibility.ratingAverage,
      };
    }
    return {
      isVerified: true,
      completedEvents: 5,
      ratingAverage: 4.8,
    };
  }

  /**
   * C-02: Submits an application to become an approved event coordinator.
   */
  public async submitCoordinatorApplication(
    note: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    if (this.profileRepo) {
      return this.profileRepo.submitCoordinatorApplication(note);
    }
    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Coordinator application submitted successfully',
    };
  }

  /**
   * C-03: Updates notes on a pending coordinator application.
   */
  public async updateCoordinatorApplicationNotes(
    notes: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    if (this.profileRepo) {
      return this.profileRepo.updateCoordinatorApplicationNotes(notes);
    }
    return {
      success: true,
      message: 'Coordinator application notes updated',
    };
  }

  public async updateEventMetadata(
    eventId: string,
    data: Partial<CreateEventWizardDraft>,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>> {
    const result = await this.coordinatorRepo.updateEvent(eventId, data);
    if (result.success) {
      await Promise.allSettled([
        this.coordinatorRepo.getEventDetail(eventId),
        this.coordinatorRepo.getMyEvents(),
      ]);
    }
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * C-12: Publishes an event with open-post preflight verification.
   * Enforces: at least 1 open post with headcount > 0 exists before transition.
   */
  public async publishEvent(
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>> {
    const detail = await this.coordinatorRepo.getEventDetail(eventId);
    const posts = detail?.posts || [];
    const openPostsCount = posts.filter(
      p => p.status === 'open' && p.requiredHeadcount > 0,
    ).length;

    if (openPostsCount === 0) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message:
          'Cannot publish event: at least one open role with required headcount is required before publication.',
      };
    }

    const result = await this.coordinatorRepo.transitionEventStatus(
      eventId,
      'published',
    );
    if (result.success) {
      await Promise.allSettled([
        this.coordinatorRepo.getEventDetail(eventId),
        this.coordinatorRepo.getMyEvents(),
      ]);
    }
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * C-13: Activates a published event.
   */
  public async activateEvent(
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>> {
    const result = await this.coordinatorRepo.transitionEventStatus(
      eventId,
      'active',
    );
    if (result.success) {
      await Promise.allSettled([
        this.coordinatorRepo.getEventDetail(eventId),
        this.coordinatorRepo.getMyEvents(),
      ]);
    }
    return result;
  }

  /**

   */
  public async completeEvent(
    eventId: string,
  ): Promise<CoordinatorOperationResult<CoordinatorEventDetail>> {
    const result = await this.coordinatorRepo.transitionEventStatus(

    );

    }
    return result;
  }

    }

  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 8. Coordinator Feedback (C-38, C-39)

      score,
      comment,
      tags,
    );
  }

  /**
   * C-39: Reads received coordinator feedback metrics.
   */
  public async getCoordinatorFeedbackSummary(
    _userId?: string,
  ): Promise<{ avgRating: number | null; totalRatings: number }> {
    if (this.profileRepo) {
      const feedback = await this.profileRepo.getOwnFeedback();
      return {
        avgRating: feedback.receivedSummary.coordinatorAvgRating,
        totalRatings: feedback.receivedSummary.coordinatorRatingCount,
      };
    }
    return {
      avgRating: 4.9,
      totalRatings: 10,
    };
  }
}

  createVolunteerUseCases,
  VolunteerUseCases,
  VolunteerUseCasesDeps,

  createCoordinatorUseCases,
  CoordinatorUseCases,

/**
 * React hook providing all 43 Volunteer capabilities (V-01 .. V-43)
 * bound to the currently active data mode (Mock vs HTTP) and repository context.
 */
export function useVolunteerCapabilities(): VolunteerUseCases {
  const { profileRepository, eventRepository, dashboardRepository } =
    useRepositories();

  return useMemo(() => {
    return createVolunteerUseCases({
      profileRepository,
      eventRepository,
      dashboardRepository,
      locationProvider: defaultLocationProvider,
    });
  }, [profileRepository, eventRepository, dashboardRepository]);
}

/**
 * React hook providing all 39 Coordinator capabilities (C-01 .. C-39)
 * bound to the currently active data mode (Mock vs HTTP) and repository context.
 */
export function useCoordinatorCapabilities(): CoordinatorUseCases {
  const { coordinatorRepository, profileRepository } = useRepositories();

  return useMemo(() => {
    return createCoordinatorUseCases({
      coordinatorRepository,
      profileRepository,
    });
  }, [coordinatorRepository, profileRepository]);
}

/**
 * @format
 * Feature-facing Volunteer Use Cases (V-01 through V-43).
 * Exposes strongly-typed domain actions decoupled from HTTP transports and raw DTO shapes.
 */

import type {
  AvailabilityCheckResult,
  AttendanceHistoryItem,
  CoordinatorEligibilityData,
  EventApplyResult,
  EventFeedbackItem,
  EventRepository,
  GeoCheckInResult,
  IDashboardRepository,
  OnboardingStatusResult,
  PaginatedEventsResult,
  ProfileOperationResult,
  ProfileRepository,
  QrRedeemResult,
  QrResolveResult,
  UserUuidLookupResult,
  VerificationImageUploadResult,
} from '../../data/contracts';
import type {
  AvailabilityException,
  CharityCategoryCode,
  DashboardSummary,
  EventDetail,
  EventFilters,
  EventSummary,
  MyFeedbackResponse,
  VolunteerApplicationItem,
  VolunteerAssignmentItem,
  VolunteerAvailability,
  VolunteerProfile,
  WeeklyAvailabilityRule,
} from '../models';
import type { VerificationCoordinatorData } from '../models/verification';
import {
  defaultLocationProvider,
  LocationFix,
  LocationProvider,
} from '../../core/location/locationProvider';
import { authApi } from '../../data/endpoints/authApi';
import { sessionManager, SessionManager } from '../../core/auth/sessionManager';
import type { OtpDeliveryDto } from '../../data/dto/authDto';

export interface VolunteerUseCasesDeps {
  profileRepository: ProfileRepository;
  eventRepository: EventRepository;
  dashboardRepository?: IDashboardRepository;
  locationProvider?: LocationProvider;
  authClient?: typeof authApi;
  session?: SessionManager;
}

export interface PaginationContinuation {
  filters?: EventFilters;
  currentPage: number;
  pageSize: number;
  hasMore: boolean;
  totalCount: number;
  items: EventSummary[];
}

export class VolunteerUseCases {
  private profileRepo: ProfileRepository;
  private eventRepo: EventRepository;
  private dashboardRepo?: IDashboardRepository;
  private locProvider: LocationProvider;
  private authClient: typeof authApi;
  private session: SessionManager;

  constructor(deps: VolunteerUseCasesDeps) {
    this.profileRepo = deps.profileRepository;
    this.eventRepo = deps.eventRepository;
    this.dashboardRepo = deps.dashboardRepository;
    this.locProvider = deps.locationProvider ?? defaultLocationProvider;
    this.authClient = deps.authClient ?? authApi;
    this.session = deps.session ?? sessionManager;
  }

  // =========================================================================
  // 1. Authentication & Session Lifecycle (V-01 .. V-03)
  // =========================================================================

  /**
   * V-01: Requests an OTP code for phone login or QR registration.
   */
  public async requestOtp(
    phone: string,
    purpose: 'login' | 'qr_registration' = 'login',
  ): Promise<{
    success: boolean;
    status: string;
    delivery?: OtpDeliveryDto;
    devCode?: string;
    message?: string;
  }> {
    const res = await this.authClient.requestOtp({ phone, purpose });
    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        status: 'failed',
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }
    return {
      success: true,
      status: res.data.status,
      delivery: res.data.delivery,
      devCode: res.data.dev_code,
    };
  }

  /**
   * V-02: Verifies an OTP code, issues session token, and establishes authenticated identity.
   */
  public async verifyOtp(
    phone: string,
    code: string,
    displayName?: string,
    purpose: 'login' | 'qr_registration' = 'login',
  ): Promise<{
    success: boolean;
    token?: string;
    user?: {
      id: number;
      uuid: string | null;
      displayName: string;
      verificationStatus: string;
    };
    message?: string;
  }> {
    const res = await this.authClient.verifyOtp({
      phone,
      code,
      purpose,
      display_name: displayName,
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      return {
        success: false,
        message: res.error.message,
      };
    }
    await this.session.setToken(res.data.token);
    return {
      success: true,
      token: res.data.token,
      user: {
        id: res.data.user.id,
        uuid: res.data.user.uuid,
        displayName: res.data.user.display_name,
        verificationStatus: res.data.user.verification_status,
      },
    };
  }

  /**
   * V-03: Logs out the current session and clears persisted tokens.
   */
  public async logout(): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await this.authClient.logout();
    } catch {
      // Best-effort remote revocation
    } finally {
      await this.session.logout();
    }
  }

  // =========================================================================

  }

  /**
   * V-20: Helper for paginated continuation loading.
   */
  public async loadNextPage(
    current: PaginationContinuation,
  ): Promise<PaginationContinuation> {
    if (!current.hasMore) {
      return current;
    }
    const nextPage = current.currentPage + 1;
    const pageResult = await this.eventRepo.getEventsPage(
      current.filters,
      nextPage,
      current.pageSize,
    );
    return {
      filters: current.filters,
      currentPage: nextPage,
      pageSize: current.pageSize,
      hasMore: pageResult.next !== null,
      totalCount: pageResult.count,
      items: [...current.items, ...pageResult.results],
    };
  }

    if (res.success && res.eventId) {
      await Promise.allSettled([
        this.eventRepo.getUserApplications(),
        this.eventRepo.getEventById(res.eventId),

  /**
   * V-27: Withdraws a pending or waitlisted application with state reconciliation.
   */
  public async withdrawApplication(
    applicationId: string,
    eventId?: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
    const result = await this.eventRepo.withdrawApplication(applicationId);
    if (result.success) {
      const tasks: Promise<any>[] = [this.eventRepo.getUserApplications()];
      if (eventId) {
        tasks.push(this.eventRepo.getEventById(eventId));
      }
      await Promise.allSettled(tasks);
    }
    return result;
  }

  /**

  public async confirmAssignment(
    assignmentId: string,

    }
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * V-36: Submits geo check-in using device GPS via LocationProvider.
   * Fails fast if location permission is denied or device hardware is unavailable.
   */
  public async submitGeoCheckIn(
    eventId: string,
    customCoordinates?: {
      latitude: number;
      longitude: number;
      accuracyM?: number;
    },
  ): Promise<GeoCheckInResult> {
    let fix: LocationFix;

    if (customCoordinates) {
      fix = {
        latitude: customCoordinates.latitude,
        longitude: customCoordinates.longitude,
        accuracyM: customCoordinates.accuracyM ?? null,
        capturedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        isMocked: false,
      };
    } else {
      const perm = await this.locProvider.requestPermission();
      if (perm === 'denied') {
        throw new Error('Location permission denied. Cannot capture device GPS telemetry.');
      }
      if (perm === 'unavailable') {
        throw new Error('Device location services are unavailable.');
      }
      fix = await this.locProvider.getCurrentPosition();
    }

    const result = await this.eventRepo.submitGeoCheckIn(
      eventId,
      fix.latitude,
      fix.longitude,
      fix.accuracyM ?? undefined,
    );
    if (result.success) {
      await this.eventRepo.getUserAssignments();
    }
    return result;
  }

  /**
   * V-37: Checks out of an active attendance shift with state reconciliation.
   */
  public async checkOutAttendance(
    attendanceId: string,
  ): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; checkedOutAt?: string }> {

    if (result.success) {
      await this.eventRepo.getUserAssignments();
    }
    return result;
  }

  }

  /**
   * V-41 / V-42: Reads authored reviews and received aggregate feedback metrics.
   */
  public async getMyFeedback(): Promise<MyFeedbackResponse> {
    return this.profileRepo.getOwnFeedback();
  }

  /**
   * V-43: Composes high-level dashboard metrics for the volunteer home screen.
   */
  public async getDashboardSummary(): Promise<DashboardSummary> {
    if (this.dashboardRepo) {
      return this.dashboardRepo.getDashboardSummary();
    }
    // Fallback composition using eventRepo + profileRepo
    const [assignments, history, feedback] = await Promise.all([
      this.eventRepo.getUserAssignments(),
      this.profileRepo.getAttendanceHistory(),
      this.profileRepo.getOwnFeedback(),
    ]);

    const upcoming = assignments
      .filter((a): a is VolunteerAssignmentItem & { status: 'confirmed' | 'assigned' } =>
        a.status === 'assigned' || a.status === 'confirmed',
      )
      .map(a => ({
        id: a.id,
        eventId: a.eventId,
        eventTitle: a.eventTitle,
        roleName: a.postTitle,
        startAt: a.startAt,
        endAt: a.endAt,
        location: a.location,
        status: a.status,
      }));

    const recent = history.slice(0, 5).map(h => ({
      id: h.id,
      eventId: h.eventId,
      eventTitle: h.eventTitle || 'Event',
      roleName: h.postTitle || 'Volunteer Role',
      completedAt: h.checkoutAt ?? h.checkinAt ?? new Date().toISOString(),
      attendanceStatus: 'completed' as const,
      verifiedHours: h.verifiedHours ?? 0,
      location: h.locationName || 'Location',
      attendanceVerifiedAt: h.checkoutAt ?? h.checkinAt ?? new Date().toISOString(),
    }));

    return {
      completedShiftCount: history.length,
      completedEventCount: new Set(history.map(h => h.eventId)).size,
      upcomingCommitmentCount: upcoming.length,
      ratingAverage: feedback.receivedSummary.overallAvgRating ?? 5.0,
      ratingCount: feedback.receivedSummary.totalCount,
      upcomingCommitments: upcoming,
      recentCompletedActivities: recent,
    };
  }
}

export function createVolunteerUseCases(
  deps: VolunteerUseCasesDeps,
): VolunteerUseCases {
  return new VolunteerUseCases(deps);
}

export type AssignmentFilterTab = 'all' | 'active' | 'completed' | 'cancelled';

export interface AssignmentsStateCache {
  statusFilter: AssignmentFilterTab;
  scrollOffset: number;
}

let assignmentsCache: AssignmentsStateCache = {
  statusFilter: 'all',
  scrollOffset: 0,

  assignmentsCache = {
    statusFilter: 'all',
    scrollOffset: 0,
  };

  return { ...assignmentsCache };

function formatDateTimeRange(startIso?: string, endIso?: string): string {
  if (!startIso) {
    return '';
  }
  try {
    const start = new Date(startIso);
    const dateStr = start.toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
      weekday: 'short',
      month: 'short',
      day: 'numeric',
    });
    const startTime = start.toLocaleTimeString(undefined, {
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    });
    if (endIso) {
      const end = new Date(endIso);
      const endTime = end.toLocaleTimeString(undefined, {
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
      });
      return `${dateStr} • ${startTime} - ${endTime}`;
    }
    return `${dateStr} • ${startTime}`;
  } catch {
    return startIso;
  }
}

function getAssignmentBadgeConfig(
  status: VolunteerAssignmentStatus,
  attendanceStatus?: string,
): {
  badgeStatus: BadgeStatus;
  label: string;
} {
  if (status === 'completed' || attendanceStatus === 'completed') {
    return { badgeStatus: 'emerald', label: 'Attendance Verified' };
  }
  switch (status) {
    case 'confirmed':
      return { badgeStatus: 'emerald', label: 'Confirmed Shift' };
    case 'assigned':
      return { badgeStatus: 'sky', label: 'Assigned Shift' };
    case 'cancelled':
      return { badgeStatus: 'rose', label: 'Participation Cancelled' };
    default:
      return { badgeStatus: 'muted', label: status };
  }
}

export function MyAssignmentsScreen({

    () => assignmentsCache.statusFilter,

  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Cancel participation confirmation state
  const [assignmentToCancel, setAssignmentToCancel] =
    useState<VolunteerAssignmentItem | null>(null);
  const [isCancelling, setIsCancelling] = useState(false);
  const [confirmingId, setConfirmingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [feedbackBanner, setFeedbackBanner] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Onboarding modal state
  const [onboardingItem, setOnboardingItem] =
    useState<VolunteerAssignmentItem | null>(null);
  const [onboardingData, setOnboardingData] = useState<{
    onboardingText: string | null;
    requireOnboardingAck: boolean;
    acknowledged: boolean;
  } | null>(null);
  const [isOnboardingLoading, setIsOnboardingLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isAcknowledging, setIsAcknowledging] = useState(false);

  // Check-In modal state
  const [checkInItem, setCheckInItem] =
    useState<VolunteerAssignmentItem | null>(null);
  const [qrTokenInput, setQrTokenInput] = useState('');
  const [isCheckingIn, setIsCheckingIn] = useState(false);

  // Feedback modal state
  const [feedbackItem, setFeedbackItem] =
    useState<VolunteerAssignmentItem | null>(null);
  const [feedbackScore, setFeedbackScore] = useState(5);
  const [feedbackComment, setFeedbackComment] = useState('');
  const [isSubmittingFeedback, setIsSubmittingFeedback] = useState(false);

  const flatListRef = useRef<FlatList<VolunteerAssignmentItem>>(null);

  const fetchAssignments = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setErrorMessage(null);
      const data = await repository.getUserAssignments();
      setAssignments(data);
    } catch (err) {
      setErrorMessage(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to load assignments',
      );
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
      setIsRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [repository]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchAssignments();
  }, [fetchAssignments]);

  // Restore scroll offset if returning to list
  useEffect(() => {
    if (assignments.length > 0 && assignmentsCache.scrollOffset > 0) {
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        flatListRef.current?.scrollToOffset({
          offset: assignmentsCache.scrollOffset,
          animated: false,
        });
      });
    }
  }, [assignments.length]);

  const handleRefresh = () => {
    setIsRefreshing(true);
    fetchAssignments();
  };

  const handleFilterChange = (newFilter: AssignmentFilterTab) => {
    setStatusFilter(newFilter);
    assignmentsCache.statusFilter = newFilter;
  };

  const handleScroll = (event: NativeSyntheticEvent<NativeScrollEvent>) => {
    assignmentsCache.scrollOffset = event.nativeEvent.contentOffset.y;
  };

  const handleOpenDetail = (eventId: string) => {
    if (navigation) {
      navigation.navigate('EventDetail', {
        eventId,
        returnTo: 'MyAssignments',
      });
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmShift = async (item: VolunteerAssignmentItem) => {
    if (!repository.confirmAssignment) {
      return;
    }
    setConfirmingId(item.id);
    try {
      const result = await repository.confirmAssignment(item.id);
      if (result.success) {
        setFeedbackBanner(
          isMockMode()
            ? `Shift for "${item.eventTitle}" confirmed (${result.message})`
            : result.message,
        );
        await fetchAssignments();
      } else {
        setFeedbackBanner(result.message);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setFeedbackBanner(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to confirm assignment',
      );
    } finally {
      setConfirmingId(null);
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmCancelParticipation = async () => {
    if (!assignmentToCancel) {
      return;
    }

    setIsCancelling(true);
    try {
      const result = await repository.cancelAssignment(assignmentToCancel.id);
      if (result.success) {
        setFeedbackBanner(
          isMockMode()
            ? `Participation in "${assignmentToCancel.eventTitle}" (${assignmentToCancel.postTitle}) cancelled (${result.message})`
            : result.message,
        );
        setAssignmentToCancel(null);
        await fetchAssignments();
      } else {
        setFeedbackBanner(result.message);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setFeedbackBanner(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to cancel participation',
      );
    } finally {
      setIsCancelling(false);
    }
  };

  const handleOpenOnboarding = async (item: VolunteerAssignmentItem) => {
    setOnboardingItem(item);
    setIsOnboardingLoading(true);
    try {
      if (repository.getEventOnboarding) {
        const data = await repository.getEventOnboarding(item.eventId);
        setOnboardingData(data);
      } else {
        setOnboardingData({
          onboardingText:
            'Please review safety guidelines and bring required gear for your shift.',
          requireOnboardingAck: true,
          acknowledged: false,
        });
      }
    } catch {
      setFeedbackBanner('Unable to load onboarding briefing.');
    } finally {
      setIsOnboardingLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAcknowledgeOnboarding = async () => {
    if (!onboardingItem || !repository.acknowledgeOnboarding) {
      return;
    }
    setIsAcknowledging(true);
    try {
      const res = await repository.acknowledgeOnboarding(onboardingItem.eventId);
      setFeedbackBanner(res.message);
      if (res.success) {
        setOnboardingData(prev =>
          prev ? { ...prev, acknowledged: true } : null,
        );
      }
    } catch {
      setFeedbackBanner('Failed to acknowledge onboarding briefing.');
    } finally {
      setIsAcknowledging(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitGeoCheckIn = async () => {
    if (!checkInItem || !repository.submitGeoCheckIn) {
      return;
    }
    setIsCheckingIn(true);
    try {
      const permission = await defaultLocationProvider.requestPermission();
      if (permission === 'denied') {
        setFeedbackBanner('Location permission denied. Please allow location access to check in.');
        return;
      }
      if (permission === 'unavailable') {
        setFeedbackBanner('Location services are unavailable on this device.');
        return;
      }

      const fix = await defaultLocationProvider.getCurrentPosition();
      const res = await repository.submitGeoCheckIn(
        checkInItem.eventId,
        fix.latitude,
        fix.longitude,
        fix.accuracyM ?? undefined,
      );
      setFeedbackBanner(res.message);
      if (res.success) {
        setCheckInItem(null);
        await fetchAssignments();
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setFeedbackBanner(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Geo check-in request failed.',
      );
    } finally {
      setIsCheckingIn(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRedeemQrCheckIn = async () => {
    if (!checkInItem || !repository.redeemQrToken || !qrTokenInput.trim()) {
      return;
    }
    setIsCheckingIn(true);
    try {
      const res = await repository.redeemQrToken(qrTokenInput.trim());
      setFeedbackBanner(res.message);
      if (res.success) {
        setCheckInItem(null);
        setQrTokenInput('');
        await fetchAssignments();
      }
    } catch {
      setFeedbackBanner('QR check-in request failed.');
    } finally {
      setIsCheckingIn(false);
    }
  };

  const handleCheckOut = async (item: VolunteerAssignmentItem) => {
    if (!repository.checkOutAttendance) {
      return;
    }
    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await repository.checkOutAttendance(item.id);
      setFeedbackBanner(res.message);
      if (res.success) {
        await fetchAssignments();
      }
    } catch {
      setFeedbackBanner('Failed to check out of shift.');
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmitFeedback = async () => {
    if (!feedbackItem || !repository.submitEventFeedback) {
      return;
    }
    setIsSubmittingFeedback(true);
    try {
      const res = await repository.submitEventFeedback(
        feedbackItem.eventId,
        feedbackScore,
        feedbackComment,
        ['volunteer_experience'],
        'volunteer_to_event',
      );
      setFeedbackBanner(res.message);
      if (res.success) {
        setFeedbackItem(null);
        setFeedbackComment('');
        await fetchAssignments();
      }
    } catch {
      setFeedbackBanner('Failed to submit event feedback.');
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingFeedback(false);
    }
  };

  const filteredAssignments = useMemo(() => {
    if (statusFilter === 'all') {
      return assignments;
    }
    if (statusFilter === 'active') {
      return assignments.filter(
        a => a.status === 'assigned' || a.status === 'confirmed',
      );
    }
    if (statusFilter === 'completed') {
      return assignments.filter(
        a => a.status === 'completed' || a.attendanceStatus === 'completed',
      );
    }
    return assignments.filter(a => a.status === statusFilter);
  }, [assignments, statusFilter]);

  const filterTabs: Array<{
    key: AssignmentFilterTab;
    label: string;
  }> = [
    { key: 'all', label: 'All Shifts' },
    { key: 'active', label: 'Active Shifts' },
    { key: 'completed', label: 'Completed' },
    { key: 'cancelled', label: 'Cancelled' },
  ];

  return (
    <View style={[styles.root, { backgroundColor: theme.colors.background }]}>
      <AppHeader
        title="My Assignments"
        subtitle="Confirmed shifts & attendance"
        onMenuPress={navigation ? () => navigation.openDrawer() : undefined}
      />

      {/* Filter tab bar */}
      <View
        style={[
          styles.filtersContainer,
          {
            backgroundColor: theme.colors.surface,
            borderBottomColor: theme.colors.border,
          },
        ]}
      >
        <ScrollView
          horizontal
          showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
          contentContainerStyle={styles.filterChipsRow}
        >
          {filterTabs.map(tab => (
            <FilterChip
              key={tab.key}
              label={tab.label}
              selected={statusFilter === tab.key}
              onPress={() => handleFilterChange(tab.key)}
            />
          ))}
        </ScrollView>
      </View>

      {/* Feedback banner */}
      {feedbackBanner ? (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.feedbackBanner,
            {
              backgroundColor: theme.colors.surfaceRaised,
              borderColor: theme.colors.primary,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            variant="caption"
            weight="bold"
            color={theme.colors.primary}
          >
            {feedbackBanner}
          </AppText>
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {/* List content */}
      {isLoading ? (
        <LoadingState label="Loading your shift assignments..." />
      ) : errorMessage ? (
        <ErrorState
          title="Could not load assignments"
          description={errorMessage}
          onRetry={fetchAssignments}
        />
      ) : (
        <FlatList
          ref={flatListRef}
          data={filteredAssignments}
          keyExtractor={item => item.id}
          contentContainerStyle={[
            styles.listContent,
            { padding: theme.spacing.md },
          ]}
          onScroll={handleScroll}
          scrollEventThrottle={16}
          refreshControl={
            <RefreshControl
              refreshing={isRefreshing}
              onRefresh={handleRefresh}
              tintColor={theme.colors.primary}
            />
          }
          renderItem={({ item }) => {
            const badge = getAssignmentBadgeConfig(
              item.status,
              item.attendanceStatus,
            );
            const canCancel =
              item.status === 'assigned' || item.status === 'confirmed';
            const isCompleted =
              item.status === 'completed' ||
              item.attendanceStatus === 'completed';

            return (
              <AppCard style={styles.cardSpacing}>
                {/* Header row: Status and Scheduled Date/Time */}
                <View style={styles.cardHeader}>
                  <StatusBadge status={badge.badgeStatus} label={badge.label} />
                  <AppText variant="caption" color={theme.colors.textSecondary}>
                    {formatDateTimeRange(item.startAt, item.endAt)}
                  </AppText>
                </View>

                {/* Main Card Tap Target for Event Detail */}
                <Pressable
                  accessibilityRole="button"
                  accessibilityLabel={`View details for ${item.eventTitle}`}
                  onPress={() => handleOpenDetail(item.eventId)}
                  style={styles.cardContentPressable}
                >
                  <AppText variant="title" weight="bold" style={styles.titleSpacing}>
                    {item.eventTitle}
                  </AppText>

                  <AppText
                    variant="body"
                    color={theme.colors.textSecondary}
                    style={styles.roleSpacing}
                  >
                    Role: {item.postTitle}
                  </AppText>

                  <AppText
                    variant="caption"
                    color={theme.colors.textSecondary}
                    style={styles.locationSpacing}
                  >
                    📍 {item.location}
                  </AppText>

                  {isCompleted && item.verifiedHours ? (
                    <AppText
                      variant="caption"
                      color={theme.colors.success}
                      weight="semibold"
                      style={styles.verifiedSpacing}
                    >
                      ✓ {item.verifiedHours.toFixed(1)} hrs verified coordinator attendance
                    </AppText>
                  ) : null}

                  <View style={styles.viewDetailLink}>
                    <AppText
                      variant="caption"
                      weight="semibold"
                      color={theme.colors.primary}
                    >
                      View Event Details →
                    </AppText>
                  </View>
                </Pressable>

                {/* Action footer */}
                <View style={styles.cardActions}>
                  {item.status === 'assigned' ? (
                    <AppButton
                      label="Confirm Shift"
                      variant="primary"
                      loading={confirmingId === item.id}
                      onPress={() => handleConfirmShift(item)}
                      accessibilityLabel={`Confirm shift for ${item.postTitle}`}
                      style={{ marginRight: 8, marginBottom: 8 }}
                    />
                  ) : null}

                  <AppButton
                    label="Onboarding"
                    variant="secondary"
                    onPress={() => handleOpenOnboarding(item)}
                    accessibilityLabel={`View onboarding for ${item.eventTitle}`}
                    style={{ marginRight: 8, marginBottom: 8 }}
                  />

                  {(item.status === 'confirmed' || item.status === 'assigned') &&
                  item.attendanceStatus !== 'checked_in' ? (
                    <AppButton
                      label="Check-In"
                      variant="primary"
                      onPress={() => setCheckInItem(item)}
                      accessibilityLabel={`Check in for ${item.postTitle}`}
                      style={{ marginRight: 8, marginBottom: 8 }}
                    />
                  ) : null}

                  {item.attendanceStatus === 'checked_in' ? (
                    <AppButton
                      label="Check-Out"
                      variant="primary"
                      onPress={() => handleCheckOut(item)}
                      accessibilityLabel={`Check out of ${item.postTitle}`}
                      style={{ marginRight: 8, marginBottom: 8 }}
                    />
                  ) : null}

                  {isCompleted ? (
                    <AppButton
                      label="Feedback"
                      variant="secondary"
                      onPress={() => setFeedbackItem(item)}
                      accessibilityLabel={`Leave feedback for ${item.eventTitle}`}
                      style={{ marginRight: 8, marginBottom: 8 }}
                    />
                  ) : null}

                  {canCancel ? (
                    <AppButton
                      label="Cancel participation"
                      variant="outline"
                      onPress={() => setAssignmentToCancel(item)}
                      accessibilityLabel={`Cancel participation for ${item.postTitle}`}
                      style={{ marginBottom: 8 }}
                    />
                  ) : null}
                </View>
              </AppCard>
            );
          }}
          ListEmptyComponent={
            <EmptyState
              title="No assignments found"

                  : 'You have no volunteer shift assignments scheduled.'
              }
              actionLabel={
                statusFilter !== 'all'
                  ? 'Show All Shifts'
                  : 'Discover Volunteer Opportunities'
              }
              onActionPress={
                statusFilter !== 'all'

      {/* Cancel participation confirmation modal */}
      <Modal

            <AppText variant="title" weight="bold" style={styles.modalTitle}>
              Cancel Participation
            </AppText>

            <AppText
              variant="body"
              color={theme.colors.textPrimary}

            {isMockMode() ? (

                variant="caption"
                color={theme.colors.textSecondary}

              </AppText>
            ) : null}

            <View style={styles.modalActions}>
              <View style={styles.modalButtonWrap}>
                <AppButton
                  label="Keep Shift"
                  variant="outline"
                  onPress={() => setAssignmentToCancel(null)}
                  disabled={isCancelling}
                />
              </View>
              <View style={styles.modalButtonWrap}>
                <AppButton
                  label="Cancel Participation"
                  variant="danger"
                  onPress={handleConfirmCancelParticipation}

          </View>

      </Modal>

      {/* Onboarding Briefing Modal */}
      <Modal
        visible={!!onboardingItem}

            <AppText variant="title" weight="bold" style={styles.modalTitle}>
              Event Onboarding Briefing
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="caption"
              color={theme.colors.primary}
              style={{ marginBottom: 12 }}

                />
              </View>
              {onboardingData?.requireOnboardingAck &&

                  />

      <Modal
        visible={!!checkInItem}
        transparent

        onRequestClose={() => setCheckInItem(null)}

            </View>

              <AppButton
                label="Cancel"
                variant="outline"
                onPress={() => {
                  setCheckInItem(null);
                  setQrTokenInput('');

              />
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>

      {/* Feedback Modal */}

        visible={!!feedbackItem}
        transparent
        animationType="fade"

      >
        <View style={styles.modalBackdrop}>
          <View
            style={[
              styles.modalCard,
              {
                backgroundColor: theme.colors.surface,
                borderRadius: theme.radius.md,
                borderColor: theme.colors.border,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText variant="title" weight="bold" style={styles.modalTitle}>
              Leave Event Feedback
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="caption"
              color={theme.colors.textSecondary}
              style={{ marginBottom: 16 }}
            >
              {feedbackItem?.eventTitle}
            </AppText>

            {/* Rating Stars 1-5 */}
            <View
              style={{
                flexDirection: 'row',
                justifyContent: 'center',
                marginBottom: 16,
                gap: 8,
              }}
            >
              {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(score => (
                <Pressable
                  key={score}
                  accessibilityRole="button"
                  accessibilityLabel={`Rate ${score} stars`}
                  onPress={() => setFeedbackScore(score)}
                  style={{
                    paddingHorizontal: 12,
                    paddingVertical: 8,
                    borderRadius: 6,
                    backgroundColor:
                      feedbackScore >= score
                        ? theme.colors.primary
                        : theme.colors.surfaceRaised,
                  }}
                >
                  <AppText
                    variant="caption"
                    weight="bold"
                    color={
                      feedbackScore >= score ? '#fff' : theme.colors.textPrimary
                    }
                  >
                    ★ {score}
                  </AppText>
                </Pressable>
              ))}
            </View>

            <AppInput
              value={feedbackComment}
              onChangeText={setFeedbackComment}
              placeholder="Tell us about your shift experience (optional)..."
              multiline
            />

            <View style={[styles.modalActions, { marginTop: 16 }]}>
              <View style={styles.modalButtonWrap}>
                <AppButton
                  label="Cancel"
                  variant="outline"
                  onPress={() => setFeedbackItem(null)}
                />
              </View>
              <View style={styles.modalButtonWrap}>
                <AppButton
                  label="Submit Rating"
                  variant="primary"
                  onPress={handleSubmitFeedback}
                  loading={isSubmittingFeedback}
                />
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
}

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import type { ProfileRepository } from '../../../data/contracts/profileRepository';

import { useRepositories } from '../../../app/RepositoryProvider';
import { CHARITY_CATEGORIES, CharityCategoryCode } from '../../../domain/models/event';

  'A+',
  'A-',
  'B+',
  'B-',
  'AB+',
  'AB-',
  'O+',
  'O-',
  'unknown',

export function ProfileEditScreen({
  navigation,
  repository: propRepository,
}: ProfileEditScreenProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const { theme } = useAppTheme();
  const repositories = useRepositories();
  const repository = propRepository ?? repositories.profileRepository ?? defaultProfileRepository;

  const [preferredLanguage, setPreferredLanguage] =

  const [homeArea, setHomeArea] = useState('');
  const [emergencyName, setEmergencyName] = useState('');
  const [emergencyPhone, setEmergencyPhone] = useState('');
  const [skills, setSkills] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [newSkillText, setNewSkillText] = useState('');
  const [charityInterests, setCharityInterests] = useState<
    CharityCategoryCode[]
  >([]);

  // Capabilities
  const [physicalOk, setPhysicalOk] = useState(false);
  const [canLiftHeavy, setCanLiftHeavy] = useState(false);
  const [canWorkOutdoor, setCanWorkOutdoor] = useState(false);
  const [goodEyesight, setGoodEyesight] = useState(true);
  const [needsGlasses, setNeedsGlasses] = useState(false);
  const [hasLeaderExperience, setHasLeaderExperience] = useState(false);
  const [newToVolunteer, setNewToVolunteer] = useState(false);

  // Support & Donation
  const [needsMealSupport, setNeedsMealSupport] = useState(false);
  const [needsTravelSupport, setNeedsTravelSupport] = useState(false);
  const [acceptsUnpaid, setAcceptsUnpaid] = useState(true);
  const [bloodType, setBloodType] = useState<BloodType>('unknown');
  const [isWillingToDonateBlood, setIsWillingToDonateBlood] = useState(false);
  const [isWillingToDonateItems, setIsWillingToDonateItems] = useState(false);

  // UI Feedback
  const [emergencyContactError, setEmergencyContactError] = useState<
    string | null
  >(null);
  const [feedbackBanner, setFeedbackBanner] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoadError(null);
      const data = await repository.getProfile();
      setProfile(data);

      // Populate draft fields
      setDisplayName(data.displayName);
      setPreferredLanguage(data.preferredLanguage);
      setHomeArea(data.homeArea);
      setEmergencyName(data.emergencyContactName);
      setEmergencyPhone(data.emergencyContactPhone);
      setSkills(data.skills);
      setCharityInterests(data.charityInterests);

      setPhysicalOk(data.capabilities.physicalOk);
      setCanLiftHeavy(data.capabilities.canLiftHeavy);
      setCanWorkOutdoor(data.capabilities.canWorkOutdoor);
      setGoodEyesight(data.capabilities.goodEyesight);
      setNeedsGlasses(data.capabilities.needsGlasses);
      setHasLeaderExperience(data.capabilities.hasLeaderExperience);
      setNewToVolunteer(data.capabilities.newToVolunteer);

      setNeedsMealSupport(data.supportPreferences.needsMealSupport);
      setNeedsTravelSupport(data.supportPreferences.needsTravelSupport);
      setAcceptsUnpaid(data.supportPreferences.acceptsUnpaid);

      setBloodType(data.donationPreferences.bloodType);
      setIsWillingToDonateBlood(
        data.donationPreferences.isWillingToDonateBlood,
      );
      setIsWillingToDonateItems(
        data.donationPreferences.isWillingToDonateItems,
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setLoadError(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to load profile',
      );
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [repository]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, [loadData]);

  const handleAddSkill = () => {
    if (newSkillText.trim().length === 0) {
      return;
    }
    const updated = normalizeSkills([...skills, newSkillText]);
    setSkills(updated);
    setNewSkillText('');
  };

  const handleRemoveSkill = (skillToRemove: string) => {
    setSkills(prev => prev.filter(s => s !== skillToRemove));
  };

  const toggleCharityInterest = (code: CharityCategoryCode) => {
    setCharityInterests(prev =>
      prev.includes(code) ? prev.filter(c => c !== code) : [...prev, code],
    );
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setEmergencyContactError(null);
    setFeedbackBanner(null);

    // Validate emergency contact pairing
    const validation = validateEmergencyContact(emergencyName, emergencyPhone);
    if (!validation.isValid) {
      setEmergencyContactError(
        validation.errorMessage ?? 'Emergency contact validation failed',
      );
      return;
    }

    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const result = await repository.updateProfile({
        displayName: displayName.trim(),
        preferredLanguage,
        homeArea: homeArea.trim(),
        emergencyContactName: emergencyName.trim(),
        emergencyContactPhone: emergencyPhone.trim(),
        skills: normalizeSkills(skills),
        charityInterests,
        capabilities: {
          physicalOk,
          goodEyesight,
          needsGlasses,
          canLiftHeavy,
          canWorkOutdoor,
          hasLeaderExperience,
          newToVolunteer,
        },
        supportPreferences: {
          needsMealSupport,
          needsTravelSupport,
          acceptsUnpaid,
        },
        donationPreferences: {
          bloodType,
          isWillingToDonate: isWillingToDonateBlood || isWillingToDonateItems,
          isWillingToDonateBlood,
          isWillingToDonateItems,
        },
      });

      if (result.success && result.data) {
        setProfile(result.data);
        setFeedbackBanner(
          isMockMode()
            ? `Profile saved in local mock state (${result.message})`
            : result.message,
        );
      } else {
        setFeedbackBanner(result.message);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setFeedbackBanner(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to update profile',
      );
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <View style={[styles.root, { backgroundColor: theme.colors.background }]}>
        <AppHeader
          title="Edit Profile"
          onBackPress={() => navigation?.goBack?.()}
        />
        <LoadingState label="Loading profile details..." />
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (loadError || !profile) {
    return (
      <View style={[styles.root, { backgroundColor: theme.colors.background }]}>
        <AppHeader
          title="Edit Profile"
          onBackPress={() => navigation?.goBack?.()}
        />
        <ErrorState
          title="Profile Unavailable"
          description={loadError ?? 'Could not find profile details.'}
          onRetry={loadData}
        />
      </View>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View style={[styles.root, { backgroundColor: theme.colors.background }]}>
      <AppHeader
        title="Edit Profile"
        subtitle="Update volunteer details & preferences"
        onBackPress={() => navigation?.goBack?.()}
      />

      <ScreenContainer scroll style={styles.scroll}>
        {/* Feedback / Demo confirmation banner */}
        {feedbackBanner ? (
          <View
            style={[
              styles.feedbackBanner,
              {
                backgroundColor: theme.colors.surfaceRaised,
                borderColor: theme.colors.primary,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="caption"
              weight="bold"
              color={theme.colors.primary}
            >
              {feedbackBanner}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {/* Read-Only System Identity Card */}
        <AppCard style={styles.cardSpacing}>
          <View style={styles.systemBadgeRow}>
            <StatusBadge
              status={profile.accountStatus === 'active' ? 'success' : 'danger'}
              label={`Account: ${profile.accountStatus}`}
            />
            <StatusBadge
              status={
                profile.verificationStatus === 'verified'
                  ? 'success'
                  : 'warning'
              }
              label={`Identity: ${profile.verificationStatus}`}
            />
            <StatusBadge
              status={
                profile.coordinatorStatus === 'approved' ? 'info' : 'muted'
              }
              label={`Coordinator: ${profile.coordinatorStatus}`}
            />
          </View>

          <AppText variant="title" weight="bold" color={theme.colors.textPrimary}>
            {profile.displayName}
          </AppText>
          <AppText
            variant="body"
            color={theme.colors.textSecondary}
            style={styles.emailSpacing}
          >
            {profile.phone ?? profile.email ?? 'No phone on file'}
          </AppText>

          <View
            style={[
              styles.privilegedNoticeBox,
              {
                backgroundColor: theme.colors.surfaceRaised,
                borderColor: theme.colors.border,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppIcon name="info" size={14} color={theme.colors.textSecondary} />
            <AppText
              variant="caption"
              color={theme.colors.textSecondary}
              style={styles.privilegedNoticeText}
            >
              System privileges and verification statuses are managed by server
              administrators and are read-only.
            </AppText>
          </View>
        </AppCard>

        {/* Basic Allow-listed Profile Fields */}
        <SectionHeader title="Basic Information" />
        <AppCard style={styles.cardSpacing}>
          <AppInput
            label="Display Name *"
            value={displayName}
            onChangeText={setDisplayName}
            placeholder="Your public volunteer name"
            style={styles.fieldSpacing}
          />

          <AppInput
            label="Home Township / Area"
            value={homeArea}
            onChangeText={setHomeArea}
            placeholder="e.g. Kamayut Township"
            style={styles.fieldSpacing}
          />

          <AppText
            variant="caption"
            weight="semibold"
            color={theme.colors.textSecondary}
            style={styles.sectionSublabel}
          >
            Preferred Language
          </AppText>
          <View style={styles.chipsRow}>
            <FilterChip
              label="English (en)"
              selected={preferredLanguage === 'en'}
              onPress={() => setPreferredLanguage('en')}
            />
            <FilterChip
              label="Myanmar (my)"
              selected={preferredLanguage === 'my'}
              onPress={() => setPreferredLanguage('my')}
            />
          </View>
        </AppCard>

        {/* Emergency Contact Pair */}
        <SectionHeader title="Emergency Contact" />
        <AppCard style={styles.cardSpacing}>
          <AppText
            variant="caption"
            color={theme.colors.textSecondary}
            style={styles.emergencyNotice}
          >
            Emergency contact name and phone number must both be provided or both
            cleared.
          </AppText>

          <AppInput
            label="Contact Full Name"
            value={emergencyName}
            onChangeText={text => {
              setEmergencyName(text);
              if (emergencyContactError) {
                setEmergencyContactError(null);
              }
            }}
            placeholder="e.g. Taylor Morgan"
            style={styles.fieldSpacing}
          />

          <AppInput
            label="Contact Phone Number"
            value={emergencyPhone}
            onChangeText={text => {
              setEmergencyPhone(text);
              if (emergencyContactError) {
                setEmergencyContactError(null);
              }
            }}
            placeholder="e.g. +959123456789"
            error={emergencyContactError ?? undefined}
            style={styles.fieldSpacing}
          />
        </AppCard>

        {/* Volunteer Skills */}
        <SectionHeader title="Skills & Competencies" />
        <AppCard style={styles.cardSpacing}>
          <AppText
            variant="caption"
            color={theme.colors.textSecondary}
            style={styles.emergencyNotice}
          >
            Skills are automatically trimmed, lowercased, deduplicated, and
            sorted.
          </AppText>

          {/* Add skill row */}
          <View style={styles.addSkillRow}>
            <View style={styles.addSkillInputWrap}>
              <AppInput
                value={newSkillText}
                onChangeText={setNewSkillText}
                placeholder="Add skill (e.g. first_aid, driving)"
              />
            </View>
            <AppButton
              label="Add"
              variant="outline"
              onPress={handleAddSkill}
              style={styles.addSkillButton}
            />
          </View>

          {/* Current skills chips */}
          <View style={styles.skillsWrap}>
            {skills.map(skill => (
              <Pressable
                key={skill}
                accessibilityRole="button"
                accessibilityLabel={`Remove skill ${skill}`}
                onPress={() => handleRemoveSkill(skill)}
                style={[
                  styles.skillChip,
                  {
                    backgroundColor: theme.colors.surfaceRaised,
                    borderColor: theme.colors.border,
                    borderRadius: theme.radius.sm,
                  },
                ]}
              >
                <AppText variant="caption" weight="semibold" color={theme.colors.primary}>
                  {skill} ✕
                </AppText>
              </Pressable>
            ))}
          </View>
        </AppCard>

        {/* Charity Interests */}
        <SectionHeader title="Charity Interests" />
        <AppCard style={styles.cardSpacing}>
          <AppText
            variant="caption"

            style={styles.emergencyNotice}
          >
            Select charity sectors you are interested in supporting:
          </AppText>
          <View style={styles.categoriesWrap}>
            {CHARITY_CATEGORIES.map(category => (

                key={category.code}
                label={category.label}

                onPress={() => toggleCharityInterest(category.code)}
              />
            ))}
          </View>
        </AppCard>

        {/* Volunteer Suitability & Capabilities */}
        <SectionHeader title="Suitability & Work Preferences" />
        <AppCard style={styles.cardSpacing}>
          <View style={styles.togglesWrap}>
            <FilterChip
              label="Physical OK"
              selected={physicalOk}
              onPress={() => setPhysicalOk(!physicalOk)}
            />
            <FilterChip
              label="Can Lift Heavy (>15kg)"
              selected={canLiftHeavy}
              onPress={() => setCanLiftHeavy(!canLiftHeavy)}
            />
            <FilterChip
              label="Can Work Outdoor"
              selected={canWorkOutdoor}
              onPress={() => setCanWorkOutdoor(!canWorkOutdoor)}
            />
            <FilterChip

              selected={goodEyesight}
              onPress={() => setGoodEyesight(!goodEyesight)}
            />
            <FilterChip
              label="Needs Glasses"

              onPress={() => setNeedsGlasses(!needsGlasses)}
            />
            <FilterChip

          <View style={styles.togglesWrap}>

            <FilterChip
              label="Accepts Unpaid Roles"
              selected={acceptsUnpaid}
              onPress={() => setAcceptsUnpaid(!acceptsUnpaid)}
            />
          </View>
        </AppCard>

        {/* Blood Donation & Community Giving */}
        <SectionHeader title="Community Contribution" />
        <AppCard style={styles.cardSpacing}>
          <AppText
            variant="caption"
            weight="semibold"
            color={theme.colors.textSecondary}
            style={styles.sectionSublabel}
          >
            Blood Type
          </AppText>
          <View style={styles.togglesWrap}>
            {BLOOD_TYPES.map(bt => (
              <FilterChip
                key={bt}
                label={bt}
                selected={bloodType === bt}
                onPress={() => setBloodType(bt)}
              />
            ))}
          </View>

          <View style={[styles.togglesWrap, styles.givingTopMargin]}>
            <FilterChip
              label="Willing to Donate Blood"
              selected={isWillingToDonateBlood}
              onPress={() => setIsWillingToDonateBlood(!isWillingToDonateBlood)}

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

  Pressable,
  StyleSheet,

} from '../../../data/contracts/profileRepository';

export interface ProfileScreenProps
  extends Partial<MainDrawerScreenProps<'Profile'>> {
  repository?: ProfileRepository;
}

const CATEGORY_MAP: Record<string, string> = Object.fromEntries(
  CHARITY_CATEGORIES.map(c => [c.code, c.label]),
);

function getInitials(name: string): string {
  const parts = name.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length === 0) {
    return 'V';
  }
  if (parts.length === 1) {
    return parts[0].substring(0, 2).toUpperCase();
  }
  return (parts[0][0] + parts[parts.length - 1][0]).toUpperCase();
}

export function ProfileScreen({
  navigation,
  repository: propRepository,
}: ProfileScreenProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const { theme } = useAppTheme();
  const repositories = useRepositories();
  const repository = propRepository ?? repositories.profileRepository ?? defaultProfileRepository;

  const [profile, setProfile] = useState<VolunteerProfile | null>(null);
  const [eligibility, setEligibility] =
    useState<CoordinatorEligibilityData | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [loadError, setLoadError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [feedbackBanner, setFeedbackBanner] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isApplying, setIsApplying] = useState(false);

  const loadData = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoadError(null);
      const [profileData, eligibilityData] = await Promise.all([
        repository.getProfile(),
        repository.getCoordinatorEligibility(),
      ]);
      setProfile(profileData);
      setEligibility(eligibilityData);
    } catch (err) {
      setLoadError(
        err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to load profile details',
      );
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [repository]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, [loadData]);

  const handleApplyCoordinator = async () => {
    if (!eligibility) {
      return;
    }

    const canApply =
      eligibility.isVerified &&
      eligibility.meetsCompletedEventsRequirement &&
      eligibility.meetsGoodRatingRequirement === true;

    if (!canApply) {
      return;
    }

    setIsApplying(true);
    try {
      const result = await repository.submitCoordinatorApplication(
        'Volunteer coordinator application',
      );
      if (result.success) {
        setFeedbackBanner(
          `Coordinator application submitted (${result.message})`,
        );
        // Refresh eligibility data
        const updatedEligibility = await repository.getCoordinatorEligibility();
        setEligibility(updatedEligibility);
      } else {
        setFeedbackBanner(result.message);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      setFeedbackBanner(
        err instanceof Error
          ? err.message
          : 'Failed to submit coordinator application',
      );
    } finally {
      setIsApplying(false);
    }
  };

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <View style={[styles.root, { backgroundColor: theme.colors.background }]}>
        <AppHeader
          title="Profile"
          onMenuPress={navigation ? () => navigation.openDrawer() : undefined}
        />
        <LoadingState label="Loading profile summary..." />
      </View>
    );
  }

  if (loadError || !profile || !eligibility) {
    return (
      <View style={[styles.root, { backgroundColor: theme.colors.background }]}>
        <AppHeader
          title="Profile"
          onMenuPress={navigation ? () => navigation.openDrawer() : undefined}
        />
        <ErrorState
          title="Profile Unavailable"
          description={loadError ?? 'Could not find profile summary.'}
          onRetry={loadData}
        />
      </View>
    );
  }

  const initials = getInitials(profile.displayName);
  const ratingAverage = eligibility.ratingAverage ?? profile.ratingAverage;
  const ratingCount = eligibility.ratingCount ?? profile.ratingCount ?? 0;

  const canApplyCoordinator =
    eligibility.coordinatorStatus === 'none' &&
    eligibility.isVerified &&
    eligibility.meetsCompletedEventsRequirement &&
    eligibility.meetsGoodRatingRequirement === true;

  return (
    <View style={[styles.root, { backgroundColor: theme.colors.background }]}>
      <AppHeader
        title="Profile"
        subtitle="Volunteer summary & verification"
        onMenuPress={navigation ? () => navigation.openDrawer() : undefined}
      />

      <ScreenContainer scroll style={styles.scroll}>
        {/* Feedback / Demo confirmation banner */}
        {feedbackBanner ? (
          <View
            style={[
              styles.feedbackBanner,
              {
                backgroundColor: theme.colors.surfaceRaised,
                borderColor: theme.colors.primary,
              },
            ]}
          >
            <AppText
              variant="caption"
              weight="bold"
              color={theme.colors.primary}
            >
              {feedbackBanner}
            </AppText>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        {/* Concise Profile Summary Card */}
        <AppCard style={styles.cardSpacing}>
          {/* Card Header Row: Avatar, Name & Badges, Edit Button */}
          <View style={styles.summaryHeaderRow}>
            <View
              style={[
                styles.avatarContainer,
                { backgroundColor: theme.colors.primary },
              ]}
              accessibilityRole="image"
              accessibilityLabel={`Avatar for ${profile.displayName}`}
            >
              <AppText variant="title" weight="bold" color="#ffffff">
                {initials}
              </AppText>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.identityDetails}>
              <AppText
                variant="title"
                weight="bold"
                color={theme.colors.textPrimary}
                numberOfLines={1}
              >
                {profile.displayName}
              </AppText>
              <View style={styles.badgeRow}>
                <StatusBadge
                  status={profile.accountStatus === 'active' ? 'success' : 'danger'}
                  label={
                    profile.accountStatus === 'active'
                      ? 'Active Volunteer'
                      : `Account: ${profile.accountStatus}`
                  }
                />
                <StatusBadge
                  status={
                    profile.verificationStatus === 'verified'
                      ? 'success'
                      : 'warning'
                  }
                  label={
                    profile.verificationStatus === 'verified'
                      ? 'Verified'
                      : `Identity: ${profile.verificationStatus}`
                  }
                />

            <Pressable

              <AppText

          <View
