          />

          {/* Selected Summary Fields (Strictly no hash, password, token, admin/staff, or private paths) */}
          <View style={styles.summaryFieldList}>
            <View style={styles.summaryRow}>
              <AppText
                variant="caption"
                weight="semibold"
                color={theme.colors.textSecondary}
                style={styles.summaryLabel}
              >
                Phone
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                color={theme.colors.textPrimary}
                style={styles.summaryValue}
              >
                {profile.phone ?? profile.email ?? 'No phone on file'}
              </AppText>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.summaryRow}>
              <AppText
                variant="caption"
                weight="semibold"
                color={theme.colors.textSecondary}
                style={styles.summaryLabel}
              >
                Home Area

              <AppText
                variant="body"

              >
                {profile.homeArea || 'Not specified'}

            <View style={styles.summaryRow}>
              <AppText
                variant="caption"
                weight="semibold"
                color={theme.colors.textSecondary}
                style={styles.summaryLabel}
              >
                Language
              </AppText>

                variant="body"
                color={theme.colors.textPrimary}
                style={styles.summaryValue}
              >
                {profile.preferredLanguage === 'my'
                  ? 'Myanmar (Burmese)'
                  : 'English'}
              </AppText>
            </View>

            <View style={styles.summaryRow}>
              <AppText
                variant="caption"
                weight="semibold"
                color={theme.colors.textSecondary}
                style={styles.summaryLabel}
              >
                Emergency Contact
              </AppText>
              <AppText
                variant="body"
                color={theme.colors.textPrimary}
                style={styles.summaryValue}
              >
                {profile.emergencyContactName
                  ? `${profile.emergencyContactName} (${profile.emergencyContactPhone})`
                  : 'Not configured'}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Skills Chips */}
          <View style={styles.tagsContainer}>
            <AppText
              variant="caption"
              weight="semibold"
              color={theme.colors.textSecondary}
              style={styles.tagSectionLabel}
            >
              Skills
            </AppText>
            <View style={styles.tagsRow}>
              {profile.skills.length > 0 ? (
                profile.skills.map(skill => (
                  <View
                    key={skill}
                    style={[
                      styles.tagChip,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: theme.colors.surfaceRaised,
                        borderColor: theme.colors.border,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      variant="caption"
                      weight="semibold"
                      color={theme.colors.textPrimary}
                    >
                      {skill}
                    </AppText>
                  </View>
                ))
              ) : (
                <AppText variant="caption" color={theme.colors.textSecondary}>
                  No skills listed
                </AppText>
              )}
            </View>
          </View>

          {/* Charity Interests Chips */}
          <View style={styles.tagsContainer}>
            <AppText
              variant="caption"
              weight="semibold"
              color={theme.colors.textSecondary}
              style={styles.tagSectionLabel}
            >
              Charity Interests
            </AppText>
            <View style={styles.tagsRow}>
              {profile.charityInterests.length > 0 ? (
                profile.charityInterests.map(code => (
                  <View
                    key={code}
                    style={[
                      styles.tagChip,
                      {
                        backgroundColor: theme.colors.surfaceRaised,
                        borderColor: theme.colors.border,
                      },
                    ]}
                  >
                    <AppText
                      variant="caption"
                      weight="semibold"
                      color={theme.colors.primary}
                    >
                      {CATEGORY_MAP[code] ?? code}
                    </AppText>
                  </View>
                ))
              ) : (
                <AppText variant="caption" color={theme.colors.textSecondary}>
                  No charity interests selected
                </AppText>
              )}
            </View>
          </View>
        </AppCard>

        {/* Become a Coordinator Card */}
        <SectionHeader title="Coordinator Program" />
        <AppCard style={styles.cardSpacing}>
          <View style={styles.coordinatorCardHeader}>
            <AppText
              variant="title"
              weight="bold"
              color={theme.colors.textPrimary}
            >
              Become a Coordinator
            </AppText>
            <AppText
              variant="caption"
              color={theme.colors.textSecondary}
              style={styles.coordinatorSubtitle}
            >
              Coordinate community events, oversee shifts, and support volunteer teams.
            </AppText>
          </View>

          {/* Non-none coordinator status view: show status badge & descriptive message */}
          {eligibility.coordinatorStatus !== 'none' ? (
            <View
              style={[
                styles.statusNotificationBox,
                {
                  backgroundColor: theme.colors.surfaceRaised,
                  borderColor: theme.colors.border,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <View style={styles.statusBadgeWrap}>
                <StatusBadge
                  status={
                    eligibility.coordinatorStatus === 'approved'
                      ? 'success'
                      : eligibility.coordinatorStatus === 'pending'
                      ? 'warning'
                      : 'danger'
                  }
                  label={
                    eligibility.coordinatorStatus === 'pending'
                      ? 'Application Pending'
                      : eligibility.coordinatorStatus === 'approved'
                      ? 'Active Coordinator'
                      : eligibility.coordinatorStatus === 'suspended'
                      ? 'Coordinator Suspended'
                      : 'Coordinator Revoked'
                  }
                />
              </View>

              <AppText
                variant="body"
                color={theme.colors.textPrimary}
                style={styles.statusDescriptionText}
              >
                {eligibility.coordinatorStatus === 'pending' &&
                  'Your coordinator application is under review. Our team will verify your qualifications.'}
                {eligibility.coordinatorStatus === 'approved' &&
                  'You are an active coordinator with event management and shift leadership privileges.'}
                {eligibility.coordinatorStatus === 'suspended' &&
                  'Your coordinator privileges are currently suspended. Please contact administration.'}
                {eligibility.coordinatorStatus === 'revoked' &&
                  'Your coordinator privileges have been revoked.'}
              </AppText>
            </View>
          ) : (
            /* Coordinator Status === 'none': Present 3 eligibility checks */
            <View style={styles.checksContainer}>
              {/* Check 1: Account Verified */}
              <View style={styles.checkItem}>
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.checkIconWrap,
                    {
                      backgroundColor: theme.colors.surfaceRaised,
                      borderColor: eligibility.isVerified
                        ? theme.colors.success
                        : theme.colors.border,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppIcon
                    name={eligibility.isVerified ? 'check' : 'alert'}
                    size={14}
                    color={
                      eligibility.isVerified
                        ? theme.colors.success
                        : theme.colors.warning
                    }
                  />
                </View>
                <View style={styles.checkTextWrap}>
                  <AppText
                    variant="body"
                    weight="semibold"
                    color={theme.colors.textPrimary}
                  >
                    Account Verified
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText variant="caption" color={theme.colors.textSecondary}>
                    {eligibility.isVerified
                      ? 'Account verified (Tier 1 identity confirmed)'
                      : `Identity verification required (Status: ${eligibility.verificationStatus})`}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              </View>

              {/* Check 2: At least 5 completed events (Attendance-backed) */}
              <View style={styles.checkItem}>
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.checkIconWrap,
                    {
                      backgroundColor: theme.colors.surfaceRaised,
                      borderColor: eligibility.meetsCompletedEventsRequirement
                        ? theme.colors.success
                        : theme.colors.border,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppIcon
                    name={
                      eligibility.meetsCompletedEventsRequirement
                        ? 'check'
                        : 'alert'
                    }
                    size={14}
                    color={
                      eligibility.meetsCompletedEventsRequirement
                        ? theme.colors.success
                        : theme.colors.warning
                    }
                  />
                </View>
                <View style={styles.checkTextWrap}>
                  <AppText
                    variant="body"
                    weight="semibold"
                    color={theme.colors.textPrimary}
                  >
                    At least 5 completed events
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText variant="caption" color={theme.colors.textSecondary}>
                    {`${eligibility.completedAttendanceEventsCount}/5 attendance-backed events completed`}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              </View>

              {/* Check 3: Good Rating (Null represents missing rule configuration / pending confirmation) */}
              <View style={styles.checkItem}>
                <View
                  style={[
                    styles.checkIconWrap,
                    {
                      backgroundColor: theme.colors.surfaceRaised,
                      borderColor:
                        eligibility.meetsGoodRatingRequirement === true
                          ? theme.colors.success
                          : eligibility.meetsGoodRatingRequirement === false
                          ? theme.colors.danger
                          : theme.colors.border,
                    },
                  ]}
                >
                  <AppIcon
                    name={
                      eligibility.meetsGoodRatingRequirement === true
                        ? 'check'
                        : 'alert'
                    }
                    size={14}
                    color={
                      eligibility.meetsGoodRatingRequirement === true
                        ? theme.colors.success
                        : eligibility.meetsGoodRatingRequirement === false
                        ? theme.colors.danger
                        : theme.colors.warning
                    }
                  />
                </View>
                <View style={styles.checkTextWrap}>
                  <AppText
                    variant="body"
                    weight="semibold"
                    color={theme.colors.textPrimary}
                  >
                    Good Volunteer Rating
                  </AppText>
                  <AppText variant="caption" color={theme.colors.textSecondary}>
                    {eligibility.meetsGoodRatingRequirement === true
                      ? 'Good rating requirement met'
                      : eligibility.meetsGoodRatingRequirement === false
                      ? 'Volunteer rating requirement not met'
                      : 'Requirement pending server confirmation (no threshold configured)'}
                  </AppText>
                </View>
              </View>

              {/* Apply Button */}
              <View style={styles.applyActionWrap}>
                <AppButton
                  label="Apply for Coordinator"
                  variant="primary"
                  accessibilityLabel="Apply for Coordinator"
                  disabled={!canApplyCoordinator}
                  loading={isApplying}
                  onPress={handleApplyCoordinator}
                />
                {!canApplyCoordinator ? (
                  <AppText
                    variant="caption"
                    color={theme.colors.textSecondary}
                    style={styles.disabledHelperText}
                  >
                    Complete all eligibility requirements above to apply for coordinator status.
                  </AppText>
                ) : null}
              </View>
            </View>
          )}
        </AppCard>

        {/* Schedule & Verification Tools Navigation */}
        <SectionHeader title="Schedule & Verification Tools" />
        <View style={styles.navStack}>
          <AppButton
            label="Manage Weekly Availability"
            variant="secondary"
            leftIcon="calendar"
            onPress={() => navigation?.navigate?.('Availability')}
          />
          <AppButton
            label="Verification & Identity Documents"
            variant="secondary"
            leftIcon="info"
            onPress={() =>
              navigation?.navigate?.('VerificationCoordinatorStatus')
            }
          />
        </View>
      </ScreenContainer>
    </View>
  );
}

/**
 * @format

import React from 'react';
import {
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  StyleSheet,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { useSafeAreaInsets } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import type { DrawerContentComponentProps } from '@react-navigation/drawer';
import { useCurrentUser } from '../app/UserContext';
import { isMockMode } from '../app/configuration/dataMode';
import { AppIcon, AppText, IconName, StatusBadge } from '../shared';
import { hexToRgba, useAppTheme } from '../theme';
import type { RouteName } from './routeNames';

interface DrawerItemConfig {
  name: RouteName;
  label: string;
  icon: IconName;
}

const MAIN_ITEMS: DrawerItemConfig[] = [
  { name: 'Dashboard', label: 'Dashboard', icon: 'home' },
  { name: 'Events', label: 'Events', icon: 'compass' },
  { name: 'Friends', label: 'Friends', icon: 'user' },
];

const ACCOUNT_ITEMS: DrawerItemConfig[] = [
  { name: 'MyApplications', label: 'My Applications', icon: 'check' },
  { name: 'MyAssignments', label: 'My Assignments', icon: 'calendar' },
  { name: 'Profile', label: 'Profile', icon: 'user' },
  { name: 'Availability', label: 'Availability', icon: 'clock' },
  {
    name: 'VerificationCoordinatorStatus',
    label: 'Verification & Status',
    icon: 'info',
  },
];

const PREFERENCE_ITEMS: DrawerItemConfig[] = [
  { name: 'Settings', label: 'Settings', icon: 'refresh' },
];

export function MainDrawerContent({
  state,
  navigation,
}: DrawerContentComponentProps): React.JSX.Element {
  const insets = useSafeAreaInsets();
  const { theme, isDark } = useAppTheme();
  const { currentUser, isCoordinator, switchUserPreset } = useCurrentUser();

  const currentRouteName = state.routes[state.index]?.name;

  const renderDrawerItem = (item: DrawerItemConfig) => {
    const isSelected = currentRouteName === item.name;

    const selectedThemeStyle = isSelected
      ? {
          backgroundColor: hexToRgba(theme.colors.primary, isDark ? 0.20 : 0.12),
        }
      : undefined;

    return (
      <Pressable
        key={item.name}
        accessibilityRole="button"
        accessibilityLabel={item.label}
        accessibilityState={{ selected: isSelected }}
        onPress={() => navigation.navigate(item.name)}
        style={({ pressed }) => [
          styles.drawerItem,
          {
            borderRadius: 12,
            paddingVertical: 10,
            paddingHorizontal: 14,
            opacity: pressed ? 0.85 : 1,
          },
          selectedThemeStyle,
        ]}
      >
        <View
          style={[
            styles.itemIconContainer,
            {
              backgroundColor: isSelected
                ? theme.colors.primary
                : theme.colors.surfaceRaised,
              borderRadius: 10,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <AppIcon
            name={item.icon}
            size={16}
            color={isSelected ? '#FFFFFF' : theme.colors.textSecondary}
          />
        </View>
        <AppText
          variant="body"
          weight={isSelected ? 'bold' : 'medium'}
          color={isSelected ? theme.colors.primary : theme.colors.textPrimary}
          style={styles.itemLabel}
        >
          {item.label}
        </AppText>
      </Pressable>
    );
  };

  return (
    <View
      style={[
        styles.drawerContainer,
        {
          backgroundColor: theme.colors.surface,
          paddingTop: insets.top,
          paddingBottom: insets.bottom,
        },
      ]}
    >
      {/* Header Profile Section */}
      <View
        style={[
          styles.headerSection,
          {
            borderBottomColor: theme.colors.border,
            padding: 16,
          },
        ]}
      >
        <View
          style={[
            styles.avatarSquircle,
            {
              backgroundColor: hexToRgba(theme.colors.primary, isDark ? 0.22 : 0.12),
              borderColor: hexToRgba(theme.colors.primary, 0.25),
              borderRadius: 16,
              marginBottom: 10,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <AppIcon name="user" size={24} color={theme.colors.primary} />
        </View>

        <AppText variant="title" weight="extrabold" color={theme.colors.textPrimary}>
          {currentUser.displayName}
        </AppText>

        <AppText
          variant="caption"
          color={theme.colors.textSecondary}
          style={styles.emailMargin}
        >
          {currentUser.phone ?? currentUser.email ?? 'No phone on file'}
        </AppText>

        <View style={styles.badgeRow}>
          <StatusBadge status="emerald" label="Active Volunteer" />
          {isCoordinator ? (
            <StatusBadge status="sky" label="Approved Coordinator" />
          ) : null}
        </View>
      </View>

      {/* Destination Sections */}
      <ScrollView
        contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollList}
        showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
      >
        {/* Main Group */}
        <AppText
          variant="eyebrow"
          color={theme.colors.muted}
          style={[styles.sectionHeading, { paddingHorizontal: 16 }]}
        >
          MAIN NAVIGATION
        </AppText>
        <View style={styles.itemGroup}>{MAIN_ITEMS.map(renderDrawerItem)}</View>

        {/* My Account Group */}
        <AppText
          variant="eyebrow"
          color={theme.colors.muted}
          style={[styles.sectionHeading, { paddingHorizontal: 16 }]}
        >
          MY ACCOUNT
        </AppText>
        <View style={styles.itemGroup}>
          {ACCOUNT_ITEMS.map(renderDrawerItem)}
        </View>

        {/* Coordinator Group */}
        {isCoordinator ? (
          <>
            <AppText
              variant="eyebrow"
              color={theme.colors.primary}
              style={[styles.sectionHeading, { paddingHorizontal: 16 }]}
            >
              COORDINATOR
            </AppText>
            <View style={styles.itemGroup}>
              {renderDrawerItem({
                name: 'CoordinatorWorkspace',
                label: 'Coordinator Workspace',
                icon: 'brief',
              })}
            </View>
          </>
        ) : null}

        {/* Preferences Group */}
        <AppText
          variant="eyebrow"
          color={theme.colors.muted}
          style={[styles.sectionHeading, { paddingHorizontal: 16 }]}
        >
          PREFERENCES
        </AppText>
        <View style={styles.itemGroup}>
          {PREFERENCE_ITEMS.map(renderDrawerItem)}
        </View>
      </ScrollView>

      {/* Bottom QA Profile Switcher — Mock mode only */}
      {typeof __DEV__ !== 'undefined' && __DEV__ && isMockMode() ? (
        <View
          style={[
            styles.footerSection,
            {
              borderTopColor: theme.colors.border,
              backgroundColor: theme.colors.surfaceRaised,
              padding: 14,
            },
          ]}
        >
          <AppText
            variant="eyebrow"
            color={theme.colors.muted}
            style={styles.qaFooterLabel}
          >
            QA DEMO PROFILE SWITCHER
          </AppText>

          <View style={styles.qaButtonsRow}>
            <Pressable
              accessibilityRole="button"
              accessibilityLabel="Switch to ordinary volunteer"
              onPress={() => switchUserPreset('volunteer')}
              style={[
                styles.qaButton,
                {
                  backgroundColor: !isCoordinator
                    ? theme.colors.primary
                    : theme.colors.surface,
                  borderColor: theme.colors.border,
                  borderRadius: 10,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="label"
                weight="bold"
                color={
                  !isCoordinator
                    ? '#FFFFFF'
                    : theme.colors.textPrimary
                }
              >
                Volunteer
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>

            <Pressable
              accessibilityRole="button"
              accessibilityLabel="Switch to approved coordinator"
              onPress={() => switchUserPreset('coordinator')}
              style={[
                styles.qaButton,
                {
                  backgroundColor: isCoordinator
                    ? theme.colors.primary
                    : theme.colors.surface,
                  borderColor: theme.colors.border,
                  borderRadius: 10,
                },
              ]}
            >
              <AppText
                variant="label"
                weight="bold"
                color={
                  isCoordinator
                    ? '#FFFFFF'
                    : theme.colors.textPrimary
                }
              >
                Coordinator
              </AppText>
            </Pressable>
          </View>
        </View>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

  avatarSquircle: {
